name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_aci

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_acp
description: Average Collection Period: average of trailing 12-month accounts receivable times 365 divided by trailing 12-month sales, indicating how long it takes for a company to collect payments

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_acqmul
description: Acquisition Multiple: most recent invested capital divided by trailing 12-month EBITDA, showing acquisition valuation

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_actrtn18m
description: 18-Month Active Return with 1-Month Lag: percent change in stock price from month t-19 to t-1

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_actrtn1m
description: 1-Month Active Return: percent change in stock price from month t-1 to t

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_actrtn24m
description: 24-Month Active Return with 1-Month Lag: percent change in stock price from month t-25 to t-1

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_actrtn2m
description: 2-Month Active Return: percent change in stock price from month t-2 to t

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_actrtn36m
description: 36-Month Active Return with 1-Month Lag: percent change in stock price from month t-37 to t-1

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_actrtn3m
description: 3-Month Active Return: percent change in stock price from month t-3 to t

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_actrtn60m
description: 60-Month Active Return with 1-Month Lag: percent change in stock price from month t-61 to t-1

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_actrtn6m
description: 6-Month Active Return with 1-Month Lag: percent change in stock price from month t-7 to t-1

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_actrtn9m
description: 9-Month Active Return with 1-Month Lag: percent change in stock price from month t-10 to t-1

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_alpha60m
description: 60-Month Alpha: intercept from regression of stock's monthly return versus S&P 500 monthly return for the past 60 months, representing risk-adjusted outperformance

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_app
description: Average Payable Period: average of trailing 12-month accounts payable times 365 divided by trailing 12-month cost of goods sold, indicating how long a company takes to pay suppliers

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_aqi
description: Asset Quality Index: year-over-year change of 1 minus the ratio of current assets plus PP&E to total assets, reflecting asset quality improvement or deterioration

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_aspanratio
description: Operating assets minus operating liabilities for the quarter, divided by lagged total assets, a balance sheet efficiency measure

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_astcomp
description: Asset Composition: total current assets from the most recent quarter divided by total assets from the same quarter, indicating the proportion of current assets

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_astto
description: Assets Turnover Ratio: trailing 12-month sales divided by most recent quarterly assets, measuring efficiency of asset usage in generating sales

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_bdi
description: Basic Defensive Interval: number of days a company can cover daily operating expenses solely from its cash and receivables

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_beta
description: 60-Month Beta: measure of stock's sensitivity to market movements, calculated as a weighted average (0.67 × 60-month beta + 0.33 × beta) using covariance of stock and S&P 500 monthly returns

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_betasigma
description: Product of Beta and Sigma: product of 60-month adjusted beta and 60-month standard deviation of monthly returns, a risk metric

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_booklev
description: Book Leverage: most recent quarterly total assets divided by book equity, a leverage ratio

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_bp
description: Book-to-Market: most recent book value per share divided by month-end trading price, a value investing measure

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_capacq
description: Capital Acquisition Ratio: trailing 12-month operating cash flow less cash dividends, divided by total expenditures in the same period, a management quality/profitability measure

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_capexast
description: Capital Expenditure-to-Total Assets: trailing 12-month capital expenditures divided by most recent quarter's total assets, a capital investment measure

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_capexsale
description: TTM Capital Expenditures-to-Sales: trailing 12-month capital expenditures divided by trailing 12-month sales, indicating capital intensity relative to sales

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_cashburnrate
description: Rate at which a company burns cash; computed as negative (operating cash flow plus investing cash flow) divided by cash and short-term investments

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_cashc
description: Cash conversion cycle in days: inventory days plus receivables days minus payables days

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_cashp
description: Cash and equivalents per share divided by trading price (cash-to-price ratio)

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_cashratio
description: Cash and equivalents divided by current liabilities (cash ratio)

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_cashsale
description: Cash-to-sales ratio: trailing 12-month average cash and equivalents divided by trailing 12-month sales

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_cashsev
description: Total cash and equivalents divided by enterprise value

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_ccd
description: Current cash flow debt coverage: (cash flow from operations minus dividends) divided by current interest-bearing debt

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_cfita
description: Trailing 12-month investing cash flow divided by average total assets over the last four quarters

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_cfleverage
description: Total liabilities divided by trailing 12-month operating cash flow (cash flow leverage)

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_cfroi
description: Trailing 12-month cash flow divided by average invested capital (equity, long-term debt, minority interest, and preferred stock)

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_cg3ysales
description: Geometric growth rate of trailing 12-month sales per share over the last 12 quarters (3-year compound annual growth)

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_chg3ycfast
description: Three-year change in assets-adjusted trailing 12-month operating cash flow: current minus 12 quarters ago, scaled by average total assets

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_chg3ycfp
description: Three-year change in price-adjusted trailing 12-month cash flow per share: current minus 12 quarters ago, divided by price

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_chg3yepsast
description: Three-year change in assets-adjusted trailing 12-month EPS (before extra items): current minus 12 quarters ago, scaled by average assets per share

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_chg3yepsp
description: Three-year change in price-adjusted trailing 12-month EPS: current minus 12 quarters ago, divided by month-end trading price

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_chg3yfcfast
description: Three-year change in assets-adjusted trailing 12-month free cash flow: current minus 12 quarters ago, divided by average total assets

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_chg3yfcfp
description: Three-year change in price-adjusted trailing 12-month free cash flow per share: current minus 12 quarters ago, divided by month-end trading price

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_chg3yocfast
description: Three-year change in assets-adjusted trailing 12-month operating cash flow: current minus 12 quarters ago, divided by average total assets

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_chg3yocfp
description: Three-year change in price-adjusted trailing 12-month operating cash flow per share: current minus 12 quarters ago divided by trading price

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_chg6malpha18m
description: Six-month nominal change in 18-month alpha; alpha is the intercept from regressing monthly returns on the S&P 500 over the past 18 months

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_chg6mltg
description: Percent change in mean consensus long-term growth forecast compared to six months ago

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_chgalpha12m
description: Six-month nominal change in 12-month alpha; alpha is the regression intercept of monthly returns versus the S&P 500

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_chgalpha36m
description: Six-month nominal change in 36-month alpha; alpha is the regression intercept of monthly returns versus the S&P 500 over 36 months

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_chgars
description: One-year change in accounts receivable as a percentage of trailing 12-month sales; current minus four quarters ago

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_chgcf
description: One-year change in assets-adjusted trailing 12-month cash flow; current minus four quarters ago scaled by average total assets

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_chgcfp
description: One-year change in price-adjusted trailing 12-month cash flow per share; current minus four quarters ago divided by trading price

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_chgeps
description: One-year change in assets-adjusted trailing 12-month EPS (before extra items); current minus four quarters ago deflated by average assets per share

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_chgepsp
description: One-year change in price-adjusted trailing 12-month EPS; current minus four quarters ago divided by month-end trading price

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_chgfcf
description: One-year change in assets-adjusted trailing 12-month free cash flow; current minus four quarters ago divided by average total assets

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_chgfcfp
description: One-year change in price-adjusted trailing 12-month free cash flow per share; current minus four quarters ago divided by trading price

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_chgis
description: Change in inventory as a percentage of sales over one year; calculated as latest reported inventory/sales minus same ratio from four quarters ago

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_chgnoa
description: Year-over-year change in net operating assets to total assets; net operating assets = short-term debt + long-term debt + preferred equity + common equity - cash

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_chgnpm
description: Change in net profit margin over one year; calculated as latest quarterly net profit margin minus net profit margin from four quarters ago

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_chgocf
description: Change in trailing twelve-month operating cash flow, asset-adjusted, over one year; calculated as the latest TTM operating cash flow minus TTM operating cash flow from four quarters ago, divided by average total assets

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_chgocfp
description: Change in trailing twelve-month operating cash flow per share over one year, divided by trading price

description: Change in operating liability leverage over one year; operating liability leverage = 1 - (short-term debt + long-term debt + common equity + preferred equity - cash) / (total assets - cash); difference between current quarter and four quarters ago

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_chgopm
description: Change in operating profit margin over one year; most recent quarterly operating profit margin minus operating profit margin from four quarters ago

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_chgreccast
description: Percent change in accounts receivable to current assets ratio over one year; most recent quarterly ratio minus ratio from same quarter one year ago

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_chgsgasale
description: Difference between yearly change in quarterly SG&A expenses and yearly change in quarterly sales

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_chgshare
description: Percent change in shares outstanding over one year; current vs. one year ago

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_chgvolpre4y
description: Change in average trading volume over four years; difference in the most recent 6-month moving average of monthly turnover compared to the 12-month moving average four years ago

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_cogsinvt
description: Absolute difference between yearly percent change in trailing twelve-month cost of goods sold and yearly percent change in inventory level

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_covol
description: Sixty-month trading volume trend; slope of regression line of last 60 months' monthly trading volume against time

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_curindbp_
description: Stock's current book-to-price ratio minus industry average, deflated by industry standard deviation

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_curindcfp_
description: Stock’s TTM cash flow-to-price ratio minus industry average, deflated by industry standard deviation

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_curinddivp_
description: Stock’s TTM dividend yield minus industry average, deflated by industry standard deviation

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_curindebitdap_
description: Stock’s TTM EBITDA-to-price ratio minus industry average, deflated by industry standard deviation

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_curindep_
description: Trailing twelve-month EPS-to-price ratio minus industry average, deflated by industry standard deviation

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_curindfcfp_
description: Stock’s TTM free cash flow-to-price ratio minus industry average, deflated by industry standard deviation

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_curindocfp_
description: Stock’s TTM operating cash flow-to-price ratio minus industry average, deflated by industry standard deviation

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_curindocfta_
description: Stock’s TTM operating cash flow-to-total assets ratio minus industry average, deflated by industry standard deviation

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_curindsp_
description: Stock’s TTM sales-to-price ratio minus industry average, deflated by industry standard deviation

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_curratio
description: Current assets divided by current liabilities from most recent quarter; a measure of liquidity

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_cusip_sedol
description: Security identifier, typically CUSIP or SEDOL code used to uniquely identify a stock or financial instrument

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_cvpre90dp
description: Coefficient of variation of prior 90 days closing prices; last 90 days' price standard deviation divided by mean

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_cvvolp20d
description: Ratio of 20-day price volatility to 20-day volume volatility; coefficient of variation of closing prices divided by coefficient of variation of daily trading volume for last 20 days

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_de
description: Long-term debt divided by book equity from most recent quarter

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_debtcf
description: Sum of long-term debt and short-term interest-bearing debt divided by trailing twelve-month cash flow

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_dfl
description: Sum of trailing 12-month pretax income and interest expense divided by trailing 12-month pretax income

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_divcf
description: Trailing 12-month cash dividends divided by trailing 12-month cash flow

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_divcov
description: Dividend Coverage Ratio: Company's trailing twelve-month profit from operations divided by its annual dividend payments

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_divyield
description: TTM Dividend Yield: Trailing twelve-month dividends per share divided by month-end trading price

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_dpcapex
description: Change in TTM Depreciation vs. CapEx: Absolute difference between yearly percent change in depreciation expense and that of capital expenditure over trailing twelve months

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_ebitdaev
description: TTM EBITDA-to-Enterprise Value: Trailing twelve-month earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization divided by enterprise value (EV)

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_ebitdap

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_epschgetr
description: EPS from Change in Effective Tax Rate: Trailing twelve-month pre-tax income per share multiplied by the change in effective tax rate over the last four quarters

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_equityto
description: Equity Turnover Ratio: Trailing twelve-month sales divided by average trailing twelve-month reported book equity

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_fc_curindfwdep_
description: Industry Relative Leading 4-QTRs EPS to Price: Stock's next four quarters' consensus EPS-to-price ratio minus industry average and deflated by industry standard deviation

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_fc_cvfy1eps
description: FY1 EPS Estimates Dispersion: Standard deviation of analyst earnings estimates for fiscal year one divided by mean consensus forecast

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_fc_cvfy2eps
description: FY2 EPS Forecast Dispersion: Standard deviation of analyst earnings estimates for fiscal year two divided by mean consensus forecast

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_fc_dypeg
description: Reciprocal of Dividend Yield-adjusted PEG: Reciprocal of forward twelve-month price/earnings ratio divided by sum of forecasted long-term growth rate and indicated dividend yield

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_fc_ebop
description: Edwards-Bell-Ohlson Value-to-Price: Firm's intrinsic valuation from EBO model divided by month-end trading price, comparing generated earnings to cost of capital

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_fc_egp
description: Inverse PEG Ratio: Next one year average forecasted earnings multiplied by long-term growth rate and scaled by stock price

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_fc_epsrm
description: Street Revision Magnitude: Three-month change in analysts' median forecast for fiscal year one scaled by current mean estimate

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_fc_estep
description: Leading 12-Month Median Earnings Yield: Next fiscal year's median consensus earnings estimate divided by current trading price

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_fc_f12mepssev
description: Forward 12-M EPS-to-Enterprise Value: Consensus forward twelve-month earnings per share forecast divided by sum of market value of equity per share and book value of long-term debt per share

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_fc_fcfp
description: Forward Free Cash Flow-to-Price: Next four quarters' mean consensus earnings estimate plus trailing twelve-month depreciation minus capital expenditures, divided by trading price

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_fc_fcfroey1p
description: Product of TTM FCF Yield and Forward ROE: Trailing twelve-month free cash flow per share times next four quarters' consensus earnings forecast divided by book value per share, scaled by trading price

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_fc_fwdep
description: Leading 12-Month Mean Earnings Yield: Next four quarters' mean consensus earnings estimate divided by trading price

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_fc_fwdroe
description: Forward Return on Equity: Analysts' earnings estimate for next four quarters divided by most recent reported common equity per share

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_fc_hlep
description: Street Revision Confidence: Sum of three-month change in highest and lowest fiscal year one earnings estimates, scaled by month-end trading price

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_fc_numest
description: Number of Analyst Coverage: Count of analysts making earnings estimates for fiscal year one

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_fc_numrevy1
description: Net Number of Revisions for Fiscal Year One: Weighted average of analyst increases minus decreases in FY1 forecasts, divided by total analyst forecasts for the month

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_fc_pdy

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_fc_rel5yfwdep
description: Five-Year Relative Leading 12-M Earnings Yield: Stock's current next four quarters' consensus earnings-to-price ratio minus five-year average, scaled by five-year standard deviation

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_fc_rev3y1
description: Three-Month Revision in FY1 EPS Forecasts: Change in current mean consensus forecast for fiscal year one minus three months ago, deflated by trading price

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_fc_rev3y2
description: Three-Month Revision in FY2 EPS Forecasts: Change in current mean consensus earnings estimate for fiscal year two minus three months ago, deflated by trading price

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_fc_rev6
description: Six-Month Average Revision for FY1 EPS: Average of prior six months' monthly changes in consensus analyst forecasts for fiscal year one, scaled by previous month-end price

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_fc_stdevfy1epsp
description: Std Dev of FY1 EPS Estimates-to-Price: Standard deviation of analyst forecasts for fiscal year one scaled by closing price

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_fc_stdevfy2epsp
description: Std Dev of FY2 EPS Estimates-to-Price: Standard deviation of analyst forecasts for fiscal year two scaled by closing price

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_fc_y2aepsg
description: Forecasted EPS growth for 2 years ahead: most recent consensus earnings estimate for year 2 minus year 1, divided by trading price

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_fcfequity
description: Trailing 12-month free cash flow divided by average book equity over the same period

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_fcfroi
description: Trailing 12-month free cash flow divided by average invested capital (sum of common equity, long-term debt, minority interest, preferred stock) over the same period

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_fcfsale
description: Trailing 12-month free cash flow divided by trailing 12-month sales

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_ff10mrtn
description: Percent change in stock price from 12 months ago to 2 months ago (momentum)

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_fixastto
description: Trailing 12-month sales divided by average total fixed assets for the same period

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_flowratio
description: (Current assets minus cash/equivalents) divided by (current liabilities minus short-term debt), using most recent quarter

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_gear
description: Long-term debt divided by (total assets minus current liabilities)

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_high52w
description: Month-end price divided by highest monthly closing price in the past 12 months

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_indrelcroe_

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_indrelrecd_
description: Stock's asset-adjusted annual doubtful receivables minus industry average, deflated by industry standard deviation

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_indrelrtn4w_
description: Stock’s 4-week return minus industry average 4-week return, deflated by industry standard deviation

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_indrelrtn5d_
description: Stock’s 5-day return minus industry average 5-day return, deflated by industry standard deviation

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_intcov

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_invast

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_invto
description: Trailing 12-month cost of goods sold divided by average inventory in the same period

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_lagegp
description: Trailing 12-month EPS before extraordinary items multiplied by change in yearly sales per share growth rate, divided by trading price

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_liqcoeff
description: Slope of regression between monthly stock trading turnover ratio and monthly stock price returns

name: mdl177_2_globaldevnorthamerica_v502_ltg

name: mdl77_2400_chg12msip
description: 12-Month Change in Short Interest Position: It is defined as the 12-month relative change in short interest position (SIP), where SIP is the number of shares sold short versus total shares outstanding.

name: mdl77_2400_chg12mtotdebt
description: 12-Month Change in Total Debt: It is defined as the 12-month relative change in total debt, where total debt is the sum of long-term and short-term debt.

name: mdl77_2400_chginvavgast
description: Change in Inventory to Average Assets: It is defined as the 12-month change in the quarterly total inventories scaled by the average of assets at the most recent quarter end and 4 quarters prior.

name: mdl77_2400_chgqtrepssurp
description: Change in Real Earnings Surprise: It is defined as the change in quarterly earnings surprise (Actual EPS - Consensus Estimate EPS), scaled by the most recent closing price.

name: mdl77_2400_cpgspea2y
description: 2-Year Ahead EPS Growth Percentage Change: It is defined as a stock's most recent consensus analysts earnings forecast for fiscal year 2 minus the consensus forecast for year 1, divided by the consensus forecast for year 1.

name: mdl77_2400_ctpmto
description: The exponentially weighted put-to-call ratio for out-of-the-money options.

name: mdl77_2400_earnshortfall
description: Earnings Shortfall: It is defined as the difference between reported accounting earnings and free cash flow, scaled by average assets.

name: mdl77_2400_ga
description: Aggregate Gamma: It is defined as the open interest weighted sum of the gamma for all options associated with a stock.

name: mdl77_2400_impvol
description: Implied Volatility: It is defined as the average implied volatility of the nearest-to-expiration at-the-money option contracts.

name: mdl77_2400_irttmsalesev
description: Stock's trailing 12-month sales-to-enterprise (SEV) value less the average of the SEVs of all stocks in the same industry deflated by the standard deviation of the SEVs of all stocks in the same relative universe.

name: mdl77_2400_md
description: Distress Measure: It is defined as the financial distress model employed by Campbell, Hilscher, and Szilagyi (2008) and Chen and Zhang (2009).

name: mdl77_2400_pbroeresidual
description: Price-to-Book Return-on-Equity Combination (PB-ROE): An adjustment to the classic price-to-book model incorporating firm growth, based on a variation of the model developed by Wilcox and Philips (2005).

name: mdl77_2400_rev3my1std
description: The change in a stock's current analysts mean earnings estimate for fiscal year 1 less that of 3 months ago, scaled by the standard deviation of analyst forecasts as of 3 months ago.

name: mdl77_2400_rev3my2std
description: 3-M Revision in FY2 EPS Forecasts: Dispersion Relative: It is defined as the change in a stock's current analysts mean earnings estimate for fiscal year 2 less that of three months ago, scaled by the standard deviation of analyst forecasts as of three months ago.

name: mdl77_2400_rmi
description: Volatility Spread: It is defined as the average implied volatility of the nearest-to-expiration at-the-money option contracts, minus the stock's annualized volatility of the previous 21-day log returns.

name: mdl77_2400_vefcomtt
description: TTM Operating Cash Flow-to-Enterprise Value: It is defined as the trailing 12-month operating cash flow per share for a stock divided by its per share Enterprise Value.

name: mdl77_2400_yen
description: Normalized Earnings Yield: It is defined as the average of three normalized earnings calculated by ROE, NPM, and EPS FY2, scaled by price.

name: mdl77_25rel5ycoreepsp
description: 5-yr Relative TTM Core Earnings-to-Price: It is defined as a stock's current trailing 12-month core earnings-to-price ratio (CoreEP) minus the average of the CoreEPs in the last 60 months scaled by the standard deviation of the CoreEPs over the same period.

name: mdl77_25saleicap
description: The trailing 12-month total revenues divided by the average of the invested capital in the same period.

name: mdl77_25yearrelativevaluefactor_rel5ybp
description: 5-yr Relative Book-to-Market: It is defined as a stock's current book-to-market ratio (BP) minus the average of the BPs in the last 60 months scaled by the standard deviation of the BPs over the same period.

name: mdl77_25yearrelativevaluefactor_rel5ycfp
description: 5-yr Relative TTM Cash Flow-to-Price: It is defined as a stock's current trailing 12-month cash flow-to-price ratio (CFP) minus the average of the CFPs in the last 60 months scaled by the standard deviation of the CFPs over the same period.

name: mdl77_25yearrelativevaluefactor_rel5ydivp
description: 5-yr Relative TTM Dividend Yield: It is defined as a stock's current dividend yield (DivYield) minus the average of the DivYields in the last 60 months scaled by the standard deviation of the DivYields over the same period.

name: mdl77_25yearrelativevaluefactor_rel5yebitdap
description: 5-yr Relative TTM EBITDA-to-Price: It is defined as a stock's current trailing 12-month EBITDA per share-to-price ratio (EBITDAP) minus the average of the EBITDAPs in the last 60 months, scaled by the standard deviation of the EBITDAPs over the same period.

name: mdl77_25yearrelativevaluefactor_rel5yep
description: 5-yr Relative TTM Earnings-to-Price: It is defined as a stock's current trailing 12-month earnings per share before extra items-to-price ratio (EP) minus the average of the EPs in the last 60 months scaled by the standard deviation of the EPs over the same period.

name: mdl77_25yearrelativevaluefactor_rel5yfcfp
description: 5-yr Relative TTM Free Cash Flow-to-Price: It is defined as a stock's current trailing 12-month free cash flow-to-price ratio (FCFP) minus the average of the FCFPs in the last 60 months scaled by the standard deviation of the FCFPs over the same period.

name: mdl77_25yearrelativevaluefactor_rel5yocfp
description: 5-yr Relative TTM Oper Cash Flow-to-Price: It is defined as a stock's current trailing 12-month operating cash flow-to-price ratio (OCFP) minus the average of the OCFPs in the last 60 months scaled by the standard deviation of the OCFPs over the same period.

name: mdl77_25yearrelativevaluefactor_rel5ysp
description: 5-Yr Relative TTM Sales-to-Price: It is defined as a stock's current trailing 12-month sales-to-price ratio (SP) minus the average of the SPs in the last 60 months scaled by the standard deviation of the SPs over the same period.

name: mdl77_2_dvm_composite
description: Score based on a strategy that selects for stocks in a universe of stocks by comparing different financial metrics as a ratio.

name: mdl77_2_htwrgspe_amq
description: Earnings Growth Rank: It is defined as the one-quarter change in a stock's trailing twelve-month earnings per share, scaled by its recent closing stock price (E/P).

name: mdl77_2ad
description: Total Debt to Total Assets: It is defined as the most recently reported total debt divided by total assets.

name: mdl77_2adverint
description: Advertising Intensity: It is defined as a stock's advertising expense in the last fiscal year divided by last fiscal year's sales.

name: mdl77_2am_amv
description: Momentum Analyst II: This model is composed of 40% Price Momentum, 30% Fundamental Growth, 20% Reported Earnings Momentum, 10% Earnings Expectations.

name: mdl77_2amv
description: Score based on the equal-weighted average of the Momentum Analyst and Value Analyst ranks

name: mdl77_2av_amv
description: Value Analyst II: This model is composed of 30% Financial Statement Valuation, 30% Earnings Quality, 20% Earnings Valuation, 10% Investor Sentiment, and 10% Management Signaling.

name: mdl77_2capacq
description: Capital Acquisition Ratio: It is defined as the trailing 12-month operating cash flow less the trailing 12-month cash dividends and then divided by the total expenditures in the same period.

name: mdl77_2capdistp
description: The sum of trailing 1-year dividends for every share and the estimated trailing 1-year stock issued for each share, which is scaled by price.

name: mdl77_2ccacw
description: Working Capital Accruals: It equals to: Increase in Accounts Receivables + Increase in Inventory + Decrease in Accounts Payable and Accrued Liabilities + Decrease in Accrued Income Taxes + Increase (Decrease) in Assets (Liabilities).

name: mdl77_2chgreccast
description: YOY Chg in Acct Receivable to Current Assets: It is defined as the percent change in the most recent quarterly reported accounts receivable to current assets ratio from the ratio for the same quarter one year ago.

name: mdl77_2cusip_sedol
description: Unix modification time of raw file

name: mdl77_2deepvaluefactor_apemtt
description: An indicator that standardizes and compares relative share price between time periods and among companies.

name: mdl77_2deepvaluefactor_bpemtt
description: The company's performance in trailing 1-year before taking into account non-recurring gain or loss. Stock divided by its month-end trading price.

name: mdl77_2deepvaluefactor_cashp
description: Cash-to-Price: It is defined as the most recently reported cash and equivalents per share of a company divided by trading price.

name: mdl77_2deepvaluefactor_cashsev
description: Cash to Enterprise Value: It is defined as the total cash & equivalents divided by the sum of the market value of common equity and book value of long-term debt.

name: mdl77_2deepvaluefactor_coreepsp
description: TTM Core Earnings-to-Price: It is defined as the trailing 12-month earnings per share from operations for a stock deflated by its trading price. This item excludes the cumulative effect of accounting change, discounted operations, extraordinary items, and special items.

name: mdl77_2deepvaluefactor_curep
description: Current Earnings Yield: It is defined as the sum of the most recently reported 3 quarters EPS and analysts' consensus earnings estimate for the current quarter divided by its price.

name: mdl77_2deepvaluefactor_divyield
description: TTM Dividend Yield: It is defined as the trailing 12-month dividends per share for a stock divided by its month-end trading price.

name: mdl77_2deepvaluefactor_ebitdaev
description: TTM EBITDA-to-Enterprise Value: It is defined as the trailing 12-month earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization for a stock deflated by its enterprise value (EV). EV = Equity Market Value + Long-term Debt + Short-term Debt + Preferred Stock + Minority Interest - Cash.

name: mdl77_2deepvaluefactor_ebitdap
description: TTM EBITDA-to-Price: It is defined as the trailing 12-month earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization for a company divided by its month-end trading price.

name: mdl77_2deepvaluefactor_ebop
description: Edwards-Bell-Ohlson Value-to-Price: It is defined as a stock's valuation based on the Edwards-Bell-Ohlson (EBO) model deflated by its trading price. EBO is a modified dividend discount model that measures a firm's intrinsic value by comparing generated earnings to the cost of capital.

name: mdl77_2deepvaluefactor_estep
description: Leading 12-Month Median Earnings Yield: It is defined as the next fiscal year median consensus earnings estimate divided by trading price.

name: mdl77_2deepvaluefactor_indidivy
description: Indicated Dividend Yield: It is defined as the last quarterly dividend declared multiplied by 4, scaled by month-end trading price. The dividend includes extras declared within the last 12 months.

name: mdl77_2deepvaluefactor_lumqca
description: Acquisition Multiple: It is defined as the most recent quarterly reported invested capital divided by the trailing 12-month EBITDA.

name: mdl77_2deepvaluefactor_nnastp
description: Net Current Assets-to-Price: It is defined as the current assets per share minus total liabilities per share divided by the price.

name: mdl77_2deepvaluefactor_past
description: Price-to-Total Assets: It is defined as a stock's month-end trading price divided by the most recent quarterly reported total assets per share.

name: mdl77_2deepvaluefactor_pb
description: Book-to-Market: It is defined as the most recently reported book value per share for a stock deflated by its month-end trading price.

name: mdl77_2deepvaluefactor_pedwf
description: Leading 12-Month Mean Earnings Yield: It is defined as the next 4-quarter's mean consensus earnings estimate divided by the price.

name: mdl77_2deepvaluefactor_pfcf
description: Forward Free Cash Flow-to-Price: It is defined as the next 4-quarter's mean consensus earnings estimate plus trailing 12-month depreciation expense per share minus corresponding capital expenditures, divided by trading price.

name: mdl77_2deepvaluefactor_pfcfmtt
description: TTM Free Cash Flow-to-Price: It is defined as the trailing 12-month free cash flow per share for a stock divided by its month-end trading price. Free cash flow equals operating cash flow minus capital expenditures and cash dividends.

name: mdl77_2deepvaluefactor_pfcmtt
description: TTM Cash Flow-to-Price: It is defined as the trailing 12-month cash flows per share for a stock scaled by its trading price. Cash flow is defined as the reported net income plus depreciation.

name: mdl77_2deepvaluefactor_pfcomtt
description: TTM Operating Cash Flow-to-Price: It is defined as the trailing 12-month operating cash flow per share for a stock divided by its trading price.

name: mdl77_2deepvaluefactor_pfgmtt
description: TTM Growth Flow-to-Price: It is defined as the sum of trailing 12-month growth flow value per share for a stock divided by its month-end trading price. Growth flow is the sum of Research & Development expenses and reported net income.

name: mdl77_2deepvaluefactor_pqipmtt
description: The most recent trailing 12-month operating and nonoperating income per share before provisions for income taxes and minority interest for a stock deflated by its trading price.

name: mdl77_2deepvaluefactor_proformaep
description: TTM Pro Forma Earnings-to-Price: It is defined as the trailing 12-month earnings scaled by the trading price.

name: mdl77_2deepvaluefactor_psmtt
description: TTM Sales-to-Price: It is defined as the most recently reported trailing 12-month sales per share for a stock deflated by its month-end trading price.

name: mdl77_2deepvaluefactor_pvan
description: Net Asset Value to Price: It is defined as the most recent book value of net assets per share (NAV) by the closing price. NAV is calculated in general form by taking the total assets of a company and subtracting the value of the company's intangible assets (goodwill, patents, etc.) minus current and long-term liabilities.

name: mdl77_2deepvaluefactor_ttmcapexp
description: TTM Capital Expenditures-to-Price: It is defined as the trailing 12-month capital expenditures per share for a stock divided by its trading price.

name: mdl77_2deepvaluefactor_ttmsaleev
description: TTM Sales-to-Enterprise Value: It is defined as the trailing 12-month sales for a stock divided by the most recent enterprise value (EV). EV = Equity Market Value + Long-term Debt + Short-term Debt + Preferred Stock + Minority Interest - Cash & Cash Equivalents.

name: mdl77_2deepvaluefactor_vefcfmtt
description: TTM Free Cash Flow-to-Enterprise Value: It is defined as the trailing 12-month free cash flow (FCF) for a stock scaled by its enterprise value (EV). EV = Equity Market Value + Long-term Debt + Short-term Debt + Preferred Stock + Minority Interest - Cash.

name: mdl77_2deepvaluefactor_vesspem21f
description: Forward 12-M EPS-to-Enterprise Value: It is defined as the consensus forward 12-month earnings per share forecast divided by the sum of market value of common equity per share and book value of long-term debt per share.

name: mdl77_2deepvaluefactor_ydp
description: Predicted Dividend Yield: It is defined as an assumed payout ratio multiplied by the next 4-quarter consensus earnings estimate divided by trading price. The payout ratio assumption is 10% + 84% * Payout Ratio in last year - 38% * consensus long-term earnings growth rate.

name: mdl77_2deepvaluemodel_chgshare
description: Percent Change in Shares Outstanding: It is defined as the percent change in a company's current number of outstanding shares as compared to the number of shares outstanding one year ago.

name: mdl77_2deepvaluemodel_indidivy
description: Indicated Dividend Yield: It is defined as the last quarterly dividend declared multiplied by 4, scaled by month-end trading price. The dividend includes extras declared within the last 12 months.

name: mdl77_2deepvaluemodel_vefcfmtt
description: TTM Free Cash Flow-to-Enterprise Value: It is defined as the trailing 12-month free cash flow (FCF) for a stock scaled by its enterprise value (EV). EV = Equity Market Value + Long-term Debt + Short-term Debt + Preferred Stock + Minority Interest - Cash.

name: mdl77_2dv_currroe
description: Current Return On Equity

name: mdl77_2dv_yoychgat
description: YOY Chg in Asset Turnover: Year-over-year Change in Asset Turnover

name: mdl77_2dvm_composite
description: Deep Value Composite: Deep Value Composite Score

name: mdl77_2earningmomentumfactor400_dypeg
description: Reciprocal of Dividend Yield-adjusted PEG: It is defined as the reciprocal of a stock's forward 12-month P/E ratio divided by the total growth rate. The total growth rate is defined as the sum of the forecasted long-term growth rate and the indicated dividend yield.

name: mdl77_2earningmomentumfactor400_fcfroey1p
description: Product of TTM FCF Yield and Forward ROE: It is defined as the trailing 12-month free cash flow per share multiplied by the next 4-quarter consensus earnings forecasts divided by the most recently reported book value per share scaled by its trading price.

name: mdl77_2earningmomentumfactor400_fcus
description: Standardized Unexpected Cash Flow: It is defined as the most recent quarterly operating cash flow minus that of 4 quarters ago, divided by the standard deviation of this difference over the preceding 8 quarters.

name: mdl77_2earningmomentumfactor400_fqsurstd
description: Most Recent Earnings Surprise: It is defined as the most recent quarterly earnings surprise (actual fiscal quarter EPS less the consensus earnings estimate) adjusted by the standard deviation of analyst forecasts.

name: mdl77_2earningmomentumfactor400_fy1epsskew
description: The skewness of the distribution of a series of leading 12-month earnings consensus estimates.

name: mdl77_2earningmomentumfactor400_gspea1q
description: 1-Quarter Ahead EPS Growth: It is defined as a stock's most recent fiscal quarter consensus earnings forecast less the actual quarterly earnings recorded four quarters ago divided by its trading price.

name: mdl77_2earningmomentumfactor400_gspea1y
description: 1-Year Ahead EPS Growth: It is defined as the most recent consensus earnings forecast for the next 4-quarters minus the last 4-quarter's reported earnings, deflated by trading price.

name: mdl77_2earningmomentumfactor400_gspea2y
description: 2-Year Ahead EPS Growth: It is defined as the most recent consensus earnings forecast for fiscal year 2 minus the consensus earnings forecast for fiscal year 1, divided by trading price.

name: mdl77_2earningmomentumfactor400_gtl
description: Long-Term Growth Rate Estimates: It is defined as the consensus long-term growth forecast. It generally represents an expected annual increase in operating earnings over the company's next full business cycle.

name: mdl77_2earningmomentumfactor400_gtlm6ghc
description: 6-M Change in Long-term Growth Estimates: It is defined as the percent change in the most recent mean consensus long-term growth forecast as compared to those of 6 months ago.

name: mdl77_2earningmomentumfactor400_lagegp
description: Lagged Inverse of PEG Ratio: It is defined as the trailing 12-month earnings per share before extraordinary items times the change in yearly trailing 12-month sales per share growth rate, divided by trading price.

name: mdl77_2earningmomentumfactor400_mrspe
description: Street Revision Magnitude: It is defined as the 3-month change in the median FY1 consensus earnings forecast, scaled by the current mean earnings estimate.

name: mdl77_2earningmomentumfactor400_numrevq1
description: Net Number ofRevisions for Fiscal QTR 1: It is defined as the number of fiscal quarter 1 upward earnings forecast revisions less the number lowered within a month, divided by the total number of analyst forecasts.

name: mdl77_2earningmomentumfactor400_numrevy1
description: Net Number ofRevisions for Fiscal Year 1: It is defined as the weighted average of the number of FY1 analyst earnings forecasts raised less the number lowered within a month, divided by the total number of analyst forecasts.

name: mdl77_2earningmomentumfactor400_pelh
description: Street Revision Confidence: It is defined as the sum of the 3-month change in the highest and lowest FY1 earnings estimate, scaled by month-end trading price.

name: mdl77_2earningmomentumfactor400_perg
description: Risk-adjusted PEG Ratio: It is defined as the stock price divided by the leading 12-month consensus earnings forecast, scaled by the average long-term growth rate estimate, and multiplied by the stock's 36-month beta.

name: mdl77_2earningmomentumfactor400_pge
description: Estimates on the next 1-year average earnings scaled by company's prospects on growth and its stock price.

name: mdl77_2earningmomentumfactor400_qepsferr
description: Prior Fiscal Quarter Forecast Error: It is defined as the difference between the actual earnings per share and consensus forecast scaled by the stock's price at the beginning of the quarter.

name: mdl77_2earningmomentumfactor400_ratrev6m
description: Street Rating Revision: It is defined as the 6-month average of the change in the average analyst recommendation tracked by

name: mdl77_2earningmomentumfactor400_rev1q1
description: Revision in Fiscal QTR 1 EPS Forecasts: It is defined as the change in the current consensus earnings forecast for fiscal quarter 1 less the earnings forecast of 1 month ago, deflated by the trading price.

name: mdl77_2earningmomentumfactor400_rev3y1
description: The change in the analysts' projection on company's performance for fiscal year 1 less that of 3 months ago, deflated by its price.

name: mdl77_2earningmomentumfactor400_rev3y2
description: 3-M Revision in FY2 EPS Forecasts: It is defined as the change in the current mean consensus earnings estimate for fiscal year 2 less that of three months ago, deflated by its trading price.

name: mdl77_2earningmomentumfactor400_rev6
description: Averaged Last 6-M EPS Revisions for FY1: It is defined as the average of prior 6-month monthly changes in a stock's consensus analysts' earnings forecasts for fiscal year 1, scaled by previous month-end trading price.

name: mdl77_2earningmomentumfactor400_salesurp
description: Sales Surprise: It is defined as the most recent reported quarterly sales minus consensus sales forecasts, divided by the standard deviation of sales forecasts.

name: mdl77_2earningmomentumfactor400_spe1yfvc
description: FY1 EPS Estimates Dispersion: It is defined as the standard deviation of analyst earnings estimates for fiscal year 1 divided by the mean consensus forecast.

name: mdl77_2earningmomentumfactor400_spe2yfvc
description: FY2 EPS Forecast Dispersion: It is defined as the standard deviation of analyst earnings estimates for fiscal year 2 divided by the mean consensus forecast.

name: mdl77_2earningmomentumfactor400_stdevfy1epsp
description: Std Dev of FY1 EPS Estimates-to-Price: It is defined as the standard deviation of analyst forecasts for fiscal year 1 earnings scaled by closing price.

name: mdl77_2earningmomentumfactor400_stdevfy2epsp
description: Std Dev of FY2 EPS Estimates-to-Price: It is defined as the standard deviation of analyst forecasts for fiscal year 2 earnings scaled by closing price.

name: mdl77_2earningmomentumfactor400_stockrating
description: Street Consensus Rating: It is defined as the consensus recommendation for a company.

name: mdl77_2earningmomentumfactor400_sue
description: Standardized Unexpected Earnings: It is defined as the most recent quarterly earnings per share minus that of 4 quarters ago, divided by the standard deviation of this difference over the preceding 8 quarters.

name: mdl77_2earningmomentumfactor400_surp
description: Real Earnings Surprise: It is defined as the difference between the actual earnings per share and consensus forecasts prior to the announcement date, scaled by price at the end of the quarter.

name: mdl77_2earningmomentumfactor400_y2repsg
description: 2-Year Projected EPS Growth: It is defined as the most recent consensus earnings forecast for fiscal year 2 minus the most recently reported fiscal year earnings, deflated by trading price.

name: mdl77_2earningmomentumfactor400_y3sur
description: Volatility-adj 3-yr Projected EPS Growth: It is defined as the consensus earnings forecast for the current quarter minus the actual quarterly earnings 12 quarters ago, deflated by the standard deviation of the actual quarterly earnings.

name: mdl77_2earningsmomemtummodel_emm_composite
description: Model composition based on earnings momentum

name: mdl77_2earningsmomemtummodel_fc_fcfroey1p
description: Product of TTM FCF Yield and Forward ROE: It is defined as the trailing 12-month free cash flow per share multiplied by the next 4-quarter consensus earnings forecasts divided by the most recently reported book value per share scaled by its trading price.

name: mdl77_2earningsmomemtummodel_fc_fqsurstd
description: Most Recent Quarterly Earnings Surprise: It is defined as a stock's most recent quarterly earnings surprise (actual fiscal quarter EPS less the consensus earnings estimate) adjusted by the standard deviation of its analysts' individual earnings forecasts.

name: mdl77_2earningsmomemtummodel_fc_numrevy1
description: Net Number ofRevisions for Fiscal Year 1: It is defined as the weighted average of the number of FY1 analyst earnings forecasts raised less the number lowered within a month, divided by the total number of analyst forecasts.

name: mdl77_2earningsmomemtummodel_fc_rev3y2
description: 3-M Revision in FY2 EPS Forecasts: It is defined as the change in a stock's current analysts mean earnings estimate for fiscal year 2 less that of 3 months ago deflated by its month-end trading price.

name: mdl77_2earningsmomemtummodel_fc_y2repsg
description: 2-Year Projected EPS Growth: It is defined as a stock's most recent consensus analysts earnings forecast for fiscal year 2 minus the most recent reported fiscal year actual earnings tracked by and then deflated by its month-end trading price.

name: mdl77_2earningsmomemtummodel_gtl
description: Long-Term Growth Rate Estimates: It is defined as the consensus long-term growth forecast. It generally represents an expected annual increase in operating earnings over the company's next full business cycle.

name: mdl77_2earningsmomemtummodel_pge_cf
description: Estimates on the next 1-year average earnings scaled by company's prospects on growth and its stock price.

name: mdl77_2earningsmomemtummodel_spe2yfvc_cf
description: FY2 EPS Forecast Dispersion: It is defined as the standard deviation of analyst earnings estimates for fiscal year 2 divided by the mean consensus forecast.

name: mdl77_2earningsqualityfactor_ccacw
description: Working Capital Accruals: It equals to: Increase in Accounts Receivables + Increase in Inventory + Decrease in Accounts Payable and Accrued Liabilities + Decrease in Accrued Income Taxes + Increase (Decrease) in Assets (Liabilities).

name: mdl77_2earningsqualityfactor_chgsgasale
description: Change in QTR SG&A Expenses vs Sales: It is defined as the difference between the yearly change in quarterly Selling, General and Administrative expenses and the yearly change in quarterly sales.

name: mdl77_2earningsqualityfactor_chgshare
description: Percent Change in Shares Outstanding: It is defined as the percent change in a company's current number of outstanding shares as compared to the number of shares outstanding one year ago.

name: mdl77_2earningsqualityfactor_cogsinvt
description: Change in TTM COGS vs Inventory Level: It is defined as the absolute value of the difference between the yearly percent change in trailing 12-month cost of goods sold and the yearly percent change in inventory level.

name: mdl77_2earningsqualityfactor_cre
description: Earnings Response Coefficient: It is defined as the slope coefficient between market-adjusted returns around the time of corporate earnings announcements and yearly change in quarterly actual earnings per share tracked by.

name: mdl77_2earningsqualityfactor_dpcapex
description: Change in TTM Depreciation vs CapEx: It is defined as the absolute value of the difference between the yearly percent change in trailing 12-month depreciation expense and the yearly percent change in trailing 12-month capital expenditure.

name: mdl77_2earningsqualityfactor_epschgetr
description: EPS from Change in Effective Tax Rate: It is defined as the trailing 12-month pre-tax income per share times the difference between most recent trailing 12-month effective tax rate and that of 4 quarters ago. The effective tax rate is defined as total tax expense divided by pre-tax income.

name: mdl77_2earningsqualityfactor_indrelrecd_
description: Industry-adjusted Doubtful Account Receivables: It is defined as a stock's asset-adjusted annual doubtful receivables minus the average of the receivables of all stocks in the same industry deflated by the standard deviation of these receivables.

name: mdl77_2earningsqualityfactor_lccau
description: Unexpected Change in Accrued Liabilities: It is defined as the difference between the most recent fiscal year's accrued liabilities and the expected accrued liabilities (multiplying the prior year's closing account balance by the growth in the trailing 12-month sales) scaled by the total assets.

name: mdl77_2earningsqualityfactor_opincltd
description: Change in TTM Oper Income vs LT Debt: It is defined as the difference between the yearly percent change in operating income and the yearly percent change in long-term debt.

name: mdl77_2earningsqualityfactor_pau
description: Unexpected Change in Accounts Payable: It is defined as the difference between current accounts payable and the expected level of accounts payable (multiplying the prior year's closing account balance by the growth in costs of goods sold in the trailing 12 months) scaled by the total assets.

name: mdl77_2earningsqualityfactor_pedu
description: Unexpected Change in Depreciation: It is defined as the difference between the trailing 12-month depreciation expenses and the expected level of depreciation expenses (multiplying the prior year's closing account balance by the growth in total fixed assets) scaled by the total assets.

name: mdl77_2earningsqualityfactor_rau
description: Unexpected Change in Accounts Receivable: It is defined as the difference between current accounts receivable and the expected level of accounts receivable (multiplying the prior year's closing account balance by the growth in sales in the trailing 12 months) scaled by the total assets.

name: mdl77_2earningsqualityfactor_saleeps
description: Change in TTM Sales vs. EPS: It is defined as the absolute value of the difference between the yearly percent change in trailing 12-month sales per share and the yearly percent change in trailing 12-month diluted earnings per share before extraordinary items.

name: mdl77_2earningsqualityfactor_salegpm
description: Change in QTR Sales vs Gross Margin: It is defined as the difference between the yearly change in most recent reported quarterly sales and the yearly change in the quarterly gross profit margin.

name: mdl77_2earningsqualityfactor_salerec
description: Change in TTM Sales vs Accounts Receivable: It is defined as the difference between the yearly percent change in trailing 12-month sales and the yearly percent change in accounts receivable.

name: mdl77_2earningsqualityfactor_spefcn
description: Change in TTM EPS vs Oper Cash Flows: It is defined as the absolute value of the difference between the yearly percent change in trailing 12-month operating cash flow per share and the yearly percent change in trailing 12-month diluted EPS before extraordinary items.

name: mdl77_2earningsqualityfactor_ttmaccu
description: Accounting Accruals: It is defined as the difference between the trailing 12-month net income and the trailing 12-month operating cash flow scaled by the beginning total assets.

name: mdl77_2earningsqualityfactor_vniu
description: The difference of inventory between present and expected levels.

name: mdl77_2earningsqualityfactor_yoychgaa
description: Change in Accruals to Assets: It is defined as the trailing 12-month income before extra items less the trailing 12-month operating cash flow, then scaled by the average total assets, then minus the scaled difference for the same quarter one year ago.

name: mdl77_2ee_am_amv
description: The equal-weighted average of the Monthly Net Number of forward earnings yield (1) Estimate Revisions and 3-Month Revision in such Estimates.

name: mdl77_2exdisspi
description: 24-Month Unusual Items to Sales: It is defined as the sum of the absolute value of extraordinary items, discontinued operations, and special items in the prior 8 quarters scaled by the average of trailing 12-month sales in the same period.

name: mdl77_2fc_curindfwdep_
description: Industry Relative Leading 4-QTRs EPS to Price: It is defined as a stock's next 4-quarter's analysts consensus earnings estimates-to-price ratio (FwdEP) less the average of the FwdEPs of all stocks in the same industry deflated by the standard deviation of these FwdEPs

name: mdl77_2fc_dypeg
description: Reciprocal of Dividend Yield-adjusted PEG: It is defined as the reciprocal of a stock's forward 12-month P/E ratio divided by the total growth rate. The total growth rate is the sum of the forecasted long-term growth rate and the indicated dividend yield.

name: mdl77_2fc_ebop
description: Stock's valuation based on a model deflated by its month-end trading price. The model measures a firm's intrinsic value by comparing generated earnings to the cost of capital.

name: mdl77_2fc_fwdroe
description: Forward Return on Equity: It is defined as a stock's analysts earnings estimates for next four quarters divided by its most recent reported common equity per share.

name: mdl77_2fc_numest
description: The number of analysts' earnings estimates for fiscal year 1 for a stock.

name: mdl77_2fc_rel5yfwdep
description: 5-yr Relative Leading 12-Month Earnings Yield: It is defined as a stock's current next 4-quarter's consensus analyst earnings forecasts-to-price ratio (FwdEP) minus the average of the FwdEPs ratio in the last 60 months scaled by the standard deviation of the FwdEPs over the same period.

name: mdl77_2fc_rev3y1
description: The change in the analysts' projection on company's performance for fiscal year 1 less that of 3 months ago, deflated by its price.

name: mdl77_2fc_rev3y2
description: 3-M Revision in FY2 EPS Forecasts: It is defined as the change in the current mean consensus earnings estimate for fiscal year 2 less that of 3 months ago, deflated by its trading price.

name: mdl77_2fc_rev6
description: Averaged Last 6-M EPS Revisions for FY1: It is defined as the average of prior 6-month monthly changes in a stock's consensus analysts earnings forecasts for fiscal year 1, scaled by previous month-end trading price.

name: mdl77_2fc_stdevfy1epsp
description: Std Dev of FY1 EPS Estimates-to-Price: It is defined as the standard deviation of analyst forecasts for fiscal year 1 earnings scaled by closing price.

name: mdl77_2fc_stdevfy2epsp
description: Std Dev of FY2 EPS Estimates-to-Price: It is defined as the standard deviation of analyst forecasts for fiscal year 2 earnings scaled by closing price.

name: mdl77_2fwdroe
description: Forward Return on Equity: It is defined as a stock's analysts earnings estimates for the next 4 quarters divided by its most recent reported common equity per share.

description: Alert Rank: Alert Rank

description: 3M Chg in Valuation: 3M Chg in Valuation

description: Analyst score based on growth and value investing attributes

name: mdl77_2garpanalystmodel_qgp_growthval

name: mdl77_2garpanalystmodel_qgp_relpegy
