name: mdl77_2gdna_6351_rp
description: 15/36 Week Stock Price Ratio: It is defined as the moving average of a stock's prices in the last 15 weeks divided by the moving average of its prices in the last 36 weeks.

name: mdl77_2gdna_actrtn12m
description: 12-Month Active Return with 1-Month Lag: It is defined as the percent change in price for a stock from month t-13 to month t-1.

name: mdl77_2gdna_actrtn18m
description: 18-Month Active Return with 1-Month Lag: It is defined as the percent change in price for a stock from month t-19 to month t-1.

name: mdl77_2gdna_actrtn1m
description: 1-Month Active Return: It is defined as the percent change in price for a stock from month t-1 to month t.

name: mdl77_2gdna_actrtn24m
description: 24-Month Active Return with 1-Month Lag: It is defined as the percent change in price for a stock from month t-25 to month t-1.

name: mdl77_2gdna_actrtn2m
description: 2-Month Active Return: It is defined as the percent change in price for a stock from month t-2 to month t.

name: mdl77_2gdna_actrtn36m
description: 36-Month Active Return with 1-Month Lag: It is defined as the percent change in price for a stock from month t-37 to month t-1.

name: mdl77_2gdna_actrtn3m
description: 3-Month Active Return: It is defined as the percent change in price for a stock from month t-3 to month t.

name: mdl77_2gdna_actrtn60m
description: 60-Month Active Return with 1-Month Lag: It is defined as the percent change in price for a stock from month t-61 to month t-1.

name: mdl77_2gdna_actrtn6m
description: 6-Month Active Return with 1-Month Lag: It is defined as the percent change in price for a stock from month t-7 to month t-1.

name: mdl77_2gdna_actrtn9m
description: 9-Month Active Return with 1-Month Lag: It is defined as a stock's price percent change from month t-10 to month t-1.

name: mdl77_2gdna_ags
description: SG&A Expenses-to-Sales: It is defined as the trailing 12-month selling, general management, and administration expenses divided by the trailing 12-month sales.

name: mdl77_2gdna_alpha60m
description: 60-Month Alpha: It is defined as the intercept of the regression line which best fits a stock's monthly price return against the S&P 500 index monthly return over the last 60-month period.

name: mdl77_2gdna_aoer
description: Retained Earnings-to-Total Assets: It is defined as the reported cumulative retained earnings from the most recent quarter deflated by reported total assets from the most recent quarter.

name: mdl77_2gdna_aor
description: Return on Assets: It is defined as the trailing 12-month income before extra items divided by the average of total assets in the same period.

name: mdl77_2gdna_apemtt
description: An indicator that standardizes and compares relative share price between time periods and among companies.

name: mdl77_2gdna_aspanratio
description: Stock's quarterly operating assets minus its operating liabilities deflated by the lagged total assets.

name: mdl77_2gdna_astcomp
description: Asset Composition: It is defined as the total current assets from the most recent quarter divided by the total assets from the most recent quarter.

name: mdl77_2gdna_astto
description: Assets Turnover Ratio: It is defined as the trailing 12-month sales divided by the most recently reported quarterly assets.

name: mdl77_2gdna_beta
description: 60-Month Beta: It is defined as 0.67 times the 60-month beta plus 0.33. Beta is the covariance between a stock's monthly return and the monthly S&P 500 index return in the prior 60-month period divided by the variance of the monthly S&P 500 index return in the same period.

name: mdl77_2gdna_betasigma
description: Product of Beta and Sigma: It is defined as the product of the adjusted 60-month Beta and 60-month Sigma (standard deviation of monthly price returns).

name: mdl77_2gdna_bmpo
description: Operating Profit Margin: It is defined as the most recently reported quarterly operating income divided by the corresponding quarterly sales.

name: mdl77_2gdna_booklev
description: Book Leverage: It is defined as the most recently reported quarterly total assets divided by the book equity.

name: mdl77_2gdna_bpemtt
description: The company's performance in trailing 1-year before taking into account non-recurring gain or loss, divided by its month-end trading price.

name: mdl77_2gdna_capacq
description: Capital Acquisition Ratio: It is defined as the trailing 12-month operating cash flow less the trailing 12-month cash dividends and then divided by the total expenditures in the same period.

name: mdl77_2gdna_capexast
description: Capital Expenditure-to-Total Assets: It is defined as trailing 12-month capital expenditures divided by the total assets from the most recent quarter.

name: mdl77_2gdna_capexsale
description: TTM Capital Expenditures-to-Sales: It is defined as trailing 12-month capital expenditures divided by trailing 12-month sales.

name: mdl77_2gdna_cashburnrate
description: Cash Burn Rate: It is defined as: -(Cash From Operations + Cash from Investments)/(Cash + Short-term Investments).

name: mdl77_2gdna_cashc
description: Cash Cycle: It is defined as the average inventory days plus the average collection days minus the average payable days.

name: mdl77_2gdna_cashp
description: Cash-to-Price: It is defined as the most recently reported cash and equivalents per share of a company divided by trading price.

name: mdl77_2gdna_cashratio
description: Cash & Equivalents-to-Current Liabilities: It is defined as the most recently reported quarterly cash & equivalents divided by current liabilities.

name: mdl77_2gdna_cashsale
description: The mean value of company's assets in the trailing 1-year divided by the trailing 1-year revenues.

name: mdl77_2gdna_cashsev
description: Cash to Enterprise Value: It is defined as the total cash & equivalents divided by the sum of the market value of common equity and book value of long-term debt.

name: mdl77_2gdna_cfita
description: TTM Cash Flow from Investment to Total Assets: It is defined as the trailing 12-month cash flow from the investing portion of the cash flow statement divided by the last 4 quarters average total assets

name: mdl77_2gdna_cfleverage
description: Cash Flow Leverage: It is defined as the total liabilities divided by the trailing 12-month operating cash flow.

name: mdl77_2gdna_cfroi
description: Cash Flow Return on Invested Capital: It is defined as the trailing 12-month cash flow divided by the average invested capital in the same period. Invested capital equals the sum of common equity, long-term debt, minority interest, and preferred stock.

name: mdl77_2gdna_cg3ysales
description: The geometric growth rate of the trailing 12-month sales per share in the last 12 quarters.

name: mdl77_2gdna_chg3ycfast
description: 3-yr Change in Assets-adj TTM Cash Flow: It is defined as the most recently reported trailing 12-month operating cash flow minus 12 quarters ago comparable trailing 12-month cash flow scaled by the average total assets in the same period.

name: mdl77_2gdna_chg3yepsast
description: 3-yr Change in Assets-adj TTM EPS: It is defined as the trailing 12-month earnings per share before extra items (EPS) minus the EPS 12-quarters ago deflated by the average total assets per share.

name: mdl77_2gdna_chg3yepsp
description: The difference between the trailing 12-month earnings per share and that of 12 quarters ago for a stock divided by its month-end trading price.

name: mdl77_2gdna_chg3yfcfast
description: 3-yr Chg in Assets-adj TTM Free Cash Flow: It is defined as the trailing 12-month free cash flow minus 12 quarters ago trailing 12-month free cash flow divided by the average total assets.

name: mdl77_2gdna_chg3yocfast
description: 3-Yr Change in Assets-Adj TTM Oper Cash Flow: It is defined as the most recently reported trailing 12-month operating cash flow (OCF) minus the OCF 12 quarters ago, deflated by the average total assets.

name: mdl77_2gdna_chg6malpha18m
description: 6-Month Nominal Change in 18-Month Alpha: It is defined as the 6-month change in a stock's 18-month alpha, which equals the intercept from the regression of a stock price's monthly return against the S&P 500 index monthly return over the last 18-month period.

name: mdl77_2gdna_chgalpha12m
description: 6-Month Nominal Change in 12-Month Alpha: It is defined as the 6-month change in a stock's 12-month alpha, which equals the intercept from the regression of a stock price's monthly return against the S&P 500 index monthly return over the last 12-month period.

name: mdl77_2gdna_chgalpha36m
description: 6-Month Nominal Change in 36-Month Alpha: It is defined as the 6-month change in a stock's 36-month alpha, which equals the intercept from the regression of a stock price's monthly return against the S&P 500 index monthly return over the last 36-month period.

name: mdl77_2gdna_chgars
description: 1-yr Chg in Acct Receivable as Percentage ofSales: It is defined as the change between the last reported accounts receivable as a percentage of trailing 12-month sales and that percentage 4 quarters ago.

name: mdl77_2gdna_chgnoa
description: Change in Net Operating Assets: It is defined as the year-over-year change of net operating assets to total assets, where net operating assets equal most recent quarterly short-term debt plus long-term debt + preferred equity plus common equity minus cash.

name: mdl77_2gdna_chgollev
description: Change in Operating Liability Leverage: It is defined as the current quarter operating liability leverage less the operating liability leverage 4 quarters ago, where operating liability leverage equals 1 minus the ratio of (short-term debt + long-term debt + common equity + preferred equity - cash) to (total assets - cash)

name: mdl77_2gdna_chgsgasale
description: Change in QTR SG&A Expenses vs Sales: It is defined as the difference between the yearly change in quarterly Selling, General and Administrative expenses and yearly change in quarterly sales.

name: mdl77_2gdna_chgshare
description: Percent Change in Shares Outstanding: It is defined as the percent change in a company's current number of outstanding shares as compared to the number of shares outstanding 1 year ago.

name: mdl77_2gdna_chgvolpre4y
description: 4-Year Change in the Average Trading Volume: It is defined as the change in the most recent 6-month moving average of monthly turnover ratio (average monthly trading volume/total shares outstanding) as compared to the 12-month moving average of monthly turnover ratio 4 years ago.

name: mdl77_2gdna_cogsinvt
description: Change in TTM COGS vs Inventory Level: It is defined as the absolute value of the difference between the yearly percent change in trailing 12-month cost of goods sold and the yearly percent change in inventory level.

name: mdl77_2gdna_covol
description: 60-Month Trading Volume Trend: It is defined as the slope of the least squares regression line of the last 60 months of monthly trading volume against time.

name: mdl77_2gdna_curindbp_
description: Industry Relative Book-to-Market: It is defined as a stock's current book-to-price ratio (BP) less the average of the BPs of all stocks in the same industry deflated by the standard deviation of the BPs of all stocks in the same relative universe.

name: mdl77_2gdna_curindcfp_
description: Industry Relative TTM Cash Flow-to-Price: It is defined as a stock's trailing 12-month cash flow-to-price ratio (CFP) less the average of the CFPs of all stocks in the same industry deflated by the standard deviation of the CFPs of all stocks in the same relative universe.

name: mdl77_2gdna_curinddivp_
description: Industry Relative TTM Dividend Yield: It is defined as a stock's trailing 12-month dividend yield (DivYield) less the average of the DivYields of all stocks in the same industry deflated by the standard deviation of the DivYields of all stocks in the same relative universe.

name: mdl77_2gdna_curindebitdap_
description: Industry Relative TTM EBITDA-to-Price: It is defined as a stock's trailing 12-month EBITDA-to-price ratio (EBITDAP) less the average of the EBITDAPs of all stocks in the same industry deflated by the standard deviation of the EBITDAPs of all stocks in the same relative universe

name: mdl77_2gdna_curindep_
description: Industry Relative TTM EPS-to-Price: It is defined as a stock's trailing 12-month earnings per share before extra items-to-price ratio (EP) less the average of the EPs of all stocks in the same industry deflated by the standard deviation of these EPs.

name: mdl77_2gdna_curindfcfp_
description: Industry Relative TTM Free Cash Flow-to-Price: It is defined as a stock's trailing 12-month free cash flow-to-price ratio (FCFP) less the average of the FCFPs of all stocks in the same industry, deflated by the standard deviation of the FCFPs of all stocks in the same relative universe.

name: mdl77_2gdna_curindocfp_
description: Industry Relative TTM Oper Cash Flow-to-Price: It is defined as a stock's trailing 12-month operating cash flow-to-price ratio (OCFP) less the average of the OCFPs of all stocks in the same industry deflated by the standard deviation of the OCFPs of all stocks in the same relative universe.

name: mdl77_2gdna_curindocfta_
description: Industry Relative TTM Oper Cash Flow-to-Total Assets: It is defined as a stock's trailing 12-month operating cash flow-to-total assets ratio (OCFTA) less the average of the OCFTA of all stocks in the same industry deflated by the standard deviation of the OCFTAs of all stocks in the same relative universe.

name: mdl77_2gdna_curindsp_
description: Industry Relative TTM Sales-to-Price: It is defined as a stock's trailing 12-month sales-to-price ratio (SP) less the average of the SPs of all stocks in the same industry deflated by the standard deviation of the SPs of all stocks in the same relative universe.

name: mdl77_2gdna_curratio
description: Current Ratio: It is defined as the reported current assets from the most recent quarter divided by the current liabilities from the most recent quarter.

name: mdl77_2gdna_cvvolp20d
description: 20-Day Volume Volatility to Price Volatility: It is defined as the coefficient of variation of the last 20 days of closing prices divided by the coefficient of variation of daily trading volume for the same time period.

name: mdl77_2gdna_cws
description: Working Capital-to-Trailing 12-Month Sales: It is defined as the average of working capital for the trailing 12 months divided by the total sales in the same period. Working capital equals the inventory plus accounts receivable minus accounts payable on the balance sheet.

name: mdl77_2gdna_dcc
description: Current Cash Flow Debt Coverage Ratio: It is defined as the most recently reported quarterly cash flow from operations less the cash dividends divided by the current interest-bearing debt.

name: mdl77_2gdna_debtcf
description: The sum of the most recent reported long-term debt and short-term interest-bearing debt divided by the trailing 12-month cash flow.

name: mdl77_2gdna_divcf
description: Dividends-to-Cash Flow: It is defined as the trailing 12-month cash dividends divided by the trailing 12-month cash flow. Cash dividends represent the total amount of cash dividends paid for both common and preferred stock.

name: mdl77_2gdna_divcov
description: Company's trailing 1-year profits scaled by its annual dividends.

name: mdl77_2gdna_divyield
description: TTM Dividend Yield: It is defined as the trailing 12-month dividends per share for a stock divided by its month-end trading price.

name: mdl77_2gdna_dpcapex
description: Change in TTM Depreciation vs CapEx: It is defined as the absolute value of the difference between the yearly percent change in trailing 12-month depreciation expense and the yearly percent change in trailing 12-month capital expenditure.

name: mdl77_2gdna_ebitdaev
description: TTM EBITDA-to-Enterprise Value: It is defined as the trailing 12-month earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization for a stock deflated by its enterprise value (EV). EV = Equity Market Value + Long-term Debt + Short-term Debt + Preferred Stock + Minority Interest - Cash.

name: mdl77_2gdna_ebitdap
description: TTM EBITDA-to-Price: It is defined as the trailing 12-month earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization for a company divided by its month-end trading price.

name: mdl77_2gdna_ed
description: Long-term Debt-to-Equity: It is defined as the most recently reported total long-term debt divided by total book equity.

name: mdl77_2gdna_epschgetr
description: EPS from Change in Effective Tax Rate: It is defined as the trailing 12-month pre-tax income per share times the difference between the most recent trailing 12-month effective tax rate and that of 4 quarters ago. The effective tax rate is defined as total tax expense divided by pre-tax income.

name: mdl77_2gdna_equityto
description: The trailing 12-month sales divided by the average of trailing 12-month reported book equity.

name: mdl77_2gdna_fc_estep
description: Leading 12-Month Median Earnings Yield: It is defined as the next fiscal year median consensus earnings estimate divided by trading price.

name: mdl77_2gdna_fc_fcfroey1p
description: Product of TTM FCF Yield and Forward ROE: It is defined as the trailing 12-month free cash flow per share multiplied by the next 4-quarter consensus earnings forecasts divided by the most recently reported book value per share scaled by its trading price.

name: mdl77_2gdna_fc_numrevy1
description: Net Number ofRevisions for Fiscal Year 1: It is defined as the weighted average of the number of FY1 analyst earnings forecasts raised less the number lowered within a month, divided by the total number of analyst forecasts.

name: mdl77_2gdna_fcfequity
description: TTM Free Cash Flow to Equity: It is defined as the trailing 12-month free cash flow divided by the average book equity value in the same period.

name: mdl77_2gdna_fcfghc
description: 1-yr Chg in Assets-adj TTM Free Cash Flow: It is defined as the trailing 12-month free cash flow minus 4 quarters ago trailing 12-month free cash flow divided by the average total assets.

name: mdl77_2gdna_fcfroi
description: Free Cash Flow Return on Invested Capital: It is defined as the trailing 12-month free cash flow divided by the average invested capital in the same period. Invested capital equals the sum of common equity, long-term debt, minority interest, and preferred stock.

name: mdl77_2gdna_fcfsale
description: TTM Free Cash Flow-to-TTM Sales: It is defined as the trailing 12-month free cash flow divided by the trailing 12-month sales.

name: mdl77_2gdna_fcghc
description: 1-yr Change in Assets-adj TTM Cash Flow: It is defined as the trailing 12-month cash flow minus comparable trailing 12-month cash flow from 4 quarters ago scaled by the average total assets.

name: mdl77_2gdna_fcoghc
description: 1-yr Chg in Assets-adj TTM Oper Cash Flow: It is defined as the most recently reported trailing 12-month operating cash flow minus 4 quarters ago trailing 12-month operating cash flow divided by the average total assets.

name: mdl77_2gdna_fixastto
description: The trailing 12-month sales divided by the average of the total fixed assets in the same period.

name: mdl77_2gdna_flowratio
description: Flow Ratio: It is defined as the difference between current assets and cash & equivalents divided by the difference between current liabilities and short-term debt. All items are from the most recent quarter.

name: mdl77_2gdna_gear
description: Capital Gearing Ratio: It is defined as the long-term debt divided by the difference between total assets and current liabilities.

name: mdl77_2gdna_gtl
description: Long-Term Growth Rate Estimates: It is defined as the consensus long-term growth forecast. It generally represents an expected annual increase in operating earnings over the company's next full business cycle.

name: mdl77_2gdna_gtlm6ghc
description: 6-M Change in Long-term Growth Estimates: It is defined as the percent change in the most recent mean consensus long-term growth forecast as compared to those of 6 months ago.

name: mdl77_2gdna_high52w
description: 52-Week High: It is defined as the month-end price divided by the highest monthly closing price in the past 12 months.

name: mdl77_2gdna_ica
description: Abnormal Capital Investment: It is defined as the change in a firm's most recent trailing 12-month capital investment intensity compared to the average of its prior 3-year investment intensity.

name: mdl77_2gdna_idb
description: Basic Defensive Interval: It measures how many days that a company can cover its daily operating expenses (cost of goods sold and SG&A) by only using its cash and receivables on its balance sheet.

name: mdl77_2gdna_indrelcroe_
description: Stock's lagged quarterly return on equity (ROE) minus the average of the ROEs of all stocks in the same industry deflated by the standard deviation of these ROEs.

name: mdl77_2gdna_indrelrecd_
description: Industry-adjusted Doubtful Account Receivables: It is defined as a stock's asset-adjusted annual doubtful receivables minus the average of the receivables of all stocks in the same industry deflated by the standard deviation of these receivables.

name: mdl77_2gdna_indrelrtn4w_
description: 4-Week Industry Relative Return: It is defined as a stock's return in the last 4 weeks minus the average of the comparable returns of all stocks in the same industry, deflated by the standard deviation of these returns.

name: mdl77_2gdna_indrelrtn5d_
description: Stock's return in the last 5 days minus the average of the comparable returns of all stocks in the same industry, then deflated by the standard deviation of these returns.

name: mdl77_2gdna_invast
description: The current inventory level deflated by the total assets from the most recent quarter.

name: mdl77_2gdna_iqa
description: Asset Quality Index: It is defined as the year-over-year change of 1 minus the ratio of current assets plus PP&E divided by total assets.

name: mdl77_2gdna_lagegp
description: Lagged Inverse of PEG Ratio: It is defined as the trailing 12-month earnings per share before extraordinary items times the change in yearly trailing 12-month sales per share growth rate, divided by trading price.

name: mdl77_2gdna_lfd
description: The sum of the trailing 12-month pretax income and the trailing 12-month interest expense divided by the trailing 12-month pretax income.

name: mdl77_2gdna_liqcoeff
description: Liquidity Coefficient: It is the slope of the regression between the monthly stock trading turnover ratio (X) and the contemporary monthly stock price returns (Y).

name: mdl77_2gdna_lumqca
description: Acquisition Multiple: It is defined as the most recent quarterly reported invested capital divided by the trailing 12-month EBITDA.

name: mdl77_2gdna_m42rav
description: 24-Month Value at Risk: It is defined as the minimum of a stock's monthly price return in the last 20-month period.

name: mdl77_2gdna_m6dn2ntr
description: Second Preceding 6-month Return: It is defined as the percent change in a stock's price from month t-12 to month t-7.

name: mdl77_2gdna_milliq
description: Stock Illiquidity: It is defined as the monthly average of the daily absolute return to the daily dollar trading volume ratio.

name: mdl77_2gdna_mktcappera
description: Stock's current market cap divided by the number of analysts providing Fiscal Year 1 earnings estimates.

name: mdl77_2gdna_mktlev
description: Stock's total market value plus the most recent reported quarterly book debt, then divided by the market value.

name: mdl77_2gdna_mpn
description: Net Profit Margin: It is defined as the most recently reported quarterly net income after tax divided by the corresponding quarterly sales.

name: mdl77_2gdna_mpnghc
description: 1-Yr Change in Net Profit Margin: It is defined as the most recent quarterly net profit margin (NPM) minus the NPM 4 quarters ago. Net profit margin is net income divided by total sales.

name: mdl77_2gdna_mpoghc
description: 1-yr Change in Operating Profit Margin: It is defined as the most recent quarterly operating profit margin minus that of 4 quarters ago. Operating profit margin is income from operations divided by total sales.

name: mdl77_2gdna_netcashp
description: Net Cash to Equity: It is defined as most recently reported quarterly cash & equivalents less the long-term debt and current debt for a stock divided by its current market value.

name: mdl77_2gdna_netdebt
description: Net Debt Ratio: It is defined as the net debt divided by the sum of the net debt, preferred stock, and common stock, where net debt equals the long-term debt plus short-term debt minus cash & equivalents. All items are from the most recent quarter.

name: mdl77_2gdna_nfaldebt
description: Net Fixed Assets to Long-term Debt: It is defined as the most recent quarterly reported net fixed assets divided by the total long-term debt.

name: mdl77_2gdna_niper
description: Net Income per Employee: It is defined as the income after taxes for the trailing 12-months divided by the number of employees at the end of the last reported fiscal year.

name: mdl77_2gdna_nlassets
description: Natural Logarithm of Total Assets: It is defined as the natural logarithm of the most recent quarterly reported total assets.

name: mdl77_2gdna_nlmktcap
description: Natural Logarithm of Market Capitalization: It is defined as the natural logarithm of the cube of a stock's total market value.

name: mdl77_2gdna_nlprice
description: Natural Logarithm of Closing Price: It is defined as the natural logarithm of the cubic of a stock's unadjusted closing price.

name: mdl77_2gdna_nlsales
description: Natural Logarithm of TTM Sales: It is defined as the natural logarithm of the cubic of a company's trailing 12-month sales.

name: mdl77_2gdna_nlvolcap
description: The natural logarithm of the quotient of the trailing 1-year average of the monthly volume to the trailing 1-year average of monthly market value of outstanding shares.

name: mdl77_2gdna_nnastp
description: Net Current Assets-to-Price: It is defined as the current assets per share minus total liabilities per share divided by the price.

name: mdl77_2gdna_noato
description: Net Operating Asset Turnover: It is defined as trailing-12-month sales divided by the last 4 quarters' average net operating assets, which equals short-term debt + long-term debt + preferred equity + common equity - cash

name: mdl77_2gdna_nopatmargin
description: NOPAT Margin: It is defined as: (Net Income + Interest Expense*(1-Effective Tax Rate))/Net Sales. All items are for trailing 12 months. Effective tax rate equals income taxes for the trailing 12 months divided by the trailing 12 months' income before taxes.

name: mdl77_2gdna_ntrm01ff
description: Fama-French Momentum: It is defined as the percent change in a stock's price from month t-12 to month t-2.

name: mdl77_2gdna_ocfast
description: Operating Cash Flow to Assets: It is defined as the trailing 12-month net cash flow from operations divided by the average total assets.

name: mdl77_2gdna_ocfmargin
description: Operating Cash Flow Profit Margin: It is defined as the trailing 12-month cash flow from operations scaled by the trailing 12-month sales.

name: mdl77_2gdna_ocfratio
description: Operating Cash Flow Ratio: It is defined as a stock's most recently reported quarterly cash flow from operations divided by its current liabilities.

name: mdl77_2gdna_ocfroi
description: Oper Cash Flow Return on Invested Capital: It is defined as the trailing 12-month operating cash flow divided by the average invested capital in the same period. Invested capital equals the sum of common equity, long-term debt, minority interest, and preferred stock.

name: mdl77_2gdna_ollev
description: Operating Liability Leverage: It is defined as 1 minus the ratio of (short-term debt + long-term debt + common equity + preferred equity - cash) to (total assets - cash) in the current quarter.

name: mdl77_2gdna_opincltd
description: Change in TTM Oper Income vs LT Debt: It is defined as the difference between the yearly percent change in operating income and the yearly percent change in long-term debt.

name: mdl77_2gdna_oplev
description: Operating Leverage: It is defined as the percent change in the trailing 12-month operating income from the previous quarter divided by the percent change in trailing 12-month sales from the previous quarter.

name: mdl77_2gdna_otvni
description: Inventory Turnover Ratio: It is defined as the trailing 12-month cost of goods sold divided by the average of inventory in the same period.

name: mdl77_2gdna_p50_00ratio
description: 50-200 Day Stock Price Ratio: It is defined as the moving average of a stock's prices in the last 50 days divided by the moving average of its prices in the last 200 days.

name: mdl77_2gdna_past
description: Price-to-Total Assets: It is defined as a stock's month-end trading price divided by the most recent quarterly reported total assets per share.

name: mdl77_2gdna_pau
description: Unexpected Change in Accounts Payable: It is defined as the difference between current accounts payable and the expected level of accounts payable (multiplying the prior year's closing account balance by the growth in costs of goods sold in the trailing 12-months) scaled by the total assets.

name: mdl77_2gdna_pb
description: Book-to-Market: It is defined as the most recently reported book value per share for a stock deflated by its month-end trading price.

name: mdl77_2gdna_pca
description: Average Collection Period: It is defined as the average of the trailing 12-month reported accounts receivable times 365 and then divided by the trailing 12-month sales.

name: mdl77_2gdna_pctabv260low
description: Price Above Last 260-Day Lowest Trading Price: It is defined as a stock's current closing price divided by its lowest daily low price in the last 260 trading days.

name: mdl77_2gdna_pctchg3ycf
description: The percent change in a stock's most recent trailing 12-month cash flow per share as compared to itself 12 quarters ago.

name: mdl77_2gdna_pctchg3yeps
description: The percent change in a stock's most recent trailing 12-month earnings per share as compared to itself 12 quarters ago.

name: mdl77_2gdna_pctchg3yfcf
description: 3-yr Growth in TTM Free Cash Flow: It is defined as the percent change in a stock's most recent trailing 12-month free cash flow per share (FCF) as compared to its FCF 12 quarters ago.

name: mdl77_2gdna_pctchg3yocf
description: 3-yr Growth in TTM Oper Cash Flow: It is defined as the percent change in a stock's most recent trailing 12-month operating cash flow per share (OCF) as compared to its OCF 12 quarters ago.

name: mdl77_2gdna_pctchgastto
description: 1-yr Change in Asset Turnover Ratio: It is defined as the percent change in the most recent asset turnover ratio as compared to that of 4 quarters ago. Asset turnover ratio is the trailing 12-month sales divided by the average total assets in the same period.

name: mdl77_2gdna_pctchgcf
description: 1-yr Growth in TTM Cash Flow: It is defined as the percent change in a stock's most recent trailing 12-month cash flow per share (CF) as compared to the CF 4 quarters ago.

name: mdl77_2gdna_pctchgeps
description: The percent change in a stock's most recent trailing 12-month earnings per share before extra items as compared to itself 4 quarters ago.

name: mdl77_2gdna_pctchgfcf
description: 1-yr Growth in TTM Free Cash Flow: It is defined as the percent change in a stock's most recent trailing 12-month free cash flow per share (FCF) as compared to the FCF 4 quarters ago.

name: mdl77_2gdna_pctchgocf
description: 1-yr Growth in TTM Oper Cash Flow: It is defined as the percent change of a stock's most recent trailing 12-month operating cash flow per share (OCF) as compared to the OCF 4 quarters ago.

name: mdl77_2gdna_pctchgqtrast
description: 1-Yr Change in Total Assets: It is defined as the growth in the most recent reported quarterly total assets per share as compared to that of 4 quarters ago.

name: mdl77_2gdna_pctchgqtrsales
description: 1-yr Change in Sales: It is defined as the growth in most recent reported quarterly sales per share as compared to 4 quarters ago.

name: mdl77_2gdna_pcurlia
description: Current Liabilities-to-Price: It is defined as a stock's most recently reported quarterly current liabilities per share divided by its closing price.

name: mdl77_2gdna_pd09erpvc
description: CV of Prior 90-Day Closing Prices: It is defined as the standard deviation of a stock's last 90 days closing prices divided by the mean of these prices.

name: mdl77_2gdna_pedu
description: Unexpected Change in Depreciation: It is defined as the difference between the trailing 12-month depreciation expenses and the expected level of depreciation expenses (multiplying the prior year's closing account balance by the growth in total fixed assets) scaled by the total assets.

name: mdl77_2gdna_pedwf_cf
description: Leading 12-Month Mean Earnings Yield: It is defined as the next 4 quarters' mean consensus earnings estimate divided by the price.

name: mdl77_2gdna_perg
description: Risk-adjusted PEG Ratio: It is defined as the stock price divided by the leading 12-month consensus earnings forecast, scaled by the average long-term growth rate estimate, and multiplied by the stock's 36-month beta.

name: mdl77_2gdna_pfcf_cf
description: Forward Free Cash Flow-to-Price: It is defined as the next 4-quarter's mean consensus earnings estimate plus trailing 12-month depreciation expense per share minus corresponding capital expenditures, divided by trading price.

name: mdl77_2gdna_pfcfghc
description: The difference between the trailing 12-month free cash flow per share and that of 4 quarters ago for a stock divided by its trading price.

name: mdl77_2gdna_pfcfmtt
description: TTM Free Cash Flow-to-Price: It is defined as the trailing 12-month free cash flow per share for a stock divided by its month-end trading price. Free cash flow equals operating cash flow minus capital expenditures and cash dividends.

name: mdl77_2gdna_pfcfy3ghc
description: 3-yr Change in Price-adj TTM FCF: It is defined as the difference between the most recently reported trailing 12-month free cash flow per share and that of 12 quarters ago for a stock divided by its month-end trading price.

name: mdl77_2gdna_pfcghc
description: The difference between the trailing 12-month cash flow per share and that of 12 quarters ago for a stock divided by its trading price.

name: mdl77_2gdna_pfcmtt
description: TTM Cash Flow-to-Price: It is defined as the trailing 12-month cash flows per share for a stock scaled by its trading price. Cash flow is defined as the reported net income plus depreciation.

name: mdl77_2gdna_pfcoghc
description: The difference between the most recently reported trailing 12-month operating cash flow per share and that of 4 quarters ago for a stock divided by its trading price.

name: mdl77_2gdna_pfcomtt
description: TTM Operating Cash Flow-to-Price: It is defined as the trailing 12-month operating cash flow per share for a stock divided by its trading price.

name: mdl77_2gdna_pfcoy3ghc
description: The difference between the trailing 12-month operating cash flow per share and that of 12 quarters ago for a stock divided by its trading price.

name: mdl77_2gdna_pfcy3ghc
description: The difference between the trailing 12-month cash flow per share and that of 12 quarters ago comparable trailing 12-month cash flow for a stock divided by its trading price.

name: mdl77_2gdna_pfgmtt
description: TTM Growth Flow-to-Price: It is defined as the sum of trailing 12-month growth flow value per share for a stock divided by its month-end trading price. Growth flow is the sum of Research & Development expenses and reported net income.

name: mdl77_2gdna_pge_cf
description: Estimates on the next 1-year average earnings scaled by company's prospects on growth and its stock price.

name: mdl77_2gdna_pinoa
description: Pretax Return on Net Operating Assets: It is defined as the trailing 12-month operating income after depreciation divided by the average net operating assets.

name: mdl77_2gdna_ppa
description: Average Payable Period: It is defined as the average of the trailing 12-month accounts payable times 365 divided by the trailing 12-month cost of goods sold.

name: mdl77_2gdna_pqipmtt
description: The most recent trailing 12-month operating and nonoperating income per share before provisions for income taxes and minority interest for a stock deflated by its trading price.

name: mdl77_2gdna_psmtt
description: TTM Sales-to-Price: It is defined as the most recently reported trailing 12-month sales per share for a stock deflated by its month-end trading price.

name: mdl77_2gdna_pspeghc
description: The difference between the most recently reported trailing 12-month earnings per share and that of 4 quarters ago for a stock deflated by its month-end trading price.

name: mdl77_2gdna_pvan
description: Net Asset Value to Price: It is defined as the most recent book value of net assets per share (NAV) by the closing price. NAV is calculated in general form by taking the total assets of a company and subtracting the value of the company's intangible assets (goodwill, patents, etc.) minus current and long-term liabilities.

name: mdl77_2gdna_rationalalpha
description: Rational Decay Alpha: It evaluates stocks based on their historical 12-month market (S&P 500) adjusted excess return (the Y intercept from an OLS regression equation) using a proprietary rational decay function

name: mdl77_2gdna_ratrev6m
description: Street Rating Revision: It is defined as the 6-month average of the change in the average analyst recommendation tracked by.

name: mdl77_2gdna_rau
description: Unexpected Change in Accounts Receivable: It is defined as the difference between current accounts receivable and the expected level of accounts receivable (multiplying the prior year's closing account balance by the growth in sales in the trailing 12 months) scaled by the total assets.

name: mdl77_2gdna_rdsale
description: R&D Intensity: It is defined as the average of the research & development expenses in the trailing 12 months deflated by the sum of total sales in the same period.

name: mdl77_2gdna_reinrate
description: Reinvestment Rate: It is defined as the trailing 12-month earnings per share before extra items less the trailing 12-month dividends per share by ex-date divided by the average book equity per share in the same period.

name: mdl77_2gdna_rel5ybp
description: 5-Year Relative Book-to-Market: It is defined as a stock's current book-to-market ratio (BP) minus the average of the BPs in the last 60 months, scaled by the standard deviation of the BPs over the same period.

name: mdl77_2gdna_rel5ycfp
description: 5-yr Relative TTM Cash Flow-to-Price: It is defined as a stock's current trailing 12-month cash flow-to-price ratio (CFP) minus the average of the CFPs in the last 60 months scaled by the standard deviation of the CFPs over the same period.

name: mdl77_2gdna_rel5ydivp
description: 5-yr Relative TTM Dividend Yield: It is defined as a stock's current dividend yield (DivYield) minus the average of the DivYields in the last 60 months scaled by the standard deviation of the DivYields over the same period.

name: mdl77_2gdna_rel5yebitdap
description: 5-yr Relative TTM EBITDA-to-Price: It is defined as a stock's current trailing 12-month EBITDA per share-to-price ratio (EBITDAP) minus the average of the EBITDAPs in the last 60 months scaled by the standard deviation of the EBITDAPs over the same period.

name: mdl77_2gdna_rel5yep
description: 5-yr Relative TTM Earnings-to-Price: It is defined as a stock's current trailing 12-month earnings per share before extra items-to-price ratio (EP) minus the average of the EPs in the last 60 months scaled by the standard deviation of the EPs over the same period.

name: mdl77_2gdna_rel5yfcfp
description: 5-yr Relative TTM Free Cash Flow-to-Price: It is defined as a stock's current trailing 12-month free cash flow-to-price ratio (FCFP) minus the average of the FCFPs in the last 60 months scaled by the standard deviation of the FCFPs over the same period.

name: mdl77_2gdna_rel5yocfp
description: 5-yr Relative TTM Oper Cash Flow-to-Price: It is defined as a stock's current trailing 12-month operating cash flow-to-price ratio (OCFP) minus the average of the OCFPs in the last 60 months scaled by the standard deviation of the OCFPs over the same period.

name: mdl77_2gdna_rel5ysp
description: 5-yr Relative TTM Sales-to-Price: It is defined as a stock's current trailing 12-month sales-to-price ratio (SP) minus the average of the SPs in the last 60 months scaled by the standard deviation of the SPs over the same period.

name: mdl77_2gdna_relpricestrength_
description: Industry-adjusted 12-month Relative Price Strength: It is defined as a stock's 12-month relative price-strength (PS) minus the PSs of all stocks in the same industry deflated by the standard deviation of these PSs.

name: mdl77_2gdna_rerror60m
description: Regression Error of 60-Month CAPM: It is defined as the standard error of the slope of the least squares regression line for a stock's last 60-month monthly returns against the S&P 500 Index returns.

name: mdl77_2gdna_revper
description: Revenue per Employee: It is defined as the trailing 12-month total sales divided by the number of employees at the end of the last reported fiscal year.

name: mdl77_2gdna_roe
description: Return on Equity: It is defined as the trailing 12-month income before extra items divided by the average of common equity in the same period.

name: mdl77_2gdna_roic
description: Return on Invested Capital: It is defined as the trailing 12-month net income and interest expenses divided by the average reported invested capital, which equals the sum of common equity, long-term debt, minority interest and preferred stock.

name: mdl77_2gdna_rq
description: Quick Ratio: It is defined as the current assets less inventories from the most recent quarter divided by the total current liabilities from the most recent quarter.

name: mdl77_2gdna_saleeps
description: Change in TTM Sales vs EPS: It is defined as the absolute value of the difference between the yearly percent change in trailing 12-month sales per share and the yearly percent change in trailing 12-month diluted earnings per share before extraordinary items.

name: mdl77_2gdna_saleg5y
description: 5-yr Sales Growth: It is defined as the difference between the trailing 12-month sales per share (SALE) and the SALE 20 quarters ago and then deflated by the average of the SALEs in the prior 20 quarters.

name: mdl77_2gdna_salegpm
description: Change in QTR Sales vs. Gross Margin: It is defined as the difference between the yearly change in most recent reported quarterly sales and the yearly change in the quarterly gross profit margin.

name: mdl77_2gdna_salerec
description: Change in TTM Sales vs Accounts Receivable: It is defined as the difference between the yearly percent change in trailing 12-month sales and the yearly percent change in accounts receivable.

name: mdl77_2gdna_sighc
description: 1-yr Chg in QTR Inventory as Percentage ofSales: It is defined as the most recently reported inventory as a percentage of trailing 12-month sales minus that percentage 4 quarters ago.

name: mdl77_2gdna_sigma
description: Stock Return Volatility: It is defined as the standard deviation of a stock's monthly returns in the prior 60 months.

name: mdl77_2gdna_skew90cortn
description: Skewness of 90-Day Stock Daily Excess Returns: It is defined as the skewness of the distribution of a stock's daily excess (compared to the S&P 500 index) price returns in the last 90 days. Skewness = 3*(Mean-Median)/Standard Deviation.

name: mdl77_2gdna_skew90drtn
description: Skewness of 90-Day Stock Daily Returns: It is defined as the skewness (measure of lack of symmetry) of the distribution of a stock's daily price returns in the last 90 days. Skewness = 3*(Mean-Median])/Standard Deviation.

name: mdl77_2gdna_slope52wp
description: Slope of 52-Week Price Trend Line: It is defined as the 4-week lagged slope coefficient of the least squares regression line of the last 52-week weekly stock's closing price against the corresponding weekly dates.

name: mdl77_2gdna_slope66wp
description: Slope of 66 Week Price Trend Line: It is defined as the 4-week lagged slope coefficient of the least squares regression line of the last 66-week weekly stock's closing price against the corresponding weekly dates.

name: mdl77_2gdna_spe2yfvc_cf
description: FY2 EPS Forecast Dispersion: It is defined as the standard deviation of analyst earnings estimates for fiscal year 2 divided by the mean consensus forecast.

name: mdl77_2gdna_spefcn
description: Change in TTM EPS vs Oper Cash Flows: It is defined as the absolute value of the difference between the yearly percent change in trailing 12-month operating cash flow per share and the yearly percent change in trailing 12-month diluted EPS before extraordinary items.

name: mdl77_2gdna_speghc
description: 1-yr Change in Assets-adj TTM EPS: It is defined as the trailing 12-month earnings per share before extra items (EPS) minus 4 quarters ago EPS deflated by the average total assets per share.

name: mdl77_2gdna_stockrating
description: Street Consensus Rating: It is defined as the consensus recommendation for a company.

name: mdl77_2gdna_surp
description: Real Earnings Surprise: It is defined as the difference between the actual earnings per share and consensus forecasts prior to the announcement date, scaled by price at the end of the quarter.

name: mdl77_2gdna_susgrowth
description: The maximum growth rate a firm can sustain without having to increase financial leverage.

name: mdl77_2gdna_tobinq
description: Tobin Q: It is defined as the market value of equity (E) plus debt (D) divided by assets (A), or (E + D)/A. D is measured using book values.

name: mdl77_2gdna_totalcov
description: Total Coverage: It equals (Cash Flow from Operations + Interest Paid + Tax Paid)/ (Interest + Principal Paid).

name: mdl77_2gdna_totalsaleg
description: Yearly TTM Total Sales Growth Rate: It is defined as the percent change in a company's trailing 12-month total sales (TOTSALE) as compared to the TOTSALE one year ago.

name: mdl77_2gdna_tstalp
description: 1-Year Price Momentum Indicator: It is defined as: (CORREL*(260-2)^.5)/(1-CORREL^2)^.5. CORREL is the correlation coefficient between the natural logarithm of stock daily closing price and the corresponding daily dates in last 260 days.

name: mdl77_2gdna_ttmaccu
description: Accounting Accruals: It is defined as the difference between the trailing 12-month net income and the trailing 12-month operating cash flow scaled by the beginning total assets.

name: mdl77_2gdna_ttmcapexp
description: TTM Capital Expenditures-to-Price: It is defined as the trailing 12-month capital expenditures per share for a stock divided by its trading price.

name: mdl77_2gdna_ttmsaleev
description: TTM Sales-to-Enterprise Value: It is defined as the trailing 12-month sales for a stock divided by the most recent enterprise value (EV). EV = Equity Market Value + Long-term Debt + Short-term Debt + Preferred Stock + Minority Interest - Cash & Cash Equivalents.

name: mdl77_2gdna_varresirtn
description: 24-Month Residual Return Variance: It is defined as the variance of a stock's monthly residual return in the last 24 months. The monthly residual return equals the stock's monthly return minus the product of the multiplication of a stock's proprietary 60-month Beta by the S&P 500 index monthly return.

name: mdl77_2gdna_vefcfmtt
description: TTM Free Cash Flow-to-Enterprise Value: It is defined as the trailing 12-month free cash flow (FCF) for a stock scaled by its enterprise value (EV). EV = Equity Market Value + Long-term Debt + Short-term Debt + Preferred Stock + Minority Interest - Cash.

name: mdl77_2gdna_vesspem21f_cf
description: Forward 12-M EPS-to-Enterprise Value: It is defined as the consensus forward 12-month earnings per share forecast divided by the sum of market value of common equity per share and book value of long-term debt per share.

name: mdl77_2gdna_visiratio
description: The Visibility Ratio: It equals a stock's most recent daily trading volume divided by the average daily trading volume in the previous 50 trading days.

name: mdl77_2gdna_vnicw
description: Working Capital to Inventory: It is defined as the most recent quarterly reported working capital divided by the inventory. Working capital is the difference between current assets and current liabilities.

name: mdl77_2gdna_vniu
description: The difference of inventory between present and expected levels.

name: mdl77_2gdna_voctni
description: Interest Coverage: It is defined as the most recently reported quarterly operating income before depreciation divided by the quarterly long-term debt interest expenses.

name: mdl77_2gdna_volpre6m
description: The 6-month moving average of average monthly turnover ratio.

name: mdl77_2gdna_volto
description: Trading Turnover Ratio: It is defined as the monthly total trading volume divided by the most recently reported total outstanding shares.

name: mdl77_2gdna_w57w03_rp
description: 30-75 Week Stock Price Ratio: It is defined as the moving average of a stock's prices in the last 30 weeks divided by the moving average of its prices in the last 75 weeks.

name: mdl77_2gdna_w62isr
description: 26-Week Relative Price Strength: It is defined as a stock's most recent weekly closing price divided by its weekly closing price 26 weeks ago.

name: mdl77_2gdna_w93ntr
description: 39-Week Return with 4-week Lag: It is defined as a stock's price change from week t-43 to week t-4.

name: mdl77_2gdna_wcast
description: Working Capital-to-Total Assets: It is defined as the average working capital in the trailing 12 months divided by the average total assets in the same period.

name: mdl77_2gdna_ydp_cf
description: Predicted Dividend Yield: It is defined as an assumed payout ratio multiplied by the next 4-quarter consensus earnings estimate divided by trading price. The payout ratio assumption is 10% + 84% * Payout Ratio in last year - 38% * consensus long-term earnings growth rate.

name: mdl77_2gdna_yoychgaa
description: Change in Accruals to Assets: It is defined as the trailing 12-month income before extra items less the trailing 12-month operating cash flow, then scaled by the average total assets, then minus the scaled difference for the same quarter 1 year ago.

name: mdl77_2gdna_yoychgcr
description: Year-over-year Change in Current Ratio: It is defined as the most recent reported quarterly current ratio and the current ratio for the same quarter one year ago. Current ratio equals current assets divided by current liabilities.

name: mdl77_2gdna_yoychgda
description: Year-over-year Change in Leverage: It is defined as the difference between the most recent reported quarterly total liabilities as a percentage of the reported total assets and the percentage for the same quarter one year ago.

name: mdl77_2gdna_yoychggpm
description: Yearly Change In Gross Profit Margin: It is defined as the most recent quarterly reported gross profit margin minus the margin for the same quarter one year ago. Gross profit margin equals the difference between sales and cost of goods sold then scaled by the sales.

name: mdl77_2gdna_yoychgroa
description: Yearly Change in Return on Assets: It is defined as the most recent trailing 12-month income before extra items as a percentage of total assets minus the percentage for the same quarter one year ago

name: mdl77_2gf_am_amv
description: Fundamental Growth: This submodule is the equal-weighted average of 1-year Growth in TTM EPS, the 1-year Change in Asset-Adjusted TTM FCF, and the 3-year Change in Asset-adjusted TTM FCF.

name: mdl77_2globaldevnorthamericasensitivityfactor_apsales
description: Asia-Pacific Sales Exposure: It is defined as the annual aggregate sales for Asia-Pacific as reported by the company divided by total annual sales

name: mdl77_2globaldevnorthamericasensitivityfactor_ceroe
description: The trailing 12-month funds from operations divided by the average of the current and previous year.

name: mdl77_2globaldevnorthamericasensitivityfactor_dsu
description: The beta coefficient estimated by a multiple regression of returns on several macroeconomic aspects over 60 months.

name: mdl77_2globaldevnorthamericasensitivityfactor_emeasales
description: EMEA Sales Exposure: It is defined as the annual aggregate sales for EMEA as reported by the company divided by total annual sales.

name: mdl77_2globaldevnorthamericasensitivityfactor_inflation
description: The beta coefficient estimated by a multiple regression of returns on several macroeconomic aspects over 60 months.

name: mdl77_2globaldevnorthamericasensitivityfactor_lasales
description: Latin America Sales Exposure: It is defined as the annual aggregate sales for Latin America as reported by the company divided by total annual sales.

name: mdl77_2globaldevnorthamericasensitivityfactor_nasales
description: North America Sales Exposure: It is defined as the annual aggregate sales for North America as reported by the company divided by total annual sales

name: mdl77_2globaldevnorthamericasensitivityfactor_oilprice
description: The beta coefficient estimated by a multiple regression of returns on several macroeconomic aspects over 60 months.

name: mdl77_2globaldevnorthamericasensitivityfactor_pi
description: Industrial Production Sensitivity: It is defined as the beta coefficient to Change in Industrial Production, which is estimated by a 60-month multiple regression of returns on several macroeconomic factors.

name: mdl77_2globaldevnorthamericasensitivityfactor_prc
description: Credit Risk Premium Sensitivity: It is defined as the beta coefficient to Change in Credit Risk Premium, which is estimated by a 60-month multiple regression of returns on several macroeconomic factors.

name: mdl77_2globaldevnorthamericasensitivityfactor_sh
description: Housing Starts Sensitivity: It is defined as the beta coefficient to Change in Housing Starts, which is estimated by a 60-month multiple regression of returns on several macroeconomic factors.

name: mdl77_2globaldevnorthamericasensitivityfactor_xiv
description: Market Volatility Sensitivity: It is defined as the beta coefficient to Change in Market Volatility, which is estimated by a 60-month multiple regression of returns on several macroeconomic factors.

name: mdl77_2globaldevnorthamericasensitivityfactor_yieldsprd
description: Yield Curve Slope Sensitivity: It is defined as the beta coefficient to Change in Slope of Term Structure, which is estimated by a 60-month multiple regression of returns on several macroeconomic factors.

name: mdl77_2gpm_composite
description: GARP Model Composite: GARP Model Composite

name: mdl77_2growthanalystmodel2_qga_ltepssurprise
description: Long Term EPS Surprise: Long Term EPS Surprise
