description: Growth Analyst Composite

name: mdl77_2growthanalystmodel_qga_epscapex
description: EPS Growth to CapEx Link

name: mdl77_2growthanalystmodel_qga_epstrend
description: EPS Trend

name: mdl77_2growthanalystmodel_qga_fcfroe
description: Free Cash Flow ROE

name: mdl77_2growthanalystmodel_qga_iarsales
description: Inv Acc Rec to Sales Link

name: mdl77_2growthanalystmodel_qga_niroe
description: Net Income ROE

name: mdl77_2growthanalystmodel_qga_opmarginsales
description: Op Margin to Sales Link

name: mdl77_2gspea2y_cf
description: 2-Year Ahead EPS Growth: It is defined as the most recent consensus earnings forecast for fiscal year 2 minus the consensus earnings forecast for fiscal year 1, divided by trading price.

name: mdl77_2historicalgrowthfactor_chg3ycfast
description: 3-yr Change in Assets-adj TTM Cash Flow: It is defined as the most recently reported trailing 12-month operating cash flow minus 12 quarters ago comparable trailing 12-month cash flow scaled by the average total assets in the same period.

name: mdl77_2historicalgrowthfactor_chg3yepsast
description: 3-yr Change in Assets-adj TTM EPS: It is defined as the trailing 12-month earnings per share before extra items (EPS) minus the EPS 12-quarters ago, deflated by the average total assets per share.

name: mdl77_2historicalgrowthfactor_chg3yepsp
description: The difference between the trailing 12-month earnings per share and that of 12-quarters ago for a stock divided by its month-end trading price.

name: mdl77_2historicalgrowthfactor_chg3yfcfast
description: 3-Yr Chg in Assets-Adj TTM Free Cash Flow: It is defined as the trailing 12-month free cash flow minus 12 quarters ago trailing 12-month free cash flow divided by the average total assets.

name: mdl77_2historicalgrowthfactor_chg3yocfast
description: 3-yr Change in Assets-adj TTM Oper Cash Flow: It is defined as the most recently reported trailing 12-month operating cash flow (OCF) minus the OCF 12 quarters ago deflated by the average total assets.

name: mdl77_2historicalgrowthfactor_chgars
description: 1-yr Chg in Acct Receivable as Percentage ofSales: It is defined as the change between the last reported accounts receivable as a percentage of trailing 12-month sales and that percentage 4 quarters ago.

name: mdl77_2historicalgrowthfactor_cv4qsales3y
description: The standard deviation of prior 12 quarters' trailing 12-month sales for individual shares scaled to the mean of itself in the same period.

name: mdl77_2historicalgrowthfactor_cvopinc
description: CV of Oper Income per Share in Last 12 QTRs: It is defined as the standard deviation of the trailing 12-month operating income per share (OPINC) in the prior 12 quarters divided by the mean of the OPINCs in the same period.

name: mdl77_2historicalgrowthfactor_div5yg
description: 5-Year Dividend Growth Rate: It is defined as the 5-year growth in dividends.

name: mdl77_2historicalgrowthfactor_fcfequity
description: TTM Free Cash Flow to Equity: It is defined as the trailing 12-month free cash flow divided by the average book equity value in the same period.

name: mdl77_2historicalgrowthfactor_fcfghc
description: 1-yr Chg in Assets-adj TTM Free Cash Flow: It is defined as the trailing 12-month free cash flow minus 4 quarters ago trailing 12-month free cash flow divided by the average total assets.

name: mdl77_2historicalgrowthfactor_fcghc
description: 1-yr Change in Assets-adj TTM Cash Flow: It is defined as the trailing 12-month cash flow minus comparable trailing 12-month cash flow from 4 quarters ago scaled by the average total assets.

name: mdl77_2historicalgrowthfactor_fcoghc
description: 1-yr Chg in Assets-adj TTM Oper Cash Flow: It is defined as the most recently reported trailing 12-month operating cash flow minus 4 quarters ago trailing 12-month operating cash flow divided by the average total assets.

name: mdl77_2historicalgrowthfactor_mpnghc
description: 1-Yr Change in Net Profit Margin: It is defined as the most recent quarterly net profit margin (NPM) minus the NPM 4 quarters ago. Net profit margin is net income divided by total sales.

name: mdl77_2historicalgrowthfactor_mpoghc
description: 1-yr Change in Operating Profit Margin: It is defined as the most recent quarterly operating profit margin minus that of 4 quarters ago. Operating profit margin is income from operations divided by total sales.

name: mdl77_2historicalgrowthfactor_pctchg3ycf
description: The percent change in a stock's most recent trailing 12-month cash flow per share as compared to itself 12 quarters ago.

name: mdl77_2historicalgrowthfactor_pctchg3yeps
description: The percent change in a stock's most recent trailing 12-month earnings per share as compared to itself 12 quarters ago.

name: mdl77_2historicalgrowthfactor_pctchg3yfcf
description: 3-yr Growth in TTM Free Cash Flow: It is defined as the percent change in a stock's most recent trailing 12-month free cash flow per share (FCF) as compared to its FCF 12 quarters ago.

name: mdl77_2historicalgrowthfactor_pctchg3yocf
description: 3-yr Growth in TTM Oper Cash Flow: It is defined as the percent change in a stock's most recent trailing 12-month operating cash flow per share (OCF) as compared to its OCF 12 quarters ago.

name: mdl77_2historicalgrowthfactor_pctchgastto
description: 1-Yr Change in Asset Turnover Ratio: It is defined as the percent change in the most recent asset turnover ratio as compared to that of 4 quarters ago. Asset turnover ratio is the trailing 12-month sales divided by the average total assets in the same period.

name: mdl77_2historicalgrowthfactor_pctchgcf
description: 1-yr Growth in TTM Cash Flow: It is defined as the percent change in a stock's most recent trailing 12-month cash flow per share (CF) as compared to the CF 4 quarters ago.

name: mdl77_2historicalgrowthfactor_pctchgeps
description: The percent change in a stock's most recent trailing 12-month earnings per share before extra items as compared to itself 4 quarters ago.

name: mdl77_2historicalgrowthfactor_pctchgfcf
description: 1-yr Growth in TTM Free Cash Flow: It is defined as the percent change in a stock's most recent trailing 12-month free cash flow per share (FCF) as compared to the FCF 4 quarters ago.

name: mdl77_2historicalgrowthfactor_pctchgocf
description: 1-Year Growth in TTM Operating Cash Flow: It is defined as the percent change of a stock's most recent trailing 12-month operating cash flow per share (OCF) as compared to the OCF 4 quarters ago.

name: mdl77_2historicalgrowthfactor_pctchgqtrast
description: 1-yr Change in Total Assets: It is defined as the growth in the most recent reported quarterly total assets per share as compared to that of four quarters ago.

name: mdl77_2historicalgrowthfactor_pctchgqtrsales
description: 1-yr Change in Sales: It is defined as the growth in most recent reported quarterly sales per share as compared to 4 quarters ago.

name: mdl77_2historicalgrowthfactor_pfcfghc
description: The difference between the trailing 12-month free cash flow per share and that of 4 quarters ago for a stock divided by its trading price.

name: mdl77_2liquidityriskfactor_covol
description: 60-Month Trading Volume Trend: It is defined as the slope of the least squares regression line of the last 60 months of monthly trading volume against time.

name: mdl77_2liquidityriskfactor_curratio
description: Current Ratio: It is defined as the reported current assets from the most recent quarter divided by the current liabilities from the most recent quarter.

name: mdl77_2liquidityriskfactor_cvvolp20d
description: 20-Day Volume Volatility to Price Volatility: It is defined as the coefficient of variation of the last 20 days of closing prices divided by the coefficient of variation of daily trading volume for the same time period.

name: mdl77_2liquidityriskfactor_dcc
description: Current Cash Flow Debt Coverage Ratio: It is defined as the most recently reported quarterly cash flow from operations less the cash dividends divided by the current interest-bearing debt

name: mdl77_2liquidityriskfactor_debtcf
description: The sum of the most recent reported long-term debt and short-term interest-bearing debt divided by the trailing 12-month cash flow.

name: mdl77_2liquidityriskfactor_divcov
description: Company's trailing 1-year profits scaled by its annual dividends.

name: mdl77_2liquidityriskfactor_ed
description: Long-term Debt-to-Equity: It is defined as the most recently reported total long-term debt divided by total book equity.

name: mdl77_2liquidityriskfactor_flowratio
description: Flow Ratio: It is defined as the difference between current assets and cash & equivalents divided by the difference between current liabilities and short-term debt. All items are from the most recent quarter.

name: mdl77_2liquidityriskfactor_gear
description: Capital Gearing Ratio: It is defined as the long-term debt divided by the difference between total assets and current liability.

name: mdl77_2liquidityriskfactor_growdura
description: Growth Duration: It is defined as the natural log of the ratio of a stock's leading 12-month PE to the leading 12-month PE of the market divided by the natural log of the ratio of 1 plus the stock's total growth rate, defined as the long-term growth rate plus indicated annual dividend yield, to the total growth rate of the market, defined similarly. The factor is ranked in ascending order.

name: mdl77_2liquidityriskfactor_idb
description: Basic Defensive Interval: It measures how many days that a company can cover its daily operating expenses (cost of goods sold and SG&A) by only using its cash and receivables on its balance sheet.

name: mdl77_2liquidityriskfactor_impduration
description: Implied Equity Duration: It is an equity risk measure based on Macaulay's traditional measure of bond duration. It combines book value, expected growth, expected profitability, and current stock trading price.

name: mdl77_2liquidityriskfactor_iqa
description: Asset Quality Index: It is defined as the year-over-year change of 1 minus the ratio of current assets plus PP&E divided by total assets

name: mdl77_2liquidityriskfactor_lfd
description: The sum of the trailing 12-month pretax income and the trailing 12-month interest expense divided by the trailing 12-month pretax income.

name: mdl77_2liquidityriskfactor_liqcoeff
description: Liquidity Coefficient: It is the slope of the regression between the monthly stock trading turnover ratio (X) and the contemporary monthly stock price returns (Y).

name: mdl77_2liquidityriskfactor_mad3yttmni
description: 3-Year MAD of TTM Net Income: It is defined as the mean absolute deviation of the last 12 quarters' trailing 12-month net income, deflated by the average of total assets.

name: mdl77_2liquidityriskfactor_mad3yttmsale
description: 3-yr MAD of TTM Sales: It is defined as the mean absolute deviation of 12-quarter trailing 12-month sales deflated by the average of total assets.

name: mdl77_2liquidityriskfactor_milliq
description: Stock Illiquidity: It is defined as the monthly average of the daily absolute return to the daily dollar trading volume ratio.

name: mdl77_2liquidityriskfactor_mktcappera
description: Stock's current market cap divided by the number of analysts providing Fiscal Year 1 earnings estimates.

name: mdl77_2liquidityriskfactor_mktlev
description: Stock's total market value plus the most recent reported quarterly book debt, then divided by the market value.

name: mdl77_2liquidityriskfactor_monchgsip
description: Monthly Change in Short Interest Position: It is defined as the month-to-month change of the ratio of shares sold short divided by common shares outstanding.

name: mdl77_2liquidityriskfactor_netcashp
description: Net Cash to Equity: It is defined as most recently reported quarterly cash & equivalents less the long-term debt and current debt for a stock divided by its current market value.

name: mdl77_2liquidityriskfactor_nfaldebt
description: Net Fixed Assets to Long-term Debt: It is defined as the most recent quarterly reported net fixed assets divided by the total long-term debt.

name: mdl77_2liquidityriskfactor_nlassets
description: Natural Logarithm of Total Assets: It is defined as the natural logarithm of the most recent quarterly reported total assets.

name: mdl77_2liquidityriskfactor_nlmktcap
description: Natural Logarithm of Market Capitalization: It is defined as the natural logarithm of the cubic of a stock's total market value.

name: mdl77_2liquidityriskfactor_nlprice
description: Natural Logarithm of Closing Price: It is defined as the natural logarithm of the cubic of a stock's unadjusted closing price.

name: mdl77_2liquidityriskfactor_nlsales
description: Natural Logarithm of TTM Sales: It is defined as the natural logarithm of the cubic of a company's trailing 12-month sales.

name: mdl77_2liquidityriskfactor_nlvolcap
description: The natural logarithm of the quotient of the trailing 1-year average of the monthly volume to the trailing 1-year average of monthly market value of outstanding shares.

name: mdl77_2liquidityriskfactor_numest
description: The number of analysts' earnings estimates for fiscal year 1 for a stock.

name: mdl77_2liquidityriskfactor_ocfratio
description: Operating Cash Flow Ratio: It is defined as a stock's most recently reported quarterly cash flow from operations divided by its current liabilities.

name: mdl77_2liquidityriskfactor_ohlsonscore
description: Ohlson Bankruptcy Score: It is a model assessing a company's probability of bankruptcy by considering firm size, capital structure, financial performance, and liquidity. It is derived from Ohlson (1980).

name: mdl77_2liquidityriskfactor_oplev
description: Operating Leverage: It is defined as the percent change in the trailing 12-month operating income from the previous quarter divided by the percent change in trailing 12-month sales from the previous quarter.

name: mdl77_2liquidityriskfactor_pcurlia
description: Current Liabilities-to-Price: It is defined as a stock's most recently reported quarterly current liabilities per share divided by its closing price.

name: mdl77_2liquidityriskfactor_rerror60m
description: Regression Error of 60-Month CAPM: It is defined as the standard error of the slope of the least squares regression line for a stock's last 60-month monthly returns against the S&P 500 Index returns.

name: mdl77_2liquidityriskfactor_rq
description: Quick Ratio: It is defined as the current assets less inventories from most recent quarter divided by the total current liabilities from most recent quarter.

name: mdl77_2liquidityriskfactor_si_ratio
description: Short Interest Ratio: It is defined as the number of shares sold short divided by the average daily trading volume of the stock over the last 30 trading days.

name: mdl77_2liquidityriskfactor_sigma
description: Stock Return Volatility: It is defined as the standard deviation of a stock's monthly returns in the prior 60 months.

name: mdl77_2liquidityriskfactor_sip
description: Short Interest Position: It is defined as the number of shares sold short divided by common shares outstanding.

name: mdl77_2liquidityriskfactor_tobinq
description: Tobin q: It is defined as the market value of equity (E) plus debt (D) divided by assets (A), or (E + D)/A. D is measured using book values.

name: mdl77_2liquidityriskfactor_totalcov
description: Total Coverage: It equals (Cash Flow from Operations + Interest Paid + Tax Paid) / (Interest + Principal Paid).

name: mdl77_2liquidityriskfactor_voctni
description: Interest Coverage: It is defined as the most recently reported quarterly operating income before depreciation divided by the quarterly long-term debt interest expenses.

name: mdl77_2liquidityriskfactor_voldiff_pc
description: ATM Put Volatility - ATM Call Volatility: It is defined as the difference between the time-weighted average implied volatility of the 2 nearest to expiration at-the-money put options and 2 nearest to expiration at-the-money call options.

name: mdl77_2liquidityriskfactor_volto
description: Trading Turnover Ratio: It is defined as the monthly total trading volume divided by the most recently reported total outstanding shares.

name: mdl77_2liquidityriskfactor_yoychgcr
description: Year-over-year Change in Current Ratio: It is defined as the most recent reported quarterly current ratio and the current ratio for the same quarter one year ago. Current ratio equals current assets divided by current liabilities.

name: mdl77_2liquidityriskfactor_yoychgda
description: Year-over-year Change in Leverage: It is defined as the difference between the most recent reported quarterly total liabilities as a percentage of the reported total assets and the percentage for the same quarter one year ago.

name: mdl77_2me_am_amv
description: Reported Earnings Momentum: This submodule is 50% Standardized Unexpected Cash Flow, 25% Real Earnings Surprise, and 25% Change in Real Earnings Surprise.

name: mdl77_2min1ygrossmargin
description: 1-Year Trough Gross Margin: It is defined as the 1-year minimum value of a stock's quarterly gross profit margin.

name: mdl77_2min1yopmargin
description: 1-Year Trough Operating Margin: It is defined as the 1-year minimum value of a stock's quarterly operating profit margin.

name: mdl77_2min2ygrossmargin
description: 2-Year Trough Gross Margin: It is defined as the 2-year minimum value of a stock's quarterly gross profit margin.

name: mdl77_2min2yopmargin
description: 2-Year Trough Operating Margin: It is defined as the 2-year minimum value of a stock's quarterly operating profit margin.

name: mdl77_2min3ygrossmargin
description: 3-Year Trough Gross Margin: It is defined as the 3-year minimum value of a stock's quarterly gross profit margin.

name: mdl77_2min3yopmargin
description: 3-Year Trough Operating Margin: It is defined as the 3-year minimum value of a stock's quarterly operating profit margin.

name: mdl77_2momemtumanalystmodel_ghcfcfmtt_amq
description: Change in TTM Free Cash Flow Rank: It is defined as the 2Q change in a stock's trailing twelve-month free cash flow, divided by the absolute value of a stock's trailing twelve-month free cash flow from two quarters ago.

name: mdl77_2momemtumanalystmodel_htwrgspe_amq
description: Earnings Growth Rank: It is defined as the one-quarter change in a stock's trailing twelve-month earnings per share, scaled by its recent closing stock price (E/P).

name: mdl77_2momemtumanalystmodel_jdaksr_amq
description: Risk Adjustments Rank: It is defined as the aggregation of five non-linear price and trading volume volatility and growth subfactors. This factor penalizes a stock with extremely high (or low) volume volatility, high standard deviation of monthly returns, and large intraday price high/low spreads, among other ideas.

name: mdl77_2momemtumanalystmodel_qma_alpha6m
description: Six-Month Alpha Change Rank: It is defined as the 6-month change in a stock's 12-month alpha, as calculated by a rolling CAPM regression.

name: mdl77_2momemtumanalystmodel_qma_chgnowc
description: Change in Net Working Capital Rank: It is defined as the one-quarter change in a stock's recent net current working capital divided by total net operating assets from one quarter ago.

name: mdl77_2momemtumanalystmodel_qma_composite
description: The composite of the Earnings Momentum Rank, the Analyst Expectations Rank, the Earnings-Price Link Rank, and the Relative Price Momentum Rank factors.

name: mdl77_2momemtumanalystmodel_qma_condsurp
description: Conditional Surprise Rank: It is defined as the average of a stock's recent earnings surprise, its cost of goods sold efficiency relative to its value categorization, and its sales growth strength relative to its growth categorization.

name: mdl77_2momemtumanalystmodel_qma_earnexp
description: Analyst Expectations Rank: It is defined as the equal weighted average of the Earnings Revisions and the Ratings Change Ranks.

name: mdl77_2momemtumanalystmodel_qma_eplinkage
description: The equal-weighted average of the Change in Free Cash Flow Rank, the Industry Relative 3-Month Return Rank, the Market Earnings Response Rank, and the Change in Net Working Capital Rank.

name: mdl77_2momemtumanalystmodel_qma_estrev
description: Estimate Revisions Rank: It is defined as the difference between the number of recent upward and downward revisions to both fiscal 1 year (FY1) and fiscal 2 year (FY2) EPS estimates over the past 4 weeks, scaled respectively by the total number of FY1 and FY2 estimates.

name: mdl77_2momemtumanalystmodel_qma_indrelrtn3m
description: The difference of a company's 3-month profit compared to its respective industry classification.

name: mdl77_2momemtumanalystmodel_qma_lagpricemo
description: Lagged 12- to 1-Month Price MomRank: It is defined as the difference between a stock's lagged 12-month return and its recent 1-month return, scaled by the standard deviation of the 1-month return over the past year.

name: mdl77_2momemtumanalystmodel_qma_mktresponse
description: Market Earnings Response Rank: It is defined as the 4-day return for a stock, spanning the 2 days before to the day after its recent quarterly earnings report

name: mdl77_2momemtumanalystmodel_qma_ratingchg
description: The trend in sell-side analysts' consensus ratings (standardized 1 = strong buy to 5 = strong sell) revisions over the last 4 and 8 weeks, respectively.

name: mdl77_2momemtumanalystmodel_qma_relpricemo
description: Relative Price Momentum Rank: It is defined as the equal-weighted average of the Lagged 12- to 1-Month Price Momentum Rank, the Risk Adjustments Rank, and the 6-Month Alpha Change Rank.

name: mdl77_2momemtumanalystmodel_qma_repearnmom
description: Earnings Momentum Rank: It is defined as the equal-weighted average of the Earnings Growth and Earnings Surprise Rankings.

name: mdl77_2mp_am_amv
description: Price Momentum: This submodule is 30% 5-day Industry Relative Return, 30% Industry-adjusted 12-month Relative Price Strength, 20% 6-Month Nominal Change in 12-month Alpha, and 20% Bollinger Bands Indicator.

name: mdl77_2mqf_ags
description: SG&A Expenses-to-Sales: It is defined as the trailing 12-month selling, general management, and administration expenses divided by the trailing 12-month sales.

name: mdl77_2mqf_aoer
description: Retained Earnings-to-Total Assets: It is defined as the reported cumulative retained earnings from the most recent quarter deflated by reported total assets from the most recent quarter.

name: mdl77_2mqf_aor
description: Return on Assets: It is defined as the trailing 12-month income before extra items divided by the average of total assets in the same period.

name: mdl77_2mqf_aspanratio
description: Stock's quarterly operating assets minus its operating liabilities deflated by the lagged total assets.

name: mdl77_2mqf_astto
description: Assets Turnover Ratio: It is defined as the trailing 12-month sales divided by the most recently reported quarterly assets.

name: mdl77_2mqf_bmpo
description: Operating Profit Margin: It is defined as the most recently reported quarterly operating income divided by the corresponding quarterly sales.

name: mdl77_2mqf_capexast
description: Capital Expenditure-to-Total Assets: It is defined as trailing 12-month capital expenditures divided by the total assets from the most recent quarter

name: mdl77_2mqf_capexsale
description: TTM Capital Expenditures-to-Sales: It is defined as trailing 12-month capital expenditures divided by trailing 12-month sales.

name: mdl77_2mqf_cashburnrate
description: Cash Burn Rate: It is defined as: -(Cash From Operations + Cash from Investments) / (Cash + Short-term Investments).

name: mdl77_2mqf_cashc
description: Cash Cycle: It is defined as the average inventory days plus the average collection days minus the average payable days.

name: mdl77_2mqf_cashsale
description: The company's performance in trailing 1-year before taking into account non-recurring gain or loss, divided by its month-end trading price.

name: mdl77_2mqf_cfita
description: TTM Cash Flow from Investment to Total Assets: It is defined as the trailing 12-month cash flow from the investing portion of the cash flow statement divided by the last 4 quarters' average total assets.

name: mdl77_2mqf_cfroi
description: Cash Flow Return on Invested Capital: It is defined as the trailing 12-month cash flow divided by the average invested capital in the same period. Invested capital equals the sum of common equity, long-term debt, minority interest, and preferred stock.

name: mdl77_2mqf_chgnoa
description: Change in Net Operating Assets: It is defined as the year-over-year change of net operating assets to total assets, where net operating assets equal the most recent quarterly short-term debt plus long-term debt plus preferred equity plus common equity minus cash.

name: mdl77_2mqf_chgollev
description: Change in Operating Liability Leverage: It is defined as the current quarter operating liability leverage less the operating liability leverage 4 quarters ago, where operating liability leverage equals 1 minus the ratio of (short-term debt + long-term debt + common equity + preferred equity - cash) to (total assets - cash)

name: mdl77_2mqf_chgreccast
description: YOY Chg in Acct Receivable to Current Assets: It is defined as the percent change in the most recent quarterly reported accounts receivable to current assets ratio from the ratio for the same quarter one year ago.

name: mdl77_2mqf_cws
description: Working Capital-to-Trailing 12-Month Sales: It is defined as the average of working capital for the trailing 12 months divided by the total sales in the same period. Working capital equals the inventory plus accounts receivable minus accounts payable on the balance sheet.

name: mdl77_2mqf_divcf
description: Dividends-to-Cash Flow: It is defined as the trailing 12-month cash dividends divided by the trailing 12-month cash flow. Cash dividends represent the total amount of cash dividends paid for both common and preferred stock.

name: mdl77_2mqf_equityto
description: The trailing 12-month sales divided by the average of trailing 12-month reported book equity.

name: mdl77_2mqf_fcfroi
description: Free Cash Flow Return on Invested Capital: It is defined as the trailing 12-month free cash flow divided by the average invested capital in the same period. Invested capital equals the sum of common equity, long-term debt, minority interest, and preferred stock.

name: mdl77_2mqf_fcfsale
description: TTM Free Cash Flow-to-TTM Sales: It is defined as the trailing 12-month free cash flow divided by the trailing 12-month sales.

name: mdl77_2mqf_fixastto
description: The trailing 12-month sales divided by the average of the total fixed assets in the same period.

name: mdl77_2mqf_ica
description: Abnormal Capital Investment: It is defined as the change in a firm's most recent trailing 12-month capital investment intensity compared to the average of its prior 3-year investment intensity.

name: mdl77_2mqf_indrelcroe_
description: Stock's lagged quarterly return on equity (ROE) minus the average of the ROEs of all stocks in the same industry deflated by the standard deviation of these ROEs.

name: mdl77_2mqf_invast
description: The current inventory level deflated by the total assets from the most recent quarter.

name: mdl77_2mqf_mpn
description: Net Profit Margin: It is defined as the most recently reported quarterly net income after tax divided by the corresponding quarterly sales.

name: mdl77_2mqf_netdebt
description: Net Debt Ratio: It is defined as the net debt divided by the sum of the net debt, preferred stock, and common stock, where net debt equals the long-term debt plus short-term debt minus cash & equivalents. All items are from the most recent quarter.

name: mdl77_2mqf_niper
description: Net Income per Employee: It is defined as the income after taxes for the trailing 12-months divided by the number of employees at the end of the last reported fiscal year.

name: mdl77_2mqf_noato
description: Net Operating Asset Turnover: It is defined as trailing 12-month sales divided by the last 4-quarters average net operating assets, which equals short-term debt + long-term debt + preferred equity + common equity - cash.

name: mdl77_2mqf_nopatmargin
description: NOPAT Margin: It is defined as: (Net Income + Interest Expense*(1-Effective Tax Rate))/Net Sales. All items are for trailing 12-month. Effective tax rate equals income taxes for the trailing 12 months divided by the trailing 12 months' income before taxes.

name: mdl77_2mqf_ocfast
description: Operating Cash Flow to Assets: It is defined as the trailing 12-month net cash flow from operations divided by the average total assets.

name: mdl77_2mqf_ocfmargin
description: Operating Cash Flow Profit Margin: It is defined as the trailing 12-month cash flow from operations scaled by the trailing 12-month sales.

name: mdl77_2mqf_ocfroi
description: Operating Cash Flow Return on Invested Capital: It is defined as the trailing 12-month operating cash flow divided by the average invested capital in the same period. Invested capital equals the sum of common equity, long-term debt, minority interest, and preferred stock.

name: mdl77_2mqf_ollev
description: Operating Liability Leverage: It is defined as 1 minus the ratio of (short-term debt + long-term debt + common equity + preferred equity - cash) to (total assets - cash) in the current quarter

name: mdl77_2mqf_otvni
description: Inventory Turnover Ratio: It is defined as the trailing 12-month cost of goods sold divided by the average of inventory in the same period.

name: mdl77_2mqf_pca
description: Average Collection Period: It is defined as the average of the trailing 12-month reported accounts receivable times 365 and then divided by the trailing 12-month sales.

name: mdl77_2mqf_pinoa
description: Pretax Return on Net Operating Assets: It is defined as the trailing 12-month operating income after depreciation divided by the average net operating assets.

name: mdl77_2mqf_ppa
description: Average Payable Period: It is defined as the average of the trailing 12-month accounts payable times 365 divided by the trailing 12-month cost of goods sold.

name: mdl77_2mqf_rdsale
description: R&D Intensity: It is defined as the average of the research & development expenses in the trailing 12 months deflated by the sum of total sales in the same period.

name: mdl77_2mqf_revper
description: Revenue per Employee: It is defined as the trailing 12-month total sales divided by the number of employees at the end of the last reported fiscal year.

name: mdl77_2mqf_roe
description: Return on Equity: It is defined as the trailing 12-month income before extra items divided by the average of common equity in the same period.

name: mdl77_2mqf_roic
description: Return on Invested Capital: It is defined as the trailing 12-month net income and interest expenses divided by the average reported invested capital, which equals the sum of common equity, long-term debt, minority interest, and preferred stock.

name: mdl77_2mqf_vnicw
description: Working Capital to Inventory: It is defined as the most recent quarterly reported working capital divided by the inventory. Working capital is the difference between current assets and current liabilities.

name: mdl77_2mqf_wcast
description: Working Capital-to-Total Assets: It is defined as the average working capital in the trailing 12 months divided by the average total assets in the same period.

name: mdl77_2mqf_yoychggpm
description: Yearly Change In Gross Profit Margin: It is defined as the most recent quarterly reported gross profit margin minus the margin for the same quarter 1 year ago. Gross profit margin equals the difference between sales and cost of goods sold then scaled by the sales.

name: mdl77_2mqf_yoychgroa
description: Yearly Change in Return on Assets: It is defined as the most recent trailing 12-month income before extra items as a percentage of total assets minus the percentage for the same quarter one year ago

name: mdl77_2mrspe_cf
description: The 3-month change in analysts' median earnings forecast for a stock's fiscal 1 scaled by the current mean estimate.

name: mdl77_2nef
description: Net External Financing: It is defined as the sum of the net cash from the change in common equity, the change in preferred equity, the change in convertible debt, the change in other long-term debt, and the change in short-term borrowings. All items are scaled by the total assets.

name: mdl77_2over
description: Overhead-to-Sales: It is defined as the trailing 12-month operating income less depreciation minus income before extraordinary items scaled by trailing 12-month sales

name: mdl77_2pe_wt
description: Time-Weighted Earnings Yield: This factor uses a time-weighted combination of FY1 and FY2 earnings estimates to create a twelve-month forward earnings forecast. This earnings factor is a unique complement to the wide variety of earnings-related metrics available to determine a company's fair value.

name: mdl77_2pelh_cf
description: Street Revision Confidence: It is defined as the sum of the 3-month change in the highest and lowest FY1 earnings estimate, scaled by month-end trading price.

name: mdl77_2priceanalystmodel2_qpa_composite
description: Score based on analysts

name: mdl77_2priceanalystmodel_nspmoc_apq
description: Price Analyst Sector-Neutral: Price Analyst Sector-Neutral

name: mdl77_2priceanalystmodel_qpa_indrs
description: Industry Relative Strength: Industry Relative Strength

name: mdl77_2priceanalystmodel_srjdaksr_apq
description: Risk Adj Relative Strength : Risk Adj Relative Strength

name: mdl77_2pricemomemtummodel2_indrelrtn5d_
description: Stock's return in the last 5 days minus the average of the comparable returns of all stocks in the same industry, then deflated by the standard deviation of these returns.

name: mdl77_2pricemomemtummodel_pmm_composite
description: Score based on price momentum

name: mdl77_2pricemomemtummodel_rationalalpha
description: Rational Decay Alpha: It evaluates stocks based on their historical 12-month market (S&P 500) adjusted excess return (the Y-intercept from an OLS regression equation) using a proprietary rational decay function.

name: mdl77_2pricemomemtummodel_relpricestrength_
description: Industry-Adjusted 12-Month Relative Price Strength: It is defined as a stock's 12-month relative price strength (PS) minus the PSs of all stocks in the same industry, deflated by the standard deviation of these PSs.

name: mdl77_2pricemomemtummodel_visiratio
description: The Visibility Ratio: It equals a stock's most recent daily trading volume divided by the average daily trading volume in the previous 50 trading days.

name: mdl77_2pricemomemtummodel_voldiff_pc
description: ATM Put Volatility - ATM Call Volatility: It is defined as the difference between the time weighted average implied volatility of the 2 nearest to expiration at the money put options and 2 nearest to expiration at the money call options

name: mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_5_4op
description: One minus the quotient of a stock's last 52-week price exponential moving average divided by its last 4-week price exponential moving average.

name: mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_6351_rp
description: 15/36 Week Stock Price Ratio: It is defined as the moving average of a stock's prices in the last 15 weeks divided by the moving average of its prices in the last 36 weeks.

name: mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_actrtn12m
description: 12-Month Active Return with 1-month Lag: It is defined as the percent change in price for a stock from month t-13 to month t-1.

name: mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_actrtn18m
description: 18-Month Active Return with 1-Month Lag: It is defined as the percent change in price for a stock from month t-19 to month t-1.

name: mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_actrtn1m
description: 1-Month Active Return: It is defined as the percent change in price for a stock from month t-1 to month t.

name: mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_actrtn24m
description: 24-Month Active Return with 1-Month Lag: It is defined as the percent change in price for a stock from month t-25 to month t-1.

name: mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_actrtn2m
description: 2-Month Active Return: It is defined as the percent change in price for a stock from month t-2 to month t.

name: mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_actrtn36m
description: 36-Month Active Return with 1-Month Lag: It is defined as the percent change in price for a stock from month t-37 to month t-1.

name: mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_actrtn3m
description: 3-Month Active Return: It is defined as the percent change in price for a stock from month t-3 to month t.

name: mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_actrtn60m
description: 60-Month Active Return with 1-Month Lag: It is defined as the percent change in price for a stock from month t-61 to month t-1.

name: mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_actrtn6m
description: 6-Month Active Return with 1-Month Lag: It is defined as the percent change in price for a stock from month t-7 to month t-1.

name: mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_alpha60m
description: 60-Month Alpha: It is defined as the intercept of the regression line which best fits a stock's monthly price return against the S&P 500 index monthly return over the last 60-month period.

name: mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_chg6malpha18m
description: 6-Month Nominal Change in 18-Month Alpha: It is defined as the 6-month change in a stock's 18-month alpha, which equals the intercept from the regression of a stock price's monthly return against the S&P 500 index monthly return over the last 18-month period.

name: mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_chgalpha12m
description: 6-Month Nominal Change in 12-Month Alpha: It is defined as the 6-month change in a stock's 12-month alpha, which equals the intercept from the regression of a stock price's monthly return against the S&P 500 index monthly return over the last 12-month period.

name: mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_chgalpha36m
description: 6-Month Nominal Change in 36-Month Alpha: It is defined as the 6-month change in a stock's 36-month alpha, which equals the intercept from the regression of a stock price's monthly return against the S&P 500 index monthly return over the last 36-month period.

name: mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_chgvolpre4y
description: 4-Year Change in the Average Trading Volume: It is defined as the change in the most recent 6-month moving average of monthly turnover ratio (average monthly trading volume/total shares outstanding) as compared to the 12-month moving average of monthly turnover ratio 4 years ago.

name: mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_high52w
description: 52-Week High: It is defined as the month-end price divided by the highest monthly closing price in the past 12 months.

name: mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_indrelrtn4w_
description: 4-week Industry Relative Return: It is defined as a stock's return in the last 4 weeks minus the average of the comparable returns of all stocks in the same industry deflated by the standard deviation of these returns.

name: mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_indrelrtn5d_
description: Stock's return in the last 5 days minus the average of the comparable returns of all stocks in the same industry, then deflated by the standard deviation of these returns.

name: mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_m42rav
description: 24-Month Value at Risk: It is defined as the minimum of a stock's monthly price return in the last 20-month period.

name: mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_m6dn2ntr
description: Second Preceding 6-Month Return: It is defined as the percent change in a stock's price from month t-12 to month t-7.

name: mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_normalmf60d
description: The 60-day average of a stock's daily money flow divided by daily total dollar volume.

name: mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_ntrm01ff
description: Fama-French Momentum: It is defined as the percent change in a stock's price from month t-12 to month t-2.

name: mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_p50_00ratio
description: 50-200 Day Stock Price Ratio: It is defined as the moving average of a stock's prices in the last 50 days divided by the moving average of its prices in the last 200 days.

name: mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_pc_ratio
description: Put/Call Ratio: It is defined as the open interest in 7 near-the-money (1 at-the-money, next 3 above and next 3 below), nearest to expiration put option contracts divided by the open interest in 7 near-the-money (1 at-the-money, next 3 above and next 3 below), nearest to expiration call option contracts.

name: mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_pctabv260low
description: Price Above Last 260-Day Lowest Trading Price: It is defined as a stock's current closing price divided by its lowest daily low price in the last 260 trading days.

name: mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_pd09erpvc
description: CV of Prior 90-Day Closing Prices: It is defined as the standard deviation of a stock's last 90 days closing prices divided by the mean of these prices.

name: mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_rationalalpha
description: Rational Decay Alpha: It evaluates stocks based on their historical 12-month market (S&P 500) adjusted excess return (the Y intercept from an OLS regression equation) using a proprietary rational decay function.

name: mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_rba
description: Abnormal Return around QTR Earnings Release: It is defined as the sum of a stock's daily market-adjusted price return from 2 days before to 1 day after its quarterly earnings announcement. The market return proxy is the S&P 500 index.

name: mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_relpricestrength_
description: Industry-adjusted 12-month Relative Price Strength: It is defined as a stock's 12-month relative price-strength (PS) minus the PSs of all stocks in the same industry deflated by the standard deviation of these PSs.

name: mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_sharpe36m
description: Changes in company's monthly profit in the last 3 years compared to its profit 3 months ago.

name: mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_skew90cortn
description: Skewness of 90-Day Stock Daily Excess Returns: It is defined as the skewness of the distribution of a stock's daily excess (compared to the S&P 500 index) price returns in the last 90 days. Skewness = 3*(Mean-Median)/Standard Deviation.

name: mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_skew90drtn
description: Skewness of 90-Day Stock Daily Returns: It is defined as the skewness (measure of lack of symmetry) of the distribution of a stock's daily price returns in the last 90 days. Skewness = 3*(Mean-Median)/Standard Deviation.

name: mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_slope52wp
description: Slope of 52-Week Price Trend Line: It is defined as the 4-week lagged slope coefficient of the least squares regression line of the last 52-week weekly stock's closing price against the corresponding weekly dates.

name: mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_slope66wp
description: Slope of 66 Week Price Trend Line: It is defined as the 4-week lagged slope coefficient of the least squares regression line of the last 66-week weekly stock's closing price against the corresponding weekly dates.

name: mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_sortinoratio
description: Sortino Ratio: It is defined as a stock's annualized average monthly total return over the last 36 months less the average annualized 90-Day T-Bill rate over the same period divided by the standard deviation of the stock's monthly returns in months when total return was negative.

name: mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_tstalp
description: 1-Year Price Momentum Indicator: It is defined as: (CORREL*(260-2)^.5)/(1-CORREL^2)^.5. CORREL is the correlation coefficient between the natural logarithm of stock daily closing price and the corresponding daily dates in last 260 days.

name: mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_varresirtn
description: 24-Month Residual Return Variance: It is defined as the variance of a stock's monthly residual return in the last 24 months. The monthly residual return equals the stock's monthly return minus the product of the multiplication of a stock's proprietary 60-month Beta by the S&P 500 index monthly return.

name: mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_visiratio
description: The Visibility Ratio: It equals a stock's most recent daily trading volume divided by the average daily trading volume in the previous 50 trading days.

name: mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_volpre6m
description: The 6-month moving average of average monthly turnover ratio.

name: mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_w15tvp
description: This field determines the strength of trends and warns of reversals.

name: mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_w57w03_rp
description: 30-75 Week Stock Price Ratio: It is defined as the moving average of a stock's prices in the last 30 weeks divided by the moving average of its prices in the last 75 weeks.

name: mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_w62isr
description: 26-Week Relative Price Strength: It is defined as a stock's most recent weekly closing price divided by its weekly closing price 26 weeks ago.

name: mdl77_2pricemomentumfactor_w93ntr
description: 39-Week Return with 4-week Lag: It is defined as a stock's price change from week t-43 to week t-4.

name: mdl77_2put_put_capmod
description: Capital Strength Module: It is defined as the equal-weighted average of the Industry Relative ROE, Change in Shares Outstanding, Total Coverage and Change in Operating Liability Leverage factors.

name: mdl77_2put_put_cashburn
description: Cash Burn Rate: It is defined as: -(Cash From Operations + Cash from Investments)/(Cash + Short-term Investments).

name: mdl77_2put_put_chgalpha
description: Six-Month Alpha Change Rank: It is defined as the six-month change in a stock's twelve-month alpha, as calculated by a rolling CAPM regression.

name: mdl77_2put_put_chgoll
description: Change in Operating Liability Leverage: It is defined as the current quarter operating liability leverage less the operating liability leverage 4 quarters ago, where operating liability leverage equals 1 minus the ratio of (short-term debt + long-term debt + common equity + preferred equity - cash) to (total assets - cash).

name: mdl77_2put_put_chshrs
description: Percent Change in Shares Outstanding: It is defined as the percent change in a company's current number of outstanding shares as compared to the number of shares outstanding 1 year ago.

name: mdl77_2put_put_dypeg
description: Reciprocal of Dividend Yield-adjusted PEG: It is defined as the reciprocal of a stock's forward 12-month P/E ratio divided by the total growth rate. The total growth rate is the sum of the forecasted long-term growth rate and the indicated dividend yield.

name: mdl77_2put_put_equality
description: Earnings Quality Rank: It is defined as the equal weighted composite of the Earnings Shortfall, Change in Inventory, Change in Asset Turnover, Change in Net Operating Working Capital and Capex/Depreciations Ranks.

name: mdl77_2put_put_indepsp
description: Industry Relative Core EPS to Price: It is defined as a stock's trailing 12-month earnings per share before extra items-to-price ratio (EP) less the average of the EPs of all stocks in the same industry, deflated by the standard deviation of these EPs.

name: mdl77_2put_put_indestep
description: Industry Relative Leading 4-QTRs EPS to Price: It is defined as a stock's trailing 12-month earnings per share before extra items-to-price ratio (EP) less the average of the EPs of all stocks in the same industry deflated by the standard deviation of these EPs.

name: mdl77_2put_put_indfcfp
description: Industry Relative Free Cash Flow-to-Price: It is defined as a stock's trailing 12-month free cash flow-to-price ratio (FCFP) less the average of the FCFPs of all stocks in the same industry deflated by the standard deviation of the FCFPs of all stocks in the same relative universe.

name: mdl77_2put_put_indroe
description: Company's ability to generate profit.

name: mdl77_2put_put_momod
description: The mean of three components: unexpected changes in expense or profit, and consumer confidence report.

name: mdl77_2put_put_opincev
description: Operating Income to EV: It is defined as a stock's ratio of trailing 4Q operating income to enterprise value (OpInc/EV).

name: mdl77_2put_put_qualmod
description: Quality Module: It is defined as the aggregation of the Earnings Quality (90%) and Short-Interest Ratio (10%) factors.

name: mdl77_2put_put_siratio
description: Short-Interest Ratio: It is defined as short-interest to average monthly volume.

name: mdl77_2put_put_strevconf
description: Street Revision Confidence: It is defined as the sum of the 3-month change in a stock's analysts' highest earnings forecast and change in analysts' lowest earnings estimates for fiscal year 1 by its month-end trading price.

name: mdl77_2put_put_sucf
description: Standardized Unexpected Cash Flow: It is defined as a stock's most recent reported quarterly operating cash flow minus that of 4 quarters ago divided by the standard deviation of this difference over the preceding 8 quarters.

name: mdl77_2put_put_totcov
description: Total Coverage: It equals (Cash Flow from Operations + Interest Paid + Tax Paid) / (Interest + Principal Paid).

name: mdl77_2put_put_valmod
description: The weighted average of various financial ratios related to a company's profits.

name: mdl77_2qe_av_amv
description: Earnings Quality: This submodule is 20% 1-year Change in Asset Turnover Ratio, 20% Current Cash Flow Debt Coverage, 20% Capital ExpTo Depreciation Linkage, 10% Change in Inventory to Average Assets, 10% YOY Change in Accruals, 10% Earnings Shortfall, and 10% Capital Acquisition Ratio. There are additional adjustments for Financials and Utilities.

name: mdl77_2rel5yfwdep
description: 5-yr Relative Leading 12-Month Earnings Yield: It is defined as a stock's current next 4-quarter's consensus analyst earnings forecasts-to-price ratio (FwdEP) minus the average of the FwdEPs ratio in the last 60 months scaled by the standard deviation of the FwdEPs over the same period.

name: mdl77_2relativevaluemodel_capacq
description: Capital Acquisition Ratio: It is defined as the trailing 12-month operating cash flow less than the trailing 12-month cash dividends and then divided by the total expenditures in the same period.

name: mdl77_2relativevaluemodel_fc_estep
description: Leading 12-Month Median Earnings Yield: It is defined as the next fiscal year median consensus earnings estimate divided by trading price.

name: mdl77_2relativevaluemodel_fmrelval
description: Fielitz & Muller Relative Intrinsic Value: It is defined as a derivative of the two-stage dividend discount model, to calculate a stock's intrinsic value. The formula uses projected long-term earnings growth rate, dividend yield, P/E ratio, and Beta. The expectation with this indicator is that stocks with high intrinsic value will outperform alternatives in the long run.

name: mdl77_2relativevaluemodel_pfcfmtt
description: TTM Free Cash Flow-to-Price: It is defined as the trailing 12-month free cash flow per share for a stock divided by its month-end trading price. Free cash flow equals operating cash flow minus capital expenditures and cash dividends.

name: mdl77_2relativevaluemodel_roe
description: Return on Equity: It is defined as the trailing 12-month income before extra items divided by the average of common equity in the same period.

name: mdl77_2relativevaluemodel_rvm_composite
description: Model composite based on an asset's worth that takes into account the value of similar assets.

name: mdl77_2sensitivityfactor400_actrtn9m
description: 9-Month Active Return with 1-Month Lag: It is defined as a stock's price percent change from month t-10 to month t-1.

name: mdl77_2sensitivityfactor400_apsales
description: Asia-Pacific Sales Exposure: It is defined as the annual aggregate sales for Asia-Pacific as reported by the company divided by total annual sales.

name: mdl77_2sensitivityfactor400_capexdeplink
description: Capital Expenditures to Depreciation Linkage: It is defined as the absolute value of the difference between ranked (1-1000) quarterly capital expenditures to assets and ranked (1-1000) quarterly depreciation to assets.

name: mdl77_2sensitivityfactor400_ceroe
description: The trailing 12-month funds from operations divided by the average of the current and previous year.

name: mdl77_2sensitivityfactor400_dsu
description: The beta coefficient estimated by a multiple regression of returns on several macroeconomic aspects over 60 months.

name: mdl77_2sensitivityfactor400_emeasales
description: EMEA Sales Exposure: It is defined as the annual aggregate sales for EMEA as reported by the company divided by total annual sales.

name: mdl77_2sensitivityfactor400_inflation
description: The beta coefficient estimated by a multiple regression of returns on several macroeconomic aspects over 60 months.

name: mdl77_2sensitivityfactor400_lasales
description: Latin America Sales Exposure: It is defined as the annual aggregate sales for Latin America as reported by the company divided by total annual sales.

name: mdl77_2sensitivityfactor400_nasales
description: North America Sales Exposure: It is defined as the annual aggregate sales for North America as reported by the company divided by total annual sales

name: mdl77_2sensitivityfactor400_oilprice
description: The beta coefficient estimated by a multiple regression of returns on several macroeconomic aspects over 60 months.

name: mdl77_2sensitivityfactor400_pi
description: Industrial Production Sensitivity: It is defined as the beta coefficient to Change in Industrial Production, which is estimated by a 60-month multiple regression of returns on several macroeconomic factors.

name: mdl77_2sensitivityfactor400_prc
description: Credit Risk Premium Sensitivity: It is defined as the beta coefficient to Change in Credit Risk Premium, which is estimated by a 60-month multiple regression of returns on several macroeconomic factors.

name: mdl77_2sensitivityfactor400_sh
description: Housing Starts Sensitivity: It is defined as the beta coefficient to Change in Housing Starts, which is estimated by a 60-month multiple regression of returns on several macroeconomic factors.

name: mdl77_2sensitivityfactor400_ttmopincev
description: TTM Operating Income to Enterprise Value: It is defined as the trailing 12-month operating income (before depreciation and amortization) divided by enterprise value (EV). EV = Equity Market Value + Long-term Debt + Short-term Debt + Preferred Stock + Minority Interest - Cash.

name: mdl77_2sensitivityfactor400_xiv
description: Market Volatility Sensitivity: It is defined as the beta coefficient to Change in Market Volatility, which is estimated by a 60-month multiple regression of returns on several macroeconomic factors.

name: mdl77_2sensitivityfactor400_yieldsprd
description: Yield Curve Slope Sensitivity: It is defined as the beta coefficient to Change in Slope of Term Structure, which is estimated by a 60-month multiple regression of returns on several macroeconomic factors.

name: mdl77_2sf_av_amv
description: Financial Statement Valuation: This submodule is the equal-weighted average of Price-to-Book ROE Combination, TTM Operating Income to Enterprise Value, TTM FCF to Enterprise Value, and Industry-Relative TTM Sales to Enterprise Value.

name: mdl77_2si_av_amv
description: Investor Sentiment: This submodule is the equal-weighted average of the Short Interest Position, 12-month change in Short Interest Position, and ATM Put-Call Volatility.

name: mdl77_2spe1yfvc_cf
description: FY1 EPS Estimates Dispersion: It is defined as the standard deviation of analyst earnings estimates for fiscal year 1 divided by the mean consensus forecast.

name: mdl77_2surpriseanalystmodel_qsa_composite
description: Surprise Analyst Composite Rank

name: mdl77_2surpriseanalystmodel_qsa_efficiency
description: Fundamentals Rank

name: mdl77_2surpriseanalystmodel_qsa_estexpect
description: Estimate Trend Rank

name: mdl77_2surpriseanalystmodel_qsa_percent
description: Probability of Surprise (%)

name: mdl77_2surpriseanalystmodel_qsa_surpsn
description: Rank based on analysts' surprise

name: mdl77_2valueanalystmodel_ccaghc_avq
description: The 1-year change in a company's trailing 4Q net operating working capital, scaled by current total assets.

name: mdl77_2valueanalystmodel_qva_alertrank
description: The aggregate of the Earnings Quality (50%), Investor Sentiment (25%) and Management Signaling (25%) Rank.

name: mdl77_2valueanalystmodel_qva_capexdep
description: Capex to Depreciation Rank: It is defined as a company's trailing 12-month capital expenditures divided by the trailing 12-month depreciation.

name: mdl77_2valueanalystmodel_qva_cashflow
description: Cash Flow Rank: It is defined as a stock's ratio of trailing 4Q free cash flow to market capitalization (FCF/P).

name: mdl77_2valueanalystmodel_qva_chgato
description: Change in Asset Turnover Rank: It is defined as the one-year change in a company's asset turnover (TTM Sales/Total Assets).

name: mdl77_2valueanalystmodel_qva_chginv
description: The one-year change in a company's trailing 4Q inventory, scaled by current total assets

name: mdl77_2valueanalystmodel_qva_composite
description: The equal-weighted combinations of ranks based on intrinsic value of stock and the quality of earnings.

name: mdl77_2valueanalystmodel_qva_earnquality
description: Earnings Quality Rank: It is defined as the equal-weighted composite of the Earnings Shortfall, Change in Inventory, Change in Asset Turnover, Change in Net Operating Working Capital and Capex/Depreciations Ranks.

name: mdl77_2valueanalystmodel_qva_earnval
description: The equal-weighted average of ranks based on price, earnings, growth, and yield.

name: mdl77_2valueanalystmodel_qva_epmodule
description: Earnings Cyclicality Rank: It is defined as the aggregated ranking of a company's 3-year low 4Q EPS to enterprise value, FY1 EPS estimate to enterprise value and industry-relative EP rankings

name: mdl77_2valueanalystmodel_qva_finstmt
description: Financial Statement Rank: It is defined as the equal-weighted average of the Income Statement Rank (OpInc/Price), the Balance Sheet Rank (Cash/Price), and the Cash Flow Rank (FCF/Price).

name: mdl77_2valueanalystmodel_qva_invsentiment
description: The equal weighted sum based on a ratio of number of stocks and those that have been sold short by investors.

name: mdl77_2valueanalystmodel_qva_mgtsignaling
description: The sum of the indicators based on the changes in the number of stocks, and the company's financial status.

name: mdl77_2valueanalystmodel_qva_pegy
description: PEGY Rank: It is defined as the aggregated ranking of a company's price, earnings, estimated long-term growth, and dividend yield rankings

name: mdl77_2valueanalystmodel_qva_shortfall
description: Earnings Shortfall Rank: It is defined as the difference between recent 4Q operating income before depreciation and trailing 4Q earnings, scaled by a company's enterprise value.

name: mdl77_2valueanalystmodel_qva_valuation
description: Valuation Rank: It is defined as the equal-weighted average of the Financial Statement Rank and the Earnings Valuation Rank.

name: mdl77_2valueanalystmodel_qva_yoychgdebt
description: Chg in Debt Issuance Rank: It is defined as a company's change in total debt over the last 12 months.

name: mdl77_2valueanalystmodel_qva_yoychgshares
description: Change in Shares Outstanding Rank: It is defined as a company's change in common shares outstanding over the last 12 months.

name: mdl77_2valueanalystmodel_tmtscni_avq
description: Income Stmt Rank: It is defined as a stock's ratio of trailing 4Q operating income to enterprise value (OpInc/EV).

description: Earnings Expectation Module

name: mdl77_2valuemomemtummodel_earningspricelinkmodule
description: Earnings-Price Link Module

description: Earnings Quality Module

description: Price Momentum Module
