name: mdl77_liquidityriskfactor_ed
description: Long-term Debt-to-Equity: It is defined as the most recently reported total long-term debt divided by total book equity.

name: mdl77_liquidityriskfactor_flowratio
description: Flow Ratio: It is defined as the difference between current assets and cash & equivalents divided by the difference between current liabilities and short-term debt. All items are from the most recent quarter.

name: mdl77_liquidityriskfactor_gear
description: Capital Gearing Ratio: It is defined as the long-term debt divided by the difference between total assets and current liability.

name: mdl77_liquidityriskfactor_growdura
description: Growth Duration: It is defined as the natural log of the ratio of a stock's leading 12-month PE to the leading 12-month PE of the market divided by the natural log of the ratio of 1 plus the stock's total growth rate, defined as the long-term growth rate plus indicated annual dividend yield, to the total growth rate of the market, defined similarly. The factor is ranked in ascending order.

name: mdl77_liquidityriskfactor_idb
description: Basic Defensive Interval: It measures how many days that a company can cover its daily operating expenses (cost of goods sold and SG&A) by only using its cash and receivables on its balance sheet.

name: mdl77_liquidityriskfactor_impduration
description: Implied Equity Duration: It is an equity risk measure based on Macaulay's traditional measure of bond duration. It combines book value, expected growth, expected profitability, and current stock trading price.

name: mdl77_liquidityriskfactor_iqa
description: Asset Quality Index: It is defined as the year-over-year change of 1 minus the ratio of current assets plus PP&E divided by total assets.

name: mdl77_liquidityriskfactor_lfd
description: The sum of the trailing 12-month pretax income and the trailing 12-month interest expense divided by the trailing 12-month pretax income.

name: mdl77_liquidityriskfactor_liqcoeff
description: Liquidity Coefficient: It is the slope of the regression between the monthly stock trading turnover ratio (X) and the contemporary monthly stock price returns (Y).

name: mdl77_liquidityriskfactor_mad3yttmni
description: 3-yr MAD of TTM Net Income: It is defined as the mean absolute deviation of the last 12 quarters' trailing 12-month net income deflated by the average of total assets.

name: mdl77_liquidityriskfactor_mad3yttmsale
description: 3-yr MAD of TTM Sales: It is defined as the mean absolute deviation of 12-quarter trailing 12-month sales deflated by the average of total assets.

name: mdl77_liquidityriskfactor_milliq
description: Stock Illiquidity: It is defined as the monthly average of the daily absolute return to the daily dollar trading volume ratio.

name: mdl77_liquidityriskfactor_mktcappera
description: Stock's current market cap divided by the number of analysts providing Fiscal Year 1 earnings estimates.

name: mdl77_liquidityriskfactor_mktlev
description: Stock's total market value plus the most recent reported quarterly book debt then divided by the market value.

name: mdl77_liquidityriskfactor_monchgsip
description: Monthly Change in Short Interest Position: It is defined as the month-to-month change of the ratio of shares sold short divided by common shares outstanding.

name: mdl77_liquidityriskfactor_netcashp
description: Net Cash to Equity: It is defined as most recently reported quarterly cash & equivalents less the long-term debt and current debt for a stock divided by its current market value.

name: mdl77_liquidityriskfactor_nfaldebt
description: Net Fixed Assets to Long-term Debt: It is defined as the most recent quarterly reported net fixed assets divided by the total long-term debt.

name: mdl77_liquidityriskfactor_nlassets
description: Natural Logarithm of Total Assets: It is defined as the natural logarithm of the most recent quarterly reported total assets.

name: mdl77_liquidityriskfactor_nlmktcap
description: Natural Logarithm of Market Capitalization: It is defined as the natural logarithm of the cubic of a stock's total market value.

name: mdl77_liquidityriskfactor_nlprice
description: Natural Logarithm of Closing Price: It is defined as the natural logarithm of the cubic of a stock's unadjusted closing price.

name: mdl77_liquidityriskfactor_nlsales
description: Natural Logarithm of TTM Sales: It is defined as the natural logarithm of the cubic of a company's trailing 12-month sales.

name: mdl77_liquidityriskfactor_nlvolcap
description: The natural logarithm of the quotient of the trailing 1-year average of the monthly volume to the trailing 1-year average of monthly market value of outstanding shares.

name: mdl77_liquidityriskfactor_numest
description: The number of analysts' earnings estimates for fiscal year 1 for a stock.

name: mdl77_liquidityriskfactor_ocfratio
description: Operating Cash Flow Ratio: It is defined as a stock's most recently reported quarterly cash flow from operations divided by its current liabilities.

name: mdl77_liquidityriskfactor_ohlsonscore
description: Ohlson Bankruptcy Score: It is a model assessing a company's probability of bankruptcy by considering firm size, capital structure, financial performance, and liquidity. It is derived from Ohlson (1980).

name: mdl77_liquidityriskfactor_oplev
description: Operating Leverage: It is defined as the percent change in the trailing 12-month operating income from the previous quarter divided by the percent change in trailing 12-month sales from the previous quarter.

name: mdl77_liquidityriskfactor_pcurlia
description: Current Liabilities-to-Price: It is defined as a stock's most recently reported quarterly current liabilities per share divided by its closing price.

name: mdl77_liquidityriskfactor_rerror60m
description: Regression Error of 60-Month CAPM: It is defined as the standard error of the slope of the least squares regression line for a stock's last 60-month monthly returns against the S&P 500 Index returns.

name: mdl77_liquidityriskfactor_rq
description: Quick Ratio: It is defined as the current assets less inventories from the most recent quarter divided by the total current liabilities from the most recent quarter.

name: mdl77_liquidityriskfactor_si_ratio
description: Short Interest Ratio: It is defined as the number of shares sold short divided by the average daily trading volume of the stock over the last 30 trading days.

name: mdl77_liquidityriskfactor_sigma
description: Stock Return Volatility: It is defined as the standard deviation of a stock's monthly returns in the prior 60 months.

name: mdl77_liquidityriskfactor_sip
description: Short Interest Position: It is defined as the number of shares sold short divided by common shares outstanding

name: mdl77_liquidityriskfactor_tobinq
description: Tobin q: It is defined as the market value of equity (E) plus debt (D) divided by assets (A), or (E + D)/A. D is measured using book values.

name: mdl77_liquidityriskfactor_totalcov
description: Total Coverage: It equals (Cash Flow from Operations + Interest Paid + Tax Paid)/(Interest + Principal Paid).

name: mdl77_liquidityriskfactor_voctni
description: Interest Coverage: It is defined as the most recently reported quarterly operating income before depreciation divided by the quarterly long-term debt interest expenses.

name: mdl77_liquidityriskfactor_voldiff_pc
description: ATM Put Volatility - ATM Call Volatility: It is defined as the difference between the time weighted average implied volatility of the 2 nearest to expiration at the money put options and 2 nearest to expiration at the money call options

name: mdl77_liquidityriskfactor_volto
description: Trading Turnover Ratio: It is defined as the monthly total trading volume divided by the most recently reported total outstanding shares.

name: mdl77_liquidityriskfactor_yoychgcr
description: Year-over-year Change in Current Ratio: It is defined as the most recent reported quarterly current ratio and the current ratio for the same quarter one year ago. Current ratio equals current assets divided by current liabilities.

name: mdl77_liquidityriskfactor_yoychgda
description: Year-over-year Change in Leverage: It is defined as the difference between the most recent reported quarterly total liabilities as a percentage of the reported total assets and the percentage for the same quarter one year ago.

name: mdl77_lumqca
description: Acquisition Multiple: It is defined as the most recent quarterly reported invested capital divided by the trailing 12-month EBITDA.

name: mdl77_managementsignalingmodule
description: Management Signaling Module

name: mdl77_momemtumanalystmodel_ghcfcfmtt_amq
description: Change in TTM Free Cash Flow Rank: It is defined as the 2Q change in a stock's trailing twelve month free cash flow, divided by the absolute value of a stock's trailing twelve month free cash flow from two quarters ago.

name: mdl77_momemtumanalystmodel_htwrgspe_amq
description: Earnings Growth Rank: It is defined as the one-quarter change in a stock's trailing twelve-month earnings per share, scaled by its recent closing stock price (E/P).

name: mdl77_momemtumanalystmodel_jdaksr_amq
description: Risk Adjustments Rank: It is defined as the aggregation of five non-linear price and trading volume volatility and growth subfactors. This factor penalizes a stock with extremely high (or low) volume volatility, high standard deviation of monthly returns, and large intraday price high/low spreads, among other ideas.

name: mdl77_momemtumanalystmodel_qma_alpha6m
description: Six-Month Alpha Change Rank: It is defined as the six-month change in a stock's twelve-month alpha, as calculated by a rolling CAPM regression.

name: mdl77_momemtumanalystmodel_qma_chgnowc
description: Change in Net Working Capital Rank: It is defined as the one-quarter change in a stock's recent net current working capital divided by total net operating assets from one quarter ago.

name: mdl77_momemtumanalystmodel_qma_composite
description: The composite of the Earnings Momentum Rank, the Analyst Expectations Rank, the Earnings-Price Link Rank and the Relative Price Momentum Rank factors.

name: mdl77_momemtumanalystmodel_qma_condsurp
description: Conditional Surprise Rank: It is defined as the average of a stock's recent earnings surprise, its cost of goods sold efficiency relative to its value categorization, and its sales growth strength relative to its growth categorization.

name: mdl77_momemtumanalystmodel_qma_earnexp
description: Analyst Expectations Rank: It is defined as the equal-weighted average of the Earnings Revisions and the Ratings Change Ranks.

name: mdl77_momemtumanalystmodel_qma_eplinkage
description: The equal-weighted average of the Change in Free Cash Flow Rank, the Industry Relative 3-Month Return Rank, the Market Earnings Response Rank, and the Change in Net Working Capital Rank.

name: mdl77_momemtumanalystmodel_qma_estrev
description: Estimate Revisions Rank: It is defined as the difference between the number of recent upward and downward revisions to both fiscal 1 year (FY1) and fiscal 2 year (FY2) EPS estimates over the past 4 weeks, scaled respectively by the total number of FY1 and FY2 estimates.

name: mdl77_momemtumanalystmodel_qma_indrelrtn3m
description: The difference of company's 3 months profit compared to its respective by industry classification.

name: mdl77_momemtumanalystmodel_qma_lagpricemo
description: Lagged 12- to 1-Month Price MomRank: It is defined as the difference between a stock's lagged 12-month return and its recent 1-month return, scaled by the standard deviation of the 1-month return over the past year.

name: mdl77_momemtumanalystmodel_qma_mktresponse
description: Market Earnings Response Rank: It is defined as the four-day return for a stock, spanning the two days before to the day after its recent quarterly earnings report.

name: mdl77_momemtumanalystmodel_qma_ratingchg
description: The trend in sell-side analysts' consensus ratings (standardized 1 = strong buy to 5 = strong sell) revisions over the last four and eight weeks, respectively.

name: mdl77_momemtumanalystmodel_qma_relpricemo
description: Relative Price Momentum Rank: It is defined as the equal-weighted average of the Lagged 12- to 1-Month Price Momentum Rank, the Risk Adjustments Rank, and the 6-Month Alpha Change Rank.

name: mdl77_momemtumanalystmodel_qma_repearnmom
description: Earnings Momentum Rank: It is defined as the equal weighted average of the Earnings Growth and Earnings Surprise Rankings.

name: mdl77_monchgsip
description: Monthly Change in Short Interest Position: It is defined as the month-to-month change of the ratio of shares sold short divided by common shares outstanding

name: mdl77_mpnghc
description: 1-Yr Change in Net Profit Margin: It is defined as the most recent quarterly net profit margin (NPM) minus the NPM 4 quarters ago. Net profit margin is net income divided by total sales.

name: mdl77_netcashp
description: Net Cash to Equity: It is defined as most recently reported quarterly cash & equivalents less the long-term debt and current debt for a stock divided by its current market value.

name: mdl77_nlvolcap
description: The natural logarithm of the quotient of the trailing 1-year average of the monthly volume to the trailing 1-year average of monthly market value of outstanding shares.

name: mdl77_nnastp
description: Net Current Assets-to-Price: It is defined as the current assets per share minus total liabilities per share divided by the price.

name: mdl77_ocfast
description: Operating Cash Flow to Assets: It is defined as the trailing 12-month net cash flow from operations divided by the average total assets.

name: mdl77_ocfratio
description: Operating Cash Flow Ratio: It is defined as a stock's most recently reported quarterly cash flow from operations divided by its current liabilities.

name: mdl77_oearningmomentumfactor_dypeg
description: Reciprocal of Dividend Yield-adjusted PEG: It is defined as the reciprocal of a stock's forward 12-month P/E ratio divided by the total growth rate. The total growth rate is defined as the sum of the forecasted long-term growth rate and the indicated dividend yield.

name: mdl77_oearningmomentumfactor_fcfroey1p
description: Product of TTM FCF Yield and Forward ROE: It is defined as the trailing 12-month free cash flow per share multiplied by the next 4-quarter consensus earnings forecasts divided by the most recently reported book value per share scaled by its trading price.

name: mdl77_oearningmomentumfactor_fcus
description: Standardized Unexpected Cash Flow: It is defined as the most recent quarterly operating cash flow minus that of 4 quarters ago, divided by the standard deviation of this difference over the preceding 8 quarters.

name: mdl77_oearningmomentumfactor_fqsurstd
description: Most Recent Earnings Surprise: It is defined as the most recent quarterly earnings surprise (actual fiscal quarter EPS less the consensus earnings estimate) adjusted by the standard deviation of analyst forecasts.

name: mdl77_oearningmomentumfactor_fy1epsskew
description: The skewness of the distribution of a series leading 12-month earnings consensus estimates.

name: mdl77_oearningmomentumfactor_gspea1q
description: 1-Quarter Ahead EPS Growth: It is defined as a stock's most recent fiscal quarter consensus earnings forecast less the actual quarterly earnings recorded four quarters ago divided by its trading price.

name: mdl77_oearningmomentumfactor_gspea1y
description: 1-Year Ahead EPS Growth: It is defined as the most recent consensus earnings forecast for the next 4 quarters minus the last 4 quarters' reported earnings, deflated by trading price.

name: mdl77_oearningmomentumfactor_gspea2y
description: 2-Year Ahead EPS Growth: It is defined as the most recent consensus earnings forecast for fiscal year 2 minus the consensus earnings forecast for fiscal year 1, divided by trading price.

name: mdl77_oearningmomentumfactor_gtl
description: Long-Term Growth Rate Estimates: It is defined as the consensus long-term growth forecast. It generally represents an expected annual increase in operating earnings over the company's next full business cycle.

name: mdl77_oearningmomentumfactor_gtlm6ghc
description: 6-M Change in Long-term Growth Estimates: It is defined as the percent change in the most recent mean consensus long-term growth forecast as compared to those of 6 months ago.

name: mdl77_oearningmomentumfactor_lagegp
description: Lagged Inverse of PEG Ratio: It is defined as the trailing 12-month earnings per share before extraordinary items times the change in yearly trailing 12-month sales per share growth rate, divided by trading price.

name: mdl77_oearningmomentumfactor_mrspe
description: Street Revision Magnitude: It is defined as the 3-month change in the median FY1 consensus earnings forecast, scaled by the current mean earnings estimate.

name: mdl77_oearningmomentumfactor_numrevq1
description: Net Number ofRevisions for Fiscal QTR 1: It is defined as the number of fiscal quarter 1 upward earnings forecast revisions less the number lowered within a month, divided by the total number of analyst forecasts.

name: mdl77_oearningmomentumfactor_numrevy1
description: Net Number ofRevisions for Fiscal Year 1: It is defined as the weighted average of the number of FY1 analyst earnings forecasts raised less the number lowered within a month, divided by the total number of analyst forecasts.

name: mdl77_oearningmomentumfactor_pelh
description: Street Revision Confidence: It is defined as the sum of the 3-month change in the highest and lowest FY1 earnings estimate, scaled by month-end trading price.

name: mdl77_oearningmomentumfactor_perg
description: Risk-Adjusted PEG Ratio: It is defined as the stock price divided by the leading 12-month consensus earnings forecast, scaled by the average long-term growth rate estimate, and multiplied by the stock's 36-month beta.

name: mdl77_oearningmomentumfactor_pge
description: Estimates on the next 1-year average earnings scaled by company's prospects on growth and its stock price.

name: mdl77_oearningmomentumfactor_qepsferr
description: Prior Fiscal Quarter Forecast Error: It is defined as the difference between the actual earnings per share and consensus forecast scaled by the stock's price at the beginning of the quarter.

name: mdl77_oearningmomentumfactor_ratrev6m
description: Street Rating Revision: It is defined as the 6-month average of the change in the average analyst recommendation tracked by

name: mdl77_oearningmomentumfactor_rev1q1
description: Revision in Fiscal QTR 1 EPS Forecasts: It is defined as the change in the current consensus earnings forecast for fiscal quarter 1 less the earnings forecast of one month ago, deflated by the trading price.

name: mdl77_oearningmomentumfactor_rev3y1
description: The change in the analysts' projection on company's performance for fiscal year 1 less that of three months ago, deflated by its price.

name: mdl77_oearningmomentumfactor_rev3y2
description: 3-M Revision in FY2 EPS Forecasts: It is defined as the change in the current mean consensus earnings estimate for fiscal year 2 less that of 3 months ago, deflated by its trading price.

name: mdl77_oearningmomentumfactor_rev6
description: Averaged Last 6-M EPS Revisions for FY1: It is defined as the average of prior 6-month monthly changes in a stock's consensus analysts' earnings forecasts for fiscal year 1, scaled by previous month-end trading price.

name: mdl77_oearningmomentumfactor_salesurp
description: Sales Surprise: It is defined as the most recent reported quarterly sales minus consensus sales forecasts, divided by the standard deviation of sales forecasts.

name: mdl77_oearningmomentumfactor_spe1yfvc
description: FY1 EPS Estimates Dispersion: It is defined as the standard deviation of analyst earnings estimates for fiscal year 1 divided by the mean consensus forecast.

name: mdl77_oearningmomentumfactor_spe2yfvc
description: FY2 EPS Forecast Dispersion: It is defined as the standard deviation of analyst earnings estimates for fiscal year 2 divided by the mean consensus forecast.

name: mdl77_oearningmomentumfactor_stdevfy1epsp
description: Std Dev of FY1 EPS Estimates-to-Price: It is defined as the standard deviation of analyst forecasts for fiscal year 1 earnings scaled by closing price.

name: mdl77_oearningmomentumfactor_stdevfy2epsp
description: Std Dev of FY2 EPS Estimates-to-Price: It is defined as the standard deviation of analyst forecasts for fiscal year 2 earnings scaled by closing price.

name: mdl77_oearningmomentumfactor_stockrating
description: Street Consensus Rating: It is defined as the consensus recommendation for a company.

name: mdl77_oearningmomentumfactor_sue
description: Standardized Unexpected Earnings: It is defined as the most recent quarterly earnings per share minus that of 4 quarters ago, divided by the standard deviation of this difference over the preceding 8 quarters.

name: mdl77_oearningmomentumfactor_surp
description: Real Earnings Surprise: It is defined as the difference between the actual earnings per share and consensus forecasts prior to the announcement date, scaled by price at the end of the quarter.

name: mdl77_oearningmomentumfactor_y2repsg
description: 2-Year Projected EPS Growth: It is defined as the most recent consensus earnings forecast for fiscal year 2 minus the most recently reported fiscal year earnings, deflated by trading price.

name: mdl77_oearningmomentumfactor_y3sur
description: Volatility-adj 3-yr Projected EPS Growth: It is defined as the consensus earnings forecast for the current quarter minus the actual quarterly earnings 12 quarters ago, deflated by the standard deviation of the actual quarterly earnings.

name: mdl77_oearningsqualityfactor_ccacw
description: Working Capital Accruals: It equals to: Increase in Accounts Receivables + Increase in Inventory + Decrease in Accounts Payable and Accrued Liabilities + Decrease in Accrued Income Taxes + Increase (Decrease) in Assets (Liabilities).

name: mdl77_oearningsqualityfactor_chgsgasale
description: Change in QTR SG&A Expenses vs Sales: It is defined as the difference between the yearly change in quarterly Selling, General and Administrative expenses and yearly change in quarterly sales.

name: mdl77_oearningsqualityfactor_chgshare
description: Percent Change in Shares Outstanding: It is defined as the percent change in a company's current number of outstanding shares as compared to the number of shares outstanding one year ago.

name: mdl77_oearningsqualityfactor_cogsinvt
description: Change in TTM COGS vs Inventory Level: It is defined as the absolute value of the difference between the yearly percent change in trailing 12-month cost of goods sold and the yearly percent change in inventory level.

name: mdl77_oearningsqualityfactor_cre
description: Earnings Response Coefficient: It is defined as the slope coefficient between market-adjusted returns around the time of corporate earnings announcements and yearly change in quarterly actual earnings per share tracked by.

name: mdl77_oearningsqualityfactor_dpcapex
description: Change in TTM Depreciation vs CapEx: It is defined as the absolute value of the difference between the yearly percent change in trailing 12-month depreciation expense and the yearly percent change in trailing 12-month capital expenditure.

name: mdl77_oearningsqualityfactor_epschgetr
description: EPS from Change in Effective Tax Rate: It is defined as the trailing 12-month pre-tax income per share times the difference between the most recent trailing 12-month effective tax rate and that of 4 quarters ago. The effective tax rate is defined as total tax expense divided by pre-tax income.

name: mdl77_oearningsqualityfactor_indrelrecd_
description: Industry-Adjusted Doubtful Account Receivables: It is defined as a stock's asset-adjusted annual doubtful receivables minus the average of the receivables of all stocks in the same industry deflated by the standard deviation of these receivables.

name: mdl77_oearningsqualityfactor_lccau
description: Unexpected Change in Accrued Liabilities: It is defined as the difference between the most recent fiscal year's accrued liabilities and the expected accrued liabilities (multiplying the prior year's closing account balance by the growth in the trailing 12-month sales) scaled by the total assets.

name: mdl77_oearningsqualityfactor_opincltd
description: Change in TTM Oper Income vs LT Debt: It is defined as the difference between the yearly percent change in operating income and the yearly percent change in long-term debt.

name: mdl77_oearningsqualityfactor_pau
description: Unexpected Change in Accounts Payable: It is defined as the difference between current accounts payable and the expected level of accounts payable (multiplying the prior year's closing account balance by the growth in costs of goods sold in the trailing 12 months) scaled by the total assets.

name: mdl77_oearningsqualityfactor_pedu
description: Unexpected Change in Depreciation: It is defined as the difference between the trailing 12-month depreciation expenses and the expected level of depreciation expenses (multiplying the prior year's closing account balance by the growth in total fixed assets) scaled by the total assets.

name: mdl77_oearningsqualityfactor_rau
description: Unexpected Change in Accounts Receivable: It is defined as the difference between current accounts receivable and the expected level of accounts receivable (multiplying the prior year's closing account balance by the growth in sales in the trailing 12 months) scaled by the total assets.

name: mdl77_oearningsqualityfactor_saleeps
description: Change in TTM Sales vs EPS: It is defined as the absolute value of the difference between the yearly percent change in trailing 12-month sales per share and the yearly percent change in trailing 12-month diluted earnings per share before extraordinary items.

name: mdl77_oearningsqualityfactor_salegpm
description: Change in QTR Sales vs. Gross Margin: It is defined as the difference between the yearly change in most recent reported quarterly sales and the yearly change in the quarterly gross profit margin.

name: mdl77_oearningsqualityfactor_salerec
description: Change in TTM Sales vs Accounts Receivable: It is defined as the difference between the yearly percent change in trailing 12-month sales and the yearly percent change in accounts receivable.

name: mdl77_oearningsqualityfactor_spefcn
description: Change in TTM EPS vs. Oper Cash Flows: It is defined as the absolute value of the difference between the yearly percent change in trailing 12-month operating cash flow per share and the yearly percent change in trailing 12-month diluted EPS before extraordinary items.

name: mdl77_oearningsqualityfactor_ttmaccu
description: Accounting Accruals: It is defined as the difference between the trailing 12-month net income and the trailing 12-month operating cash flow scaled by the beginning total assets.

name: mdl77_oearningsqualityfactor_vniu
description: The difference of inventory between present and expected levels.

name: mdl77_oearningsqualityfactor_yoychgaa
description: Change in Accruals to Assets: It is defined as the trailing 12-month income before extra items less the trailing 12-month operating cash flow, then scaled by the average total assets, then minus the scaled difference for the same quarter 1 year ago.

name: mdl77_ohistoricalgrowthfactor_cg3ysales
description: The geometric growth rate of the trailing 12-month sales per share in the last 12 quarters.

name: mdl77_ohistoricalgrowthfactor_chg3ycfast
description: 3-yr Change in Assets-adj TTM Cash Flow: It is defined as the most recently reported trailing 12-month operating cash flow minus 12 quarters ago comparable trailing 12-month cash flow scaled by the average total assets in the same period.

name: mdl77_ohistoricalgrowthfactor_chg3yepsast
description: 3-yr Change in Assets-adj TTM EPS: It is defined as the trailing 12-month earnings per share before extra items (EPS) minus the EPS 12 quarters ago deflated by the average total assets per share.

name: mdl77_ohistoricalgrowthfactor_chg3yepsp
description: The difference between the trailing 12-month earnings per share and that of 12 quarters ago for a stock divided by its month-end trading price.

name: mdl77_ohistoricalgrowthfactor_chg3yfcfast
description: 3-yr Chg in Assets-adj TTM Free Cash Flow: It is defined as the trailing 12-month free cash flow minus 12-quarters ago trailing 12-month free cash flow divided by the average total assets.

name: mdl77_ohistoricalgrowthfactor_chg3yocfast
description: 3-yr Change in Assets-adj TTM Oper Cash Flow: It is defined as the most recently reported trailing 12-month operating cash flow (OCF) minus the OCF 12 quarters ago deflated by the average total assets.

name: mdl77_ohistoricalgrowthfactor_chgars
description: 1-yr Chg in Acct Receivable as Percentage ofSales: It is defined as the change between the last reported accounts receivable as a percentage of trailing 12-month sales and that percentage 4 quarters ago.

name: mdl77_ohistoricalgrowthfactor_cv4qsales3y
description: The standard deviation of prior 12 quarters' trailing 12-month sales for individual share scaled to the mean of itself in the same period.

name: mdl77_ohistoricalgrowthfactor_cvopinc
description: CV of Oper Income per Share in Last 12 QTRs: It is defined as the standard deviation of the trailing 12-month operating income per share (OPINC) in the prior 12 quarters divided by the mean of the OPINCs in the same period.

name: mdl77_ohistoricalgrowthfactor_div5yg
description: 5-Year Dividend Growth Rate: It is defined as the 5-year growth in dividends

name: mdl77_ohistoricalgrowthfactor_fcfequity
description: TTM Free Cash Flow to Equity: It is defined as the trailing 12-month free cash flow divided by the average book equity value in the same period.

name: mdl77_ohistoricalgrowthfactor_fcfghc
description: 1-yr Chg in Assets-adj TTM Free Cash Flow: It is defined as the trailing 12-month free cash flow minus 4 quarters ago trailing 12-month free cash flow divided by the average total assets.

name: mdl77_ohistoricalgrowthfactor_fcghc
description: 1-yr Change in Assets-adj TTM Cash Flow: It is defined as the trailing 12-month cash flow minus comparable trailing 12-month cash flow from 4 quarters ago scaled by the average total assets.

name: mdl77_ohistoricalgrowthfactor_fcoghc
description: 1-yr Chg in Assets-adj TTM Oper Cash Flow: It is defined as the most recently reported trailing 12-month operating cash flow minus 4 quarters ago trailing 12-month operating cash flow divided by the average total assets.

name: mdl77_ohistoricalgrowthfactor_mpnghc
description: 1-Yr Change in Net Profit Margin: It is defined as the most recent quarterly net profit margin (NPM) minus the NPM 4 quarters ago. Net profit margin is net income divided by total sales.

name: mdl77_ohistoricalgrowthfactor_mpoghc
description: 1-yr Change in Operating Profit Margin: It is defined as the most recent quarterly operating profit margin minus that of 4 quarters ago. Operating profit margin is income from operations divided by total sales.

name: mdl77_ohistoricalgrowthfactor_pctchg3ycf
description: The percent change in a stock's most recent trailing 12-month cash flow per share as compared to itself 12 quarters ago.

name: mdl77_ohistoricalgrowthfactor_pctchg3yeps
description: The percent change in a stock's most recent trailing 12-month earnings per share as compared to itself 12 quarters ago.

name: mdl77_ohistoricalgrowthfactor_pctchg3yfcf
description: 3-yr Growth in TTM Free Cash Flow: It is defined as the percent change in a stock's most recent trailing 12-month free cash flow per share (FCF) as compared to its FCF 12 quarters ago.

name: mdl77_ohistoricalgrowthfactor_pctchg3yocf
description: 3-yr Growth in TTM Oper Cash Flow: It is defined as the percent change in a stock's most recent trailing 12-month operating cash flow per share (OCF) as compared to its OCF 12 quarters ago.

name: mdl77_ohistoricalgrowthfactor_pctchgastto
description: 1-Yr Change in Asset Turnover Ratio: It is defined as the percent change in the most recent asset turnover ratio as compared to that of 4 quarters ago. Asset turnover ratio is the trailing 12-month sales divided by the average total assets in the same period.

name: mdl77_ohistoricalgrowthfactor_pctchgcf
description: 1-yr Growth in TTM Cash Flow: It is defined as the percent change in a stock's most recent trailing 12-month cash flow per share (CF) as compared to the CF 4 quarters ago.

name: mdl77_ohistoricalgrowthfactor_pctchgeps
description: The percent change in a stock's most recent trailing 12-month earnings per share before extra items as compared to itself 4 quarters ago.

name: mdl77_ohistoricalgrowthfactor_pctchgfcf
description: 1-yr Growth in TTM Free Cash Flow: It is defined as the percent change in a stock's most recent trailing 12-month free cash flow per share (FCF) as compared to the FCF 4 quarters ago.

name: mdl77_ohistoricalgrowthfactor_pctchgocf
description: 1-yr Growth in TTM Oper Cash Flow: It is defined as the percent change of a stock's most recent trailing 12-month operating cash flow per share (OCF) as compared to the OCF 4 quarters ago.

name: mdl77_ohistoricalgrowthfactor_pctchgqtrast
description: 1-Yr Change in Total Assets: It is defined as the growth in the most recent reported quarterly total assets per share as compared to that of four quarters ago.

name: mdl77_ohistoricalgrowthfactor_pctchgqtrsales
description: 1-Year Change in Sales: It is defined as the growth in the most recent reported quarterly sales per share as compared to 4 quarters ago.

name: mdl77_ohistoricalgrowthfactor_pfcfghc
description: The difference between the trailing 12-month free cash flow per share and that of 4 quarters ago for a stock divided by its trading price.

name: mdl77_ohistoricalgrowthfactor_pfcfy3ghc
description: 3-yr Change in Price-adj TTM FCF: It is defined as the difference between the most recently reported trailing 12-month free cash flow per share and that of 12 quarters ago for a stock divided by its month-end trading price.

name: mdl77_ohistoricalgrowthfactor_pfcghc
description: The difference between the trailing 12-month cash flow per share and that of 12 quarters ago for a stock divided by its trading price.

name: mdl77_ohistoricalgrowthfactor_pfcoghc
description: The difference between the most recently reported trailing 12-month operating cash flow per share and that of 4 quarters ago for a stock divided by its trading price.

name: mdl77_ohistoricalgrowthfactor_pfcoy3ghc
description: The difference between the trailing 12-month operating cash flow per share and that of 12 quarters ago for a stock divided by its trading price.

name: mdl77_ohistoricalgrowthfactor_pfcy3ghc
description: The difference between the trailing 12-month cash flow per share and that of 12 quarters ago comparable trailing 12-month cash flow for a stock divided by its trading price.

name: mdl77_ohistoricalgrowthfactor_pspeghc
description: The difference between the most recently reported trailing 12-month earnings per share and that of 4 quarters ago for a stock deflated by its month-end trading price.

name: mdl77_ohistoricalgrowthfactor_reinrate
description: Reinvestment Rate: It is defined as the trailing 12-month earnings per share before extra items less the trailing 12-month dividends per share by ex-date divided by the average book equity per share in the same period.

name: mdl77_ohistoricalgrowthfactor_rsqr4qsales3y
description: The conditional square of the correlation between monthly dates and the corresponding trailing 12-month sales per share in the prior 12 quarters.

name: mdl77_ohistoricalgrowthfactor_saleg5y
description: 5-yr Sales Growth: It is defined as the difference between the trailing 12-month sales per share (SALE) and the SALE 20 quarters ago and then deflated by the average of the SALEs in the prior 20 quarters

name: mdl77_ohistoricalgrowthfactor_salegstdev
description: Sales Growth Rate Standard Deviation: It is defined as the standard deviation of the year-over-year quarterly sales per share growth rate during the last 12 quarters.

name: mdl77_ohistoricalgrowthfactor_salesaccel4q
description: 4-Quarter Sales Acceleration: It is defined as the slope of the regression line between year-over-year sales growth and time.

name: mdl77_ohistoricalgrowthfactor_se5yepsg
description: Stability-Adjusted Residual Growth Rate: It is defined as a stock's mean long-term growth rate minus its 5-year historical EPS Growth, as calculated by, divided by stability of 5-year historical EPS Growth, as defined by.

name: mdl77_ohistoricalgrowthfactor_sighc
description: 1-Yr Chg in QTR Inventory as Percentage ofSales: It is defined as the most recently reported inventory as a percentage of trailing 12-month sales minus that percentage 4 quarters ago.

name: mdl77_ohistoricalgrowthfactor_slope4qcf3y
description: Slope of 3-yr TTM Cash Flow Trend Line: It is defined as the slope coefficient between monthly dates and the corresponding trailing 12-month cash flow per share in the prior 12 quarters

name: mdl77_ohistoricalgrowthfactor_slope4qeps3y
description: Slope of 3-Yr TTM EPS Trend Line: It is defined as the slope coefficient between monthly dates and the corresponding trailing 12-month earnings per share before extra items in the prior 12 quarters.

name: mdl77_ohistoricalgrowthfactor_slope4qfcf3y
description: Slope of 3-Year TTM Free Cash Flow Trend Line: It is defined as the slope coefficient between monthly dates and the corresponding trailing 12-month free cash flow per share in the prior 12 quarters.

name: mdl77_ohistoricalgrowthfactor_slope4qocf3y
description: Slope of 3-Yr TTM Oper Cash Flow Trend Line: It is defined as the slope coefficient between monthly dates and the corresponding trailing 12-month operating cash flow per share in the prior 12 quarters.

name: mdl77_ohistoricalgrowthfactor_slope4qsales3y
description: Slope of 3-yr TTM Sales Trend Line: It is defined as the slope coefficient between monthly dates and the corresponding trailing 12-month sales per share in the prior 12 quarters.

name: mdl77_ohistoricalgrowthfactor_speghc
description: 1-yr Change in Assets-adj TTM EPS: It is defined as the trailing 12-month earnings per share before extra items (EPS) minus 4 quarters ago EPS deflated by the average total assets per share.

name: mdl77_ohistoricalgrowthfactor_susgrowth
description: The maximum growth rate a firm can sustain without having to increase financial leverage.

name: mdl77_ohistoricalgrowthfactor_totalsaleg
description: Yearly TTM Total Sales Growth Rate: It is defined as the percent change in a company's trailing 12-month total sales (TOTSALE) as compared to the TOTSALE one year ago.

name: mdl77_ohistoricalgrowthfactor_y3fcfq4rqsr
description: R-Sqr of 3-yr TTM FCF Trend Line: It is defined as the conditional square of the correlation between monthly dates and the corresponding trailing 12-month free cash flow per share in the prior 12 quarters

name: mdl77_ohistoricalgrowthfactor_y3fcfq4vc
description: Stability of 3-Year TTM Free Cash Flow: It is defined as the standard deviation of the last 12 quarters' trailing 12-month free cash flow per share (FCF) divided by the mean of the FCFs.

name: mdl77_ohistoricalgrowthfactor_y3fcoq4rqsr
description: R-Sqr of 3-yr TTM Oper Cash Flow Trend Line: It is defined as the conditional square of the correlation between monthly dates and the corresponding trailing 12-month operating cash flow per share in the prior 12 quarters.

name: mdl77_ohistoricalgrowthfactor_y3fcoq4vc
description: The standard deviation of the ratio for the values that the company generates scaled by its mean in the previous 12 quarters in a trailing 1 year.

name: mdl77_ohistoricalgrowthfactor_y3fcq4rqsr
description: R-Sqr of 3-yr TTM Cash Flow Trend Line: It is defined as the conditional square of the correlation between monthly dates and the corresponding trailing 12-month cash flow per share in the prior 12 quarters

name: mdl77_ohistoricalgrowthfactor_y3fcq4vc
description: Stability of 3-yr TTM Cash Flow: It is defined as the standard deviation of the prior 12-quarter's trailing 12-month cash flow per share (CF) divided by the mean of these CFs.

name: mdl77_ohistoricalgrowthfactor_y3speq4rqsr
description: R-Sqr of 3-yr TTM EPS Trend Line: It is defined as the conditional square of the correlation between monthly dates and the corresponding trailing 12-month earnings per share before extra items in the prior 12 quarters

name: mdl77_ohistoricalgrowthfactor_y3speq4vc
description: Stability of 3-yr TTM Earnings per Share: It is defined as the standard deviation of the last 12 quarters' trailing 12-month earnings per share (EPS) divided by the mean of these EPS.

name: mdl77_oindustryrrelativevaluefactor_curindbp_
description: Industry Relative Book-to-Market: It is defined as a stock's current book-to-price ratio (BP) less the average of the BPs of all stocks in the same industry deflated by the standard deviation of the BPs of all stocks in the same relative universe

name: mdl77_oindustryrrelativevaluefactor_curindcfp_
description: Industry Relative TTM Cash Flow-to-Price: It is defined as a stock's trailing 12-month cash flow-to-price ratio (CFP) less the average of the CFPs of all stocks in the same industry, deflated by the standard deviation of the CFPs of all stocks in the same relative universe.

name: mdl77_oindustryrrelativevaluefactor_curindcoreepsp_
description: Industry Relative TTM Core Earnings-to-Price: It is defined as a stock's trailing 12-month core earnings-to-price ratio (CoreEP) less the average of the CoreEPs of all stocks in the same industry deflated by the standard deviation of the CoreEPs of all stocks in the same relative universe

name: mdl77_oindustryrrelativevaluefactor_curinddivp_
description: Industry Relative TTM Dividend Yield: It is defined as a stock's trailing 12-month dividend yield (DivYield) less the average of the DivYields of all stocks in the same industry deflated by the standard deviation of the DivYields of all stocks in the same relative universe.

name: mdl77_oindustryrrelativevaluefactor_curindebitdap_
description: Industry Relative TTM EBITDA-to-Price: It is defined as a stock's trailing 12-month EBITDA-to-price ratio (EBITDAP) less the average of the EBITDAPs of all stocks in the same industry deflated by the standard deviation of the EBITDAPs of all stocks in the same relative universe

name: mdl77_oindustryrrelativevaluefactor_curindep_
description: Industry Relative TTM EPS-to-Price: It is defined as a stock's trailing 12-month earnings per share before extra items-to-price ratio (EP) less the average of the EPs of all stocks in the same industry deflated by the standard deviation of these EPs.

name: mdl77_oindustryrrelativevaluefactor_curindfcfp_
description: Industry Relative TTM Free Cash Flow-to-Price: It is defined as a stock's trailing 12-month free cash flow-to-price ratio (FCFP) less the average of the FCFPs of all stocks in the same industry deflated by the standard deviation of the FCFPs of all stocks in the same relative universe.

name: mdl77_oindustryrrelativevaluefactor_curindfwdep_
description: Industry Relative Leading 4-QTRs EPS to Price: It is defined as a stock's next 4 quarters' analysts' consensus earnings estimates-to-price ratio (FwdEP) less the average of the FwdEPs of all stocks in the same industry, deflated by the standard deviation of these FwdEPs.

name: mdl77_oindustryrrelativevaluefactor_curindocfp_
description: Industry Relative TTM Oper Cash Flow-to-Price: It is defined as a stock's trailing 12-month operating cash flow-to-price ratio (OCFP) less the average of the OCFPs of all stocks in the same industry, deflated by the standard deviation of the OCFPs of all stocks in the same relative universe.

name: mdl77_oindustryrrelativevaluefactor_curindocfta_
description: Industry Relative TTM Oper Cash Flow-to-Total Assets: It is defined as a stock's trailing 12-month operating cash flow-to-total assets ratio (OCFTA) less the average of the OCFTA of all stocks in the same industry deflated by the standard deviation of the OCFTAs of all stocks in the same relative universe.

name: mdl77_oindustryrrelativevaluefactor_curindsp_
description: Industry Relative TTM Sales-to-Price: It is defined as a stock's trailing 12-month sales-to-price ratio (SP) less the average of the SPs of all stocks in the same industry deflated by the standard deviation of the SPs of all stocks in the same relative universe.

name: mdl77_omomemtumanalystmodel_ghcfcfmtt_amq
description: Change in TTM Free Cash Flow Rank: It is defined as the 2Q change in a stock's trailing twelve-month free cash flow, divided by the absolute value of a stock's trailing twelve-month free cash flow from two quarters ago.

name: mdl77_omomemtumanalystmodel_htwrgspe_amq
description: Earnings Growth Rank: It is defined as the one quarter change in a stock's trailing twelve month earnings per share, scaled by its recent closing stock price (E/P).

name: mdl77_omomemtumanalystmodel_jdaksr_amq
description: Risk Adjustments Rank: It is defined as the aggregation of five non-linear price and trading volume volatility and growth subfactors. This factor penalizes a stock with extremely high (or low) volume volatility, high standard deviation of monthly returns, and large intraday price high/low spreads, among other ideas.

name: mdl77_omomemtumanalystmodel_qma_alpha6m
description: Six-Month Alpha Change Rank: It is defined as the six-month change in a stock's twelve-month alpha, as calculated by a rolling CAPM regression.

name: mdl77_omomemtumanalystmodel_qma_chgnowc
description: Change in Net Working Capital Rank: It is defined as the one-quarter change in a stock's recent net current working capital divided by total net operating assets from one quarter ago.

name: mdl77_omomemtumanalystmodel_qma_composite
description: The composite of the Earnings Momentum Rank, the Analyst Expectations Rank, the Earnings-Price Link Rank, and the Relative Price Momentum Rank factors.

name: mdl77_omomemtumanalystmodel_qma_condsurp
description: Conditional Surprise Rank: It is defined as the average of a stock's recent earnings surprise, its cost of goods sold efficiency relative to its value categorization, and its sales growth strength relative to its growth categorization.

name: mdl77_omomemtumanalystmodel_qma_earnexp
description: Analyst Expectations Rank: It is defined as the equal-weighted average of the Earnings Revisions and the Ratings Change Ranks.

name: mdl77_omomemtumanalystmodel_qma_eplinkage
description: The equal-weighted average of the Change in Free Cash Flow Rank, the Industry Relative 3-Month Return Rank, the Market Earnings Response Rank, and the Change in Net Working Capital Rank.

name: mdl77_omomemtumanalystmodel_qma_estrev
description: Estimate Revisions Rank: It is defined as the difference between the number of recent upward and downward revisions to both fiscal one year (FY1) and fiscal two year (FY2) EPS estimates over the past four weeks, scaled respectively by the total number of FY1 and FY2 estimates.

name: mdl77_omomemtumanalystmodel_qma_indrelrtn3m
description: The difference of a company's 3-month profit compared to its respective by industry classification.

name: mdl77_omomemtumanalystmodel_qma_lagpricemo
description: Lagged 12- to 1-Month Price MomRank: It is defined as the difference between a stock's lagged twelve month return and its recent one month return, scaled by the standard deviation of the one month return over the past year.

name: mdl77_omomemtumanalystmodel_qma_mktresponse
description: Market Earnings Response Rank: It is defined as the four-day return for a stock, spanning the two days before to the day after its recent quarterly earnings report.

name: mdl77_omomemtumanalystmodel_qma_ratingchg
description: The trend in sell-side analysts' consensus ratings (standardized 1 = strong buy to 5 = strong sell) revisions over the last 4 and 8 weeks, respectively.

name: mdl77_omomemtumanalystmodel_qma_relpricemo
description: Relative Price Momentum Rank: It is defined as the equal-weighted average of the Lagged 12- to 1-Month Price Momentum Rank, the Risk Adjustments Rank, and the 6-Month Alpha Change Rank.

name: mdl77_omomemtumanalystmodel_qma_repearnmom
description: Earnings Momentum Rank: It is defined as the equal-weighted average of the Earnings Growth and Earnings Surprise Rankings.

name: mdl77_ooearningsmomemtummodel_chgsup
description: Change in EPS Surprise: It is defined as the quarterly change in EPS surprise.

name: mdl77_ooearningsmomemtummodel_emm_composite
description: Model composition based on earnings momentum

name: mdl77_ooearningsmomemtummodel_fc_fcfroey1p
description: Product of TTM FCF Yield and Forward ROE: It is defined as the trailing 12-month free cash flow per share multiplied by the next 4-quarter consensus earnings forecasts divided by the most recently reported book value per share scaled by its trading price.

name: mdl77_ooearningsmomemtummodel_fc_fqsurstd
description: Most Recent Quarterly Earnings Surprise: It is defined as a stock's most recent quarterly earnings surprise (actual fiscal quarter EPS less the consensus earnings estimate) adjusted by the standard deviation of its analysts' individual earnings forecasts.

name: mdl77_ooearningsmomemtummodel_fc_numrevy1
description: Net Number ofRevisions for Fiscal Year 1: It is defined as the weighted average of the number of FY1 analyst earnings forecasts raised less the number lowered within a month, divided by the total number of analyst forecasts.

name: mdl77_ooearningsmomemtummodel_fc_rev3y2
description: 3-M Revision in FY2 EPS Forecasts: It is defined as the change in a stock's current analysts' mean earnings estimate for fiscal year 2 less that of 3 months ago, deflated by its month-end trading price.

name: mdl77_ooearningsmomemtummodel_fc_y2repsg
description: 2-Year Projected EPS Growth: It is defined as a stock's most recent consensus analysts' earnings forecast for fiscal year 2 minus the most recent reported fiscal year actual earnings tracked by and then deflated by its month-end trading price.

name: mdl77_ooearningsmomemtummodel_gtlo
description: Long-Term Growth Rate Estimates: It is defined as the consensus long-term growth forecast. It generally represents an expected annual increase in operating earnings over the company's next full business cycle.

name: mdl77_ooearningsmomemtummodel_pge_cf
description: Estimates on the next 1-year average earnings scaled by company's prospects on growth and its stock price.

name: mdl77_ooearningsmomemtummodel_spe2yfvc_cf
description: FY2 EPS Forecast Dispersion: It is defined as the standard deviation of analyst earnings estimates for fiscal year 2 divided by the mean consensus forecast.

name: mdl77_opricemomentumfactor_25_4op
description: One minus the quotient of a stock's last 52-week price exponential moving average divided by its last 4-week price exponential moving average.

name: mdl77_opricemomentumfactor_6351_rp
description: 15/36 Week Stock Price Ratio: It is defined as the moving average of a stock's prices in the last 15 weeks divided by the moving average of its prices in the last 36 weeks.

name: mdl77_opricemomentumfactor_actrtn12m
description: 12-Month Active Return with 1-month Lag: It is defined as the percent change in price for a stock from month t-13 to month t-1.

name: mdl77_opricemomentumfactor_actrtn18m
description: 18-Month Active Return with 1-Month Lag: It is defined as the percent change in price for a stock from month t-19 to month t-1.

name: mdl77_opricemomentumfactor_actrtn1m
description: 1-Month Active Return: It is defined as the percent change in price for a stock from month t-1 to month t.

name: mdl77_opricemomentumfactor_actrtn24m
description: 24-Month Active Return with 1-Month Lag: It is defined as the percent change in price for a stock from month t-25 to month t-1.

name: mdl77_opricemomentumfactor_actrtn2m
description: 2-Month Active Return: It is defined as the percent change in price for a stock from month t-2 to month t.

name: mdl77_opricemomentumfactor_actrtn36m
description: 36-Month Active Return with 1-Month Lag: It is defined as the percent change in price for a stock from month t-37 to month t-1.

name: mdl77_opricemomentumfactor_actrtn3m
description: 3-Month Active Return: It is defined as the percent change in price for a stock from month t-3 to month t.

name: mdl77_opricemomentumfactor_actrtn60m
description: 60-Month Active Return with 1-Month Lag: It is defined as the percent change in price for a stock from month t-61 to month t-1.

name: mdl77_opricemomentumfactor_actrtn6m
description: 6-Month Active Return with 1-Month Lag: It is defined as the percent change in price for a stock from month t-7 to month t-1.

name: mdl77_opricemomentumfactor_alpha60m
description: 60-Month Alpha: It is defined as the intercept of the regression line which best fits a stock's monthly price return against the S&P 500 index monthly return over the last 60-month period.

name: mdl77_opricemomentumfactor_chg6malpha18m
description: 6-Month Nominal Change in 18-Month Alpha: It is defined as the 6-month change in a stock's 18-month alpha, which equals the intercept from the regression of a stock price's monthly return against the S&P 500 index monthly return over the last 18-month period.

name: mdl77_opricemomentumfactor_chgalpha12m
description: 6-Month Nominal Change in 12-Month Alpha: It is defined as the 6-month change in a stock's 12-month alpha, which equals the intercept from the regression of a stock price's monthly return against the S&P 500 index monthly return over the last 12-month period.

name: mdl77_opricemomentumfactor_chgalpha36m
description: 6-Month Nominal Change in 36-Month Alpha: It is defined as the 6-month change in a stock's 36-month alpha, which equals the intercept from the regression of a stock price's monthly return against the S&P 500 Index monthly return over the last 36-month period.

name: mdl77_opricemomentumfactor_chgvolpre4y
description: 4-Year Change in the Average Trading Volume: It is defined as the change in the most recent 6-month moving average of monthly turnover ratio (average monthly trading volume/total shares outstanding) as compared to the 12-month moving average of monthly turnover ratio 4 years ago.

name: mdl77_opricemomentumfactor_high52w
description: 52-Week High: It is defined as the month-end price divided by the highest monthly closing price in the past 12 months.

name: mdl77_opricemomentumfactor_indrelrtn4w_
description: 4-Week Industry Relative Return: It is defined as a stock's return in the last 4 weeks minus the average of the comparable returns of all stocks in the same industry, deflated by the standard deviation of these returns.

name: mdl77_opricemomentumfactor_indrelrtn5d_
description: Stock's return in the last 5 days minus the average of the comparable returns of all stocks in the same industry, then deflated by the standard deviation of these returns.

name: mdl77_opricemomentumfactor_m42rav
description: 24-Month Value at Risk: It is defined as the minimum of a stock's monthly price return in the last 20-month period.

name: mdl77_opricemomentumfactor_m6dn2ntr
description: Second Preceding 6-month Return: It is defined as the percent change in a stock's price from month t-12 to month t-7.

name: mdl77_opricemomentumfactor_normalmf60d
description: The 60-day average of a stock's daily money flow divided by daily total dollar volume.

name: mdl77_opricemomentumfactor_ntrm01ff
description: Fama-French Momentum: It is defined as the percent change in a stock's price from month t-12 to month t-2.

name: mdl77_opricemomentumfactor_p50_200ratio
description: 50-200 Day Stock Price Ratio: It is defined as the moving average of a stock's prices in the last 50 days divided by the moving average of its prices in the last 200 days.

name: mdl77_opricemomentumfactor_pc_ratio
description: Put/Call Ratio: It is defined as the open interest in 7 near-the-money (1 at-the-money, next 3 above and next 3 below), nearest to expiration put option contracts divided by the open interest in 7 near-the-money (1 at-the-money, next 3 above and next 3 below), nearest to expiration call option contracts.

name: mdl77_opricemomentumfactor_pctabv260low
description: Price Above Last 260-day Lowest Trading Price: It is defined as a stock's current closing price divided by its lowest daily low price in the last 260 trading days.

name: mdl77_opricemomentumfactor_pd09erpvc
description: CV of Prior 90-Day Closing Prices: It is defined as the standard deviation of a stock's last 90 days closing prices divided by the mean of these prices.

name: mdl77_opricemomentumfactor_rationalalpha
description: Rational Decay Alpha: It evaluates stocks based on their historical 12-month market (S&P 500) adjusted excess return (the Y intercept from an OLS regression equation) using a proprietary rational decay function.

name: mdl77_opricemomentumfactor_rba
description: Abnormal Return around QTR Earnings Release: It is defined as the sum of a stock's daily market-adjusted price return from 2 days before to 1 day after its quarterly earnings announcement. The market return proxy is the S&P 500 index.

name: mdl77_opricemomentumfactor_relpricestrength_
description: Industry-adjusted 12-month Relative Price Strength: It is defined as a stock's 12-month relative price strength (PS) minus the PSs of all stocks in the same industry deflated by the standard deviation of these PSs.

name: mdl77_opricemomentumfactor_sharpe36m
description: Changes in a company's monthly profit in the last 3 years compared to its profit 3 months ago.

name: mdl77_opricemomentumfactor_skew90cortn
description: Skewness of 90-Day Stock Daily Excess Returns: It is defined as the skewness of the distribution of a stock's daily excess (compared to the S&P 500 index) price returns in the last 90 days. Skewness = 3*(Mean-Median])/Standard Deviation.

name: mdl77_opricemomentumfactor_skew90drtn
description: Skewness of 90-Day Stock Daily Returns: It is defined as the skewness (measure of lack of symmetry) of the distribution of a stock's daily price returns in the last 90 days. Skewness = 3*(Mean-Median])/Standard Deviation.

name: mdl77_opricemomentumfactor_slope52wp
description: Slope of 52 Week Price Trend Line: It is defined as the 4-week lagged slope coefficient of the least squares regression line of the last 52-week weekly stock's closing price against the corresponding weekly dates.

name: mdl77_opricemomentumfactor_slope66wp
description: Slope of 66 Week Price Trend Line: It is defined as the 4-week lagged slope coefficient of the least squares regression line of the last 66-week weekly stock's closing price against the corresponding weekly dates.

name: mdl77_opricemomentumfactor_sortinoratio
description: Sortino Ratio: It is defined as a stock's annualized average monthly total return over the last 36-months less the average annualized 90-Day T-Bill rate over the same period divided by the standard deviation of the stock's monthly returns in months when total return was negative.

name: mdl77_opricemomentumfactor_tstalp
description: 1-Year Price Momentum Indicator: It is defined as: (CORREL*(260-2)^.5)/(1-CORREL^2)^.5. CORREL is the correlation coefficient between the natural logarithm of stock daily closing price and the corresponding daily dates in the last 260 days.

name: mdl77_opricemomentumfactor_varresirtn
description: 24-Month Residual Return Variance: It is defined as the variance of a stock's monthly residual return in the last 24 months. The monthly residual return equals the stock's monthly return minus the product of the multiplication of a stock's proprietary 60-month Beta by the S&P 500 index monthly return.

name: mdl77_opricemomentumfactor_visiratio
description: The Visibility Ratio: It equals a stock's most recent daily trading volume divided by the average daily trading volume in the previous 50 trading days.

name: mdl77_opricemomentumfactor_volpre6m
description: The 6-month moving average of average monthly turnover ratio.

name: mdl77_opricemomentumfactor_w15tvp
description: This field determines the strength of trends and warns of reversals.

name: mdl77_opricemomentumfactor_w57w03_rp
description: 30-75 Week Stock Price Ratio: It is defined as the moving average of a stock's prices in the last 30 weeks divided by the moving average of its prices in the last 75 weeks.

name: mdl77_opricemomentumfactor_w62isr
description: 26-Week Relative Price Strength: It is defined as a stock's most recent weekly closing price divided by its weekly closing price 26 weeks ago.

name: mdl77_opricemomentumfactor_w93ntr
description: 39-Week Return with 4-week Lag: It is defined as a stock's price change from week t-43 to week t-4.

name: mdl77_oput_put_capmod
description: Capital Strength Module: It is defined as the equal-weighted average of the Industry Relative ROE, Change in Shares Outstanding, Total Coverage, and Change in Operating Liability Leverage factors.

name: mdl77_oput_put_cashburn
description: Cash Burn Rate: It is defined as: -(Cash From Operations + Cash from Investments)/(Cash + Short-term Investments).

name: mdl77_oput_put_chgalpha
description: Six-Month Alpha Change Rank: It is defined as the six-month change in a stock's twelve-month alpha, as calculated by a rolling CAPM regression.

name: mdl77_oput_put_chgoll
description: Change in Operating Liability Leverage: It is defined as the current quarter operating liability leverage less the operating liability leverage 4 quarters ago, where operating liability leverage equals 1 minus the ratio of (short-term debt + long-term debt + common equity + preferred equity - cash) to (total assets - cash).

name: mdl77_oput_put_chshrs
description: Percent Change in Shares Outstanding: It is defined as the percent change in a company's current number of outstanding shares as compared to the number of shares outstanding 1 year ago.

name: mdl77_oput_put_composite
description: Custom Small Cap Composite: It is defined as the equal-weighted average of the Momentum, Quality, Valuation, and Capital Strength modules.
